publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)

Unfortunately, this is why real-time deployments hurt healthcare efficiency. Despite several optimization solutions proposed by academics to tackle these issues, most of them increase mining complexity, which in turn reduces its scalability. articleTitle: Advanced Device Interaction Enabled by Vision Control and Eye Gesture Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The research focusses on a vision-based human-computer interface, in which we propose a method for recognising and categorising eye motions for the purpose of computer interaction. The goal of this research is to improve interaction between humans and computers. The purpose of the system is to make it possible for people who have physical restrictions to communicate with computers in a way that is both efficient and cost-effective by utilising eye movements. The proposed technique includes a number of important stages, including the detection of facial and eye areas, the pre - processing of pictures of the eye region, the extraction of Histogram of Orientated Gradients (HOG) features, and the classification of these features through the application of deep learning algorithms as well as machine learning. At the same time that an interface is being built to permit computer control by eye motions, a performance evaluation of the system is being carried out in order to determine how effective it is becoming. By utilizing strong computational approaches and inexpensive, easily available technologies, this project aims to provide equitable access to persons with physical limits.

articleTitle: A Survey on Cyber Threat Predictive Analysis in Cyber Supply Chain Security
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The primary objective of this work is to find out a methodology for cyber security which has become a major concern in cyber networks due to the targeted attacks in the network environments. This survey aims to effectively detect and classify cyber-attacks within network environments, providing robust protection against various types of intrusions. To identify and respond to the security breaches in the network, intrusion detection systems play a key role. The existing traditional methods have drawbacks such as high false rates, less accuracy and limited adaptability. Research has started to use advanced optimization algorithms and machine learning techniques to tackle the existing problems. This work discusses in detail the approaches to solving the problem and gives a comprehensive overview of the advantages and disadvantages. Lastly, this work analyses an approach that includes the usage of advanced optimization algorithms to overcome the existing problems in the system.

articleTitle: Weather Forecasting Web application
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Weather Refers to the Atmosphere state of certain area and time in terms of temperature, clouds, winds, dry state, sun and rain. The most important geophysical phenomenon that affects us is weather. Weather fluctuates greatly and is impacted by a number of elements including cloudiness, climate, and other variables. The primary goal of the project is to develop an app that can deliver weather forecasts for each city on the planet. We wish to use the ReactJS java script technology to create a web application.

articleTitle: Leveraging Yolov3 and CNN Algorithms for Brain Tumor Detection in MRI Scans
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The brain ranks high among the body's most vital organs, and scientists have examined it to learn more about human behavior. The body acts better when the brain is operating properly. Several things affect the brain's systematic function. We opted to research brain tumours, which are caused by aberrant brain cell growth. MRI is usually used for brain recognition. The inability to determine location is a major drawback. Finding the tools and techniques to identify, diagnose, and categorise the disease from the image is crucial. The proposed method is an MRI-based approach to identify and classify brain tumours. We utilise the YOLOv3 object detection technique. This approach may determine the target subject and confidence score in one pass. Additionally, CNN divides tumors into two groups: gliomas of low severity and high severity gliomas, according to the grading system used by the World Health Organisation. The model can reliably detect MRI tumours with 99.5%, 97%, and 98% accuracy, respectively. We achieved 98% categorisation accuracy by evaluating forty photographs, twenty each category. With Low Grade Glioma, one may acquire 100% precision at recall 97%, while with High Grade, 97% precision at recall 100%.

articleTitle: Leveraging Cloud Technology for Enhanced Online Examination System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: An online cloud-based Examination Framework is a web application in which the user can try an online exam. Through a web browser, the user can search for an exam for a particular subject that they want to improve. Users can also review their earlier exams and learn and improve their mistakes. The user can login using his/her account details of interest, or modern users can set up an account exceptionally rapidly using the enrollment strategy. They ought to grant the subtle elements of their title, contact and their level of education.

articleTitle: Securing Smart Homes with Blockchain-Enabled Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Growing Internet Of Things (IoT) boosts rapid development Of smart home technologies.. Yet it brings new security challenges.. Centralized architectures frequently used in smart home networks are particularly at risk through gateways. .Such networks are exposed to numerous security threats. These include unauthorized access, data tampering And single points of failure. In this study we suggest decentralized blockchain-based system to reinforce security in smart home environments .Through integration of blockchain technology we seek to handle problems like data integrity. Also authentication and availability. Adopting Our proposed architecture plays upon use Of Ethereum blockchain.. It utilizes smart contracts to manage and secure interactions Between devices in the household.. Furthermore employing SHA-256 hashing guarantees privacy to sensitive data exchanged between devices. .It also makes the transmitted data tamper-proof. We perform real-time validation of data over distributed ledgers. This considerably diminishes chance of cyber-attacks .Our strategy is Scalable and Safe for management of Smart homes.

articleTitle: Enhanced Cardiovascular Disease Diagnosis Using Multi-Label Machine Learning and Stacking Cross-Validation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The necessity for early access to reliable models is heightened by the fact that cardiovascular disease (CVD) remains a leading global killer. This study also looks at how multi-label algorithms for machine learning may be used to better diagnose cardiovascular diseases. In this study we utilized different types of ML procedures to successfully analyze various heart disease datasets, including LR Classifier, SVM, KNN, Choice Tree, Random Forestry, and Gradient Boosting Classifiers. Conventional methods provide the groundwork for prediction, according to comparative research, but they often fall short of what is needed for peak performance and accuracy. We provide a refined model that addresses these limitations by use of a Stacking Cross-Validation (CV) Classifier. To get the best results, this model takes the best parts of many approaches and merges them. The proposed model's prediction power for cardiac illness detection is substantially enhanced by using classifiers like random forest models and Gradient Boosting. By optimizing the reproduction's generalizability, recall, accurateness, correctness, and F1-score, the Stacking CV approach ensures consistent and reliable performance across many datasets. The experimental findings show that the created Stacking CV Classifier outperforms the other methods utilized in this study with an accuracy of 98%. More accurate diagnoses of cardiovascular disease may be possible with this method, and it also outperforms the most advanced ML methods when it comes to predicting CVD in its early stages.

articleTitle: Advanced Fuzzy Rule Set-Based Approach for Fetal Heart Rate Detection and Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Fetal heart rate measurement is important in evaluation of fetal well-being and the visible sign of compromise or dysfunction. Congenital heart diseases rank among the main causes of infant mortality and can be identified by means of fetal heart rate monitoring. An effective and reliable method of recognizing and categorizing fetal heart rate is hence important for correct diagnosis and early intervention. The directed research utilizes an improved fuzzy rule set to boost fetal heart rate detection and classification precision. This technique incorporates fuzzy algorithms to adapt to the non-linearity of the fetal cardiotocographic signal as compared to precise methodologies. Some of the difficulties that arise when using FHR analysis include handling of maternal heart rates, power line interference and other biomass signals which tend to complicate the fetal signal. With fuzzy rule sets, this work shall be able to generate better classification between fetal and maternal components for accurate extraction and differentiation of FHR patterns. Moreover, this approach is able to account for uncertainties and temporal changes of the signal and could potentially provide a more robust solution for clinical applications of fetal monitoring and early detection of congenital heart diseases.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Transformations in Content-Based Image Retrieval: Exploring the Visual Geometry Group (VGG16) Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Content-based image retrieval (CBIR) is evolving with new computational paradigms such as deep learning in vision applications viz. visual searches, machine translation, and query-based image retrieval. The deep visual learning with Visual Geometry Group (VGG) Model is one of the support layer-based convolution neural networks (CNN) utilized in multiple machine vision tasks like image segmentation, categorization, and object detection within image recovery systems. A VGG architecture consists of numerous blocks, each having a maximum-pooling layer, bus encoder, and 2D complexity. VGG16 consists of 16 layers having extracting features and learning weights to enhance the system's performance. This highlights the challenge of handling large datasets, compounded by the complexity of the network's architecture and resulting features.

articleTitle: Automated Accident Detection and Reporting System with GPS and GSM Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: A Smart Accident Detection and Reporting System, which seamlessly integrates GPS and GSM technologies to enable real-time accident detection, precise location tracking, and immediate alerts. The system leverages a GPS device to accurately pinpoint accident locations and employs a Global System for Mobile (GSM) module to send instant notification messages, including a link to the accident's location on a Google map, to the nearest hospital and emergency contact. This presentation will delve into the technical aspects of the system design, operation, and the potential it holds for improving emergency response, reducing accident-related fatalities, and enhancing road safety. The innovative integration of GPS and GSM technologies marks a significant advancement in accident reporting systems and is poised to make a substantial impact on the safety of our road networks.

articleTitle: Maximizing Bandwidth Utilization and Multipath Routing for Control Congestion in MANET
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This paper presents a novel Maximize Bandwidth utilization and Multipath Routing for Congestion Control (MBMRCC) scheme designed to address congestion issues in MANETs effectively. The MBMRCC scheme integrates multipath routing with adaptive rate control to enhance data throughput and minimize packet loss. In MBMRCC proposed scheme, multiple paths among sources and destinations are established using for enhance the multipath on demand protocol ability in dynamic network. This Ad hoc On-demand Multipath Distance Vector (AOMDV) routing approach distributes the data load across more than two paths, thereby reducing the congestion on any established path. Concurrently, the data rate control approach is able to handle data transmission rate based on real-time network conditions, such as node mobility, link stability, and current congestion levels. Simulation results demonstrate that the MBMRCC scheme significantly outperforms traditional single-path routing protocol AODV and Multipath routing AOMDV i.e. existing congestion control mechanisms in MANETs. Significant performance metrics such as throughput, packet delivery ratio, overhead and end-to-end delay performance are network favorable. The adaptive nature of the proposed scheme ensures robust performance in highly dynamic and heterogeneous network environments, making it a viable solution for various MANET applications, including disaster recovery, military operations, and mobile social networks. The MBMRCC scheme's ability to efficiently manage network congestion and enhance data transmission reliability underscores its potential to enhances the overall performance of MANET.

articleTitle: Spotlight : Redefining Theatre Application Through AI-Driven Personalization and Community Engagement
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Spotlight, a platform dedicated to the dramatic arts, aims to change spotlight at theatres and redefine the experience at theatres. This research paper aims to depict the evolution of Spotlight by emphasizing on its usage of Kotlin and Android Studio, making use of which it provides user-friendly UI. Spotlight is not only a mobile application, but it uses artificial intelligence (AI) which can generate personalized scripts automatically that are based on preferences, thus, enhancing user experience. Users, by recording and sharing their performances of the scripts, facilitate the community involvement and self-expression channel. What gives Spotlight the main benefit is their interactive community feature, which highlights ratings and supports everyone needs to create a feeling of belonging. This paper illustrates the engineering details of Kotlin, Android Studio, as well as AI integration, and the contributions of these in the development of Spotlight's cutting-edge features. Moreover, it scrutinizes the role played by the rating system in enhancing user interaction and strengthening the friendships. In a nutshell, Spotlight is a game-changing platform that leads towards a lively, fun, and possibly engaging theatre experience for everyone. The user gets a feel of belonging through the ratings, multilingual script generation, or even through other interactive functionalities. The research made was thus a larger application of AI in the performing arts, how scripts can then be transferred to the audience, or how the audience was incorporated in writing the scripts.

articleTitle: IndiTranslate: Bridging Language Barriers in India
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The IndiTranslate project tackles the challenge of communication barriers in India’s multilingual context, which includes 22 official languages and numerous dialects. It proposes areal-time translation system using advanced NLP and machine learning to facilitate seamless translations among Indian languages. With a user-friendly interface, the system ensures accessibility for all users and achieves over 85% accuracy, validated through extensive testing. Its scalable architecture supports cloud deployment for high availability. Future improvements include expanding language coverage, offline translation, context-aware translations, and real-time speech features. IndiTranslate aims to enhance communication, fostering inclusivity and improving access to essential services in India.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Supervised Machine Learning Framework for Diabetes Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Estimates suggest that 578 million people could be affected by diabetes mellitus in 2030, with an estimated 700 million affected by 2045 worldwide. Diabetes mellitus (DM) has impacted many people worldwide, with over 422 million affected and about 1.5 million deaths annually. Given the significant global burden of diabetes mellitus and alarming mortality rates, early diagnosis is crucial. Machine learning (ML) techniques offer promising ways for reliably predicting diabetes. This research proposes a machine-learning framework utilizing the random forest algorithm for accurate diabetes prediction. The proposed framework was built using the Hospital Frankfurt, Germany dataset, which included eight independent variables and one target variable. The proposed framework was evaluated and compared to other existing frameworks based on accuracy and AUC metrics for Area Under Curve. The findings reveal that the proposed framework outperformed the reviewed frameworks in this study, with a 99.39% score of accuracy.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Detection of Depression from EEG Signals Using Linear and Non-Linear Features
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Non-linear, complex, and non-stationary signals are EEGs. Deterioration in brain function is shown in electroencephalogram (EEG) data throughout MDD or despair. Dementia patients and healthy people were classified using linear and non-linear variables, as well as a combination of the two, in this research. All of the data utilized in this research came from freely accessible public sources. There were 30 healthy persons and 34 patients with MDD in the sample. These classifiers were utilized: quadratic discriminant analysis, linear discriminant analysis, radial basis function network, and multi layered perceptron neural network (MLPNN). With the usage of linear features, the alpha power with MLPNN classifier achieved the greatest classification accuracy of 92.58 percent. Using a non-linear feature, RWE and WE both accomplished 90.67% classification accuracy with the RBFN classifier and the LDA classifier, respectively. When using a mix of linear and non-linear features, such as alpha power and RWE with MLPNN and RBFN classifier, the best classification accuracy was 95.3%. The maximum classification accuracy was 95.2%, which was accomplished by combining non-linear characteristics, namely RWE and WE. This was shown in the study as well. Researchers looked examined how various classifiers performed when given either linear or non-linear characteristics, or a mix of the two, as well as their sensitivity and specificity. Alpha power and RWE together had the best classification accuracy (93.33%) among all classifiers tested.

articleTitle: An Improved Chess AI System with Hybrid-Fly Optimization and Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The "Drosophila of Artificial Intelligence (AI)" is a chessboard, since chess was an early and popular subject in AI studies, and the field later expanded to include other games. The majority of the most advanced chess engines relied on more traditional search strategies like as Minimax and Alpha beta prior to the current success of systems that are based on notions from machine learning. The majority of chess engines aren't built to mimic human intuition, but rather to compute as many feasible permutations before making a move. New features in the game demonstrated how AlphaZero used a deep reinforcement learning-based strategy. Training the model with top human games may increase chess engines' intuitive sense for the situation, and our suggested hybrid optimization approach can glean the ideal move. This study addresses the shortcomings of traditional methods of evaluating a chess situation and presents a new model, the Hybridfly-ANN, to achieve the greatest number of legal moves. The suggested technique first determines all legitimate moves that might be made in response to a single opponent move, and then uses the standard mini-max algorithm to determine which move is the most optimum. An important part of this study is the suggested Hybrid Fly optimization approach, which improves the system's performance by fine-tuning the ANN classifier's weights. The effectiveness of the method that has been suggested is assessed using a series of evaluation criteria that includes accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity.

articleTitle: Accessing Visual Information for Divyangjan
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Approximately 1.3 billion people worldwide suffer from a visual impairment. Typically, they must use Braille to read printed materials. However, when the content is not printed in Braille, these individuals have difficulties. Even though there are a lot of electronic reading aids available, the costs remain prohibitive. Therefore, our work suggests a low-cost document reader that uses a webcam to take pictures of printed materials. The Optical Character Recognition (OCR) framework's image-to-text conversion is then used to turn the acquired image into text. Finally, the Text to Speech (TTS) framework's text-to-speech conversion will be used to read the text aloud in speech format. Consequently, a person with a visual impairment can use hearing rather than touch to comprehend printed materials that are not written in Braille. Users may view documents printed in five different languages. The choice of different document sizes is this work's greatest novelty. The system is equipped with a Raspberry Pi, Arduino Uno, NEMA 17 stepper motors, a web camera and speaker. The Raspberry Pi, Arduino Uno, NEMA 17 stepper motors, webcam, and speaker are all part of the system.

articleTitle: Advanced Techniques for Detecting Intrusions Leveraging Ensemble Machine Learning and Feature Reduction Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: As its name implies, intrusion detection is the primary function of intrusion detection systems. Among the many tools used by conventional computer-based systems to guarantee cyber security, this kind of detecting system stands out. When an IDS model uses the input dataset to identify the most relevant characteristics, it may improve detection rates and run quicker. Feature selection is a crucial part of IDs since it allows you to choose the best subsection of structures to use in training your model, which in turn speeds up the process, removes complexity, and maintains or improves system performance. In this research, we provide a strategy that uses attack-specific partitioning of the input dataset. Every subset was thereafter subjected to an information gain filter feature selection procedure. When all of the feature sets from each assault are combined, the best features set is produced. Using the NSL-KDD dataset, researchers were able to validate that the suggested feature selection strategy improved system accuracy while reducing complexity with fewer features. In addition, we compare the effectiveness of several categorization approaches in feature selection. Next, we apply Random Forest and PART to the voting learning algorithm in order to improve its overall performance. Using the end result probability rule yields the greatest outcomes in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Enhancing Facial Emotion Detection for Depression Detection using Image Integration by Hybrid Dataset Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Depression is a critical mental health challenge that impacts millions globally, manifesting through various emotional, cognitive, and behavioural changes. Traditional diagnostic methods often rely on self-reported data and clinical interviews, which may not always capture the refined emotional shifts associated with depression. The proposed research aims to develop a novel approach for depression detection by analysing emotional patterns and expressions using images collected from the interviews and standard data set sources of RAF-DB, FER2013. By applying Machine Learning(ML) techniques, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Haar Cascading, the study builds predictive models that identify depressive symptoms based on emotions that they portray. This emotion-centred approach offers a more objective and sensitive method for early detection of depression, providing a valuable tool for both individuals and healthcare professionals to monitor and address mental health more effectively.

articleTitle: A Secure method of transferring confidential documents by leveraging Zero Trust Principles and Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Ensuring regulatory compliance and maintaining client trust in the legal industry depend on the safe transfer and preservation of sensitive data. Maintaining the safety and security of confidential information is essential in a law business. The suggested concept combines zero-trust concepts with blockchain technology to develop a decentralized application (dApp) that facilitates secure document sharing between clients and law firms. To guarantee the safe transfer of private legal documents, the platform makes use of IPFS for decentralized file storage and MetaMask for authentication. OTP verification, document encryption using cryptographic methods, and MetaMask user authentication are some of its key features. Only authorized users are able to view or manage documents in the DApp thanks to smart contract access management. The requirements for security, immutability, and transparency are maintained by this method.

articleTitle: Twitter Sentiment Analysis Based Classification Model incorporating Multinominal Naive Bayes Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The study is a small-scale effort to categorise positive and negative attitudes from Twitter comments. Social media makes it incredibly simple to disseminate hate speech, racist statements, and comments these days. Various social media sites have begun utilising Natural Language Processing (NLP) to identify and flag remarks that are associated with bigotry and hatred. This project uses a collection of actual tweets from Twitter to perform a sentiment analysis on the platform. There are 200000 observations in the dataset. Stopwords, punctuation, and Twitter user handles are all present in the tweets itself. After pre-processing the data to exclude these undesired features, the tweets are count vectorised and used to train a Naïve Bayes Classifier (NBC), whose performance is assessed using the F1 score, confusion matrix, recall score, along with precision score. The existing method of sentiment analysis includes assumption that the feature in the text are all independent, but in reality it is not so which leads to incorrect sentiment prediction. Along with this it also results Naïve Bayes classifiers failing to detect sarcasm the tweets being slang, Naïve Bayes classifiers fails to classifies abstract complete information from them, and it also fails to adapt well to evolving trends in language. To overcome these limitations a hybrid Naïve Bayes classifiers in the studies and a lot of previous problems have been eliminated. Prior they got 57% accuracy level in results and This paper shows 87% accuracy level for tweets. The assessment conclude with insights into future research directions, emphasizing the need for improving accuracy level.

articleTitle: The Evolution and Impact of Price Comparison Websites: A Technological and Economic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Price comparison websites (PCWs) have become integral to the online shopping experience, enabling consumers to make informed decisions by comparing prices, features, and reviews from multiple retailers. These platforms not only benefit consumers by saving time and money but also influence market competition by increasing pricing transparency and driving businesses to optimize their strategies. This research explores the evolution of PCWs, their technological infrastructure, and their business models. Moreover, it examines their impact on consumer behavior, the challenges they pose for retailers, and the future trends shaping the industry. Through an analysis of current practices, technological innovations, and economic effects, this work highlights the growing importance of PCWs in the global e-commerce ecosystem.

articleTitle: Detection of Pneumonia Using CNN and its Variants
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Severe respiratory infections like pneumonia pose a major global health threat, requiring prompt and precise diagnosis for appropriate treatment. Conventional diagnostic techniques are often subjective and time-consuming due to reliance on radiological expertise. This study leverages deep learning to improve pneumonia detection from chest X- rays, evaluating multiple CNN designs such as ResNet50v2, VGG16, MobileNetV2, CheXNet, InceptionV3, and a customized CNN. Models are trained and tested on a large dataset of labelled chest X-rays, employing preprocessing techniques like data augmentation, scaling, and normalization. Transfer learning optimizes the models where applicable. Performance is assessed using recall, accuracy, precision, and F1-score, alongside ROC curve and confusion matrix analysis. Findings indicate that deep learning models significantly enhance pneumonia detection accuracy, with CheXNet and ResNet50v2 outperforming others. This comparative analysis highlights each model's strengths and weaknesses, advancing the development of reliable, automated diagnostic tools for pneumonia and potentially enabling quicker and more precise clinical decision- making.

articleTitle: Web-Based Career Portal for Efficient Job Search and Recruitment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This research paper focuses on the design, development and implementation of an enhanced Web-based career portal, based on principles of web programming and core Java. The system is designed for three types of users: the job seeker, employer, and administrator. The system shall allow job seekers to carry out various profile and resume management tasks, search for jobs, while enabling employers to publish job openings and manage their corporate profiles with ease.The administrators ensure the integrity of the portal by user registration, posting of jobs, and interaction moderation between seekers and employers. The platform is user-friendly, hence the usage is intuitive and self-explanatory throughout its features. Significant emphasis has been given to security with efficient lines of communication so as to protect confidentiality for users, thereby streamlining the recruitment process.It covers the technical architecture, functionality, and design of the user experience of the Career Portal that is going to revolutionize modern job search methods by improving the match between the employer and job seeker. This should improve career prospects and contribute on a more general basis to economic growth.

articleTitle: Feature Selection for Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem Algorithm Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The practical application of feature selection is evident in the machine learning domain. The purpose of a learning activity is to identify a mapping of features to output that generalizes the data. Therefore, identifying significant features is an utmost requirement. Feature selection approaches provide a means to decrease computational time, enhance predictive accuracy, and facilitate a deeper comprehension of the underlying data. This work presents an overview of feature selection methodologies documented in the literature. We additionally apply feature selection techniques to a dataset containing capacitated vehicle routing problem instances features and algorithm performance, designed to facilitate algorithm selection. Random forest which is an embedded method of feature selection is used which explicitly provides importance of each attribute for the underlying classification task.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Enhancing the Efficiency of Convolutional Neural Networks through Quantization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: A new kind of image categorisation technology, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have shown themselves capable of astounding accuracy across a range of uses. Problems arise, however, when dealing with real-time applications in settings where resources are limited due to their computational complexity and resource needs. An extensive investigation on how to make convolutional neural networks (CNNs) better at picture classification is detailed in this work. We explore several optimization techniques, including network pruning, quantization, and the deployment of lightweight architectures such as MobileNet and SqueezeNet. Additionally, we investigate the impact of advanced training strategies like transfer learning and data augmentation on model performance. We show, by means of comprehensive tests, that our suggested approaches considerably reduce the memory footprint and computational cost of CNNs while preserving or even enhancing classification accuracy. Our findings provide valuable insights for deploying efficient CNN models in practical scenarios, paving the way for more accessible and scalable image classification solutions.

articleTitle: Innovative Data Replication Techniques for Effective Latency Reduction in Mobile Edge Computing and IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Applications like smart cities, driverless vehicles, healthcare, and industrial automation are made possible by the revolutionary grouping of the IoT and MEC. Problems with data management, especially with lowering latency for real-time applications, plague these systems. System efficiency, operational dependability, and user experience can all take a hit when data transmission delays occur. Copying and distributing data over numerous servers or edge nodes enables faster access to information, and novel data replication techniques are being developed to meet this. Because of resource limitations, unpredictable user requests, and changing network circumstances, traditional data replication approaches struggle in the distributed and dynamic settings of MEC and the Internet of Things (IoT). Intelligent data placement algorithms, network-aware replication, and demand-based dynamic replication are examples of advanced approaches. By decreasing latency and avoiding the need for repeated calls to the central cloud, these strategies guarantee that data is always available at the proper location and time. Particularly for latency-sensitive applications like augmented reality, autonomous vehicles, and telemedicine, this paper assesses these methods using simulations and case studies from real-world MEC and IoT deployments, showing that they can considerably decrease latency, improve system responsiveness, and increase data availability. Results show that MEC and IoT data management may be enhanced in terms of performance, scalability, and user happiness, which advances the state of the art.

articleTitle: Short-term load forecasting using LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: One of the most crucial elements for power system operators is short-term load forecasting (STLF), enabling efficient resource allocation and grid stability. Accurate short-term load forecasting predicts the electrical load in small time horizons, that start from hours up to days with data based on history and real-time data. This project utilises LSTM networks in predicting power load at Godishala Substation by having features that include voltage, current, temperature, and humidity besides the time-related attributes. The results are compared using mean absolute error and root mean squared error. The outcomes show that the LSTM model outperforms GRU throughout the experiment and delivers enhanced predictive accuracy. GUI is integrated into the system to allow users to input data directly for real-time load forecasts, hence improving the practical usability of the system. This study supports the LSTM model’s efficacy for STLF decision-making in operational tasks.

articleTitle: Efficient Implementation of GF-CNN for Advanced Traffic Sign Recognition in Transportation Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Traffic violations cause accidents nowadays. Traffic accidents sometimes result from disobedience of traffic signs owing to low sight, inadequate light, and lack of expertise. ADAS and ITS are the only solutions to prevent accidents. ADAS detects traffic signs and ITS recognizes images for various transport applications. ADAS and ITS can detect minor traffic signs and provide driving information to guarantee road user safety. A key function of ADAS is to inform drivers and traffic signs. One research used traffic sign detection to aid vehicle navigation and driving assistance. Overfitting in the current technique reduces traffic sign detection performance. For image analysis, this study employs Gabor filter, Grey Level Co-occurrence Matrix, and Local Optimal Oriented Pattern feature extraction approaches. Our multi-threshold Otsu approach and cuckoo search method aid in segmentation. The SVM classifier performs traffic sign detection. The hybrid feature extraction approach enhances traffic sign identification by exploring the form, color, and texture of the board. Research used an enhanced CNN to recognize traffic signs. Current hybrid feature extraction approach achieves 98.97% accuracy in classifying six traffic signs, however processing time is high for multi-operations. To categorize 10 traffic signs with 99.1% accuracy, an enhanced CNN is presented.

articleTitle: Harnessing AI in Prisons: Balancing Security, Efficiency, and Ethical Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in prison systems offers transformative potential for enhancing security, streamlining operations, and improving inmate rehabilitation. AI-driven surveillance systems provide real-time monitoring and anomaly detection, while predictive models help preempt incidents. Personalized rehabilitation programs powered by AI improve inmates' reintegration prospects. However, deploying AI in prisons raises significant ethical, privacy, and fairness concerns. This paper examines AI's multifaceted role in prison systems, addressing its benefits and challenges. By proposing a comprehensive technical framework, the study aims to guide policymakers, technologists, and administrators in implementing ethical and effective AI solutions in prison management.

articleTitle: Social Media Emotion Analysis Using ML
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Social media platforms have come to be utilized as discussions for sharing ideas, emotions, and thoughts. This has created a huge data set that may be analyzed. Utilizing machine learning (ML) methods, in particular natural language processing (natural language processing), offers hitherto unseen possibilities for large-scale user emotion understanding and response. With an emphasis on emotion task classification, this research investigates the use of machine learning (ML) algorithms for internet-based emotion analysis. We examine the efficacy of several machine learning (ML) models in precisely categorizing emotions expressed in social media postings, including recurrent neural networks (RNNs), convolutional neural networks (CNNs), and ensemble techniques like random forests and gradient boosting machines. To increase the accuracy of emotion classification, we also go over the significance of feature engineering, text preparation methods, and the incorporation of domain-specific lexicons and embedded data.

articleTitle: Robust Twitter Spam Detection Through Ensemble Learning and Optimal Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Specifically, it delves into various ensemble learning techniques utilized for enhancing choosing features in the context of detecting junk on Instagram. Choosing the right features A further crucial stage in the process is choosing features that are both extremely useful and minimally associated with each other in order to enhance the categorization rate. This work provides a summary of various methods for selecting features, including filter, wrapper, and embedded approaches, along with unsupervised approaches. Features can be ranked through various approaches to choice such as chi-square, information gain, and random forest. This section delves into the concept of combining multiple feature selectors to enhance the reliability of outcomes and improve the accuracy of alternatives. The research team specifically concentrate on both uniform and diverse ensemble techniques applied in the context of feature selection. The present investigation of spam detection on Twitter employs user and tweet content characteristics such as age, follower count, and the presence of hashtags and URLs as streamlined features. Four categorization algorithms Support Vector Machines, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, and Random Forest—were implemented, with Random Forest yielding the highest detection accuracy. The results indicate that using ensemble feature selection improves the effectiveness of machine learning models in identifying spam.

articleTitle: The Hexagonal Hierarchical Broad Telecommunication Length Protocol's (Hexa-Htbtdp) Scalability in Wsn-Iot Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Clustering applications for WSN-IoT must prioritize energy efficiency. It is not feasible to evaluate the lifespan of a network in the absence of clustering or variation. In order to create clustering algorithms that consume less energy, cluster head selection models have been used. It is a huge undertaking to simulate a whole WSN-IoT cluster. In this paper, we examine the dependability of the clustering mechanism and the durability of the network. Most of the research on energy-efficient clustering algorithms has been done in academic journals. To comprehend the energy efficiency of a sensor network, one must be aware of its initial energy sources, the quantity of data-collecting nodes, and the network field. Live node metrics, network durability, stability, and instability are performance indicators. More characteristics could be included in a comprehensive energy-efficient clustering model. A wide range of sensor nodes are used to investigate heterogeneous clustering in networks of varying sizes and kinds. In this study, we examine the scalability and heterogeneity of WSN-IoT clustering. Lifespan sub-periods display the living metrics used to assess energy-efficient clustering methods. Our first area of interest will be the two-level heterogeneity component of cluster head selection. A new protocol for heterogeneous hexagonal wide transmission distance (HEXA-HTBTDP). Different from a three-level protocol, which may have either advanced or super advanced nodes, a two-level heterogeneous protocol can have either normal or advanced nodes. By outperforming HEXA-SEP by 69.34% and HEXA-EEHC by 38.47% in terms of stability period, the suggested method’s algorithm proves to be very efficient. The proposed method has an 85% longer stability period and a 45.67% of longer lifespan than other Models.

articleTitle: Automated Legal Decision Support System for Indian Army
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Legal processes within the military tend to be complex, known for strict compliance with legal regulations. Timeliness, accuracy, and consistency in legal procedures are crucial in the military to uphold the law and justice. Conventional legal proceedings can be lengthy and susceptible to mistakes because they are done manually. This paper presents an Automated Legal Decision Support System created for the military, which uses Natural Language Processing and Machine Learning to manage legal documents, produce charge sheets, and suggest appropriate actions. The goal of the system is to improve the effectiveness and precision of legal decision-making while upholding procedural accuracy. This paper delves into the system’s architecture, underlying algorithms, and its application through a case study involving a military legal scenario. The ethical and technical challenges, especially those related to military-specific requirements, are also discussed.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Coconut Palm Leaflet Diseases using Convolutional Neural Networks based Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In tropical regions, coconut palms are an essential part of the economy and daily life, providing food, oil, and many other products. However, their health and productivity can be affected by various diseases. Early and precise disease identification is essential for the management and prevention of many diseases. Leaflet diseases in coconut plants are those that impact individual leaflets, or leaf segments, on the fronds of coconut palms. Drying leaflets in coconut tree leaves can result from a variety of factors, including biotic (living organisms) and abiotic (environmental or non-living) impacts. In coconut trees, chlorosis, or the yellowing of the leaves, is a prevalent issue that can be caused by some factors. The CNN model is trained on a sizable set of high-resolution images of both healthy and diseased coconut leaves. Each disease's unique characteristics and patterns are automatically acquired with the aid of the deep learning architecture, enabling accurate categorization. Using an additional set of annotated photos of coconut tree leaves, the CNN model is assessed with remarkable accuracy in identifying illnesses. Comparing the system to traditional manual diagnosis procedures demonstrates the technology's efficacy and potential for early disease identification. Using this strategy raises the algorithm's accuracy to 95%

articleTitle: Generative AI in battling Fraud
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Generative AI, a subset of artificial intelligence (AI) that comprises models such as GANs (Generative Adversarial Networks) and large language models (LLMs), has demonstrated enormous promise in a variety of domains, including picture generation and language translation. Recently, its use in fraud detection and prevention has emerged as a viable area. Fraud, including financial fraud, identity theft, and cybercrime, costs billions of dollars each year, and standard detection systems are restricted by their inability to foresee new fraud trends. Generative AI takes a novel approach to this problem, improving fraud detection systems using anomaly detection, predictive modelling, and reinforcement learning. This paper analyses Generative AI in battling different fraud.

articleTitle: Cybersecurity Strategies for Intrusion Detection in Smart Grid Generation and Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In order to keep the electric power system running smoothly and reliably, it is constantly monitored and controlled by an intelligent cyber layer that consists of data processing algorithms and a wide network of sensors. Cyberattacks on this data processing and collecting system might halt operations and have catastrophic physical consequences like system breakdowns. Among the many attack methods that are often used, false data injection attacks (FDIA) stand out. To avoid detection by the condition estimator's inherent anomaly detection mechanisms, an attacker tries to trick the grid's foundation control system into producing disturbances. On top of that, there are major issues with customer-end security. For instance, criminals might intercept, alter, or replay wireless transmissions of power consumption signals sent by consumers to their utility provider. The smart grid is therefore beset by privacy and security issues. Protecting the vital infrastructure of the electricity system against cyberattacks is one of the goals of this study. The contribution may be broken down into three parts, as mentioned before. The smart grid design and technological advancements brought forth by digitization are the topics of the thesis. Next, it delves into the security issues surrounding the smart grid's two most important cyber-physical systems: the infrastructure serving end users and the generating and transmission side.

articleTitle: CodeGuardian: Improving Software Quality with Automated CI-Driven Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: CodeGuardian is an advanced static code analyzer designed with much to improve the processes of software development. This is by automating performance and quality of code intelligence. A tool of this nature typically has an intuitive interface that works in combination with a large backend to drive a complete solution for managing code efficiently. Core features include project management, static code analysis, smooth integration of the continuous integration/ continuous deployment pipeline, and storage of extensive analysis results. In the backend, it can be used with several static analysis tools to scan code for any issues, and is able to notify users about key activities and findings. The front end should be an intuitive, responsive user interface that shall support easier project management. This view of extended analysis reports provides clear visualizations so that the monitoring of code quality trends becomes much easier.

articleTitle: Automated Detection of Tomato Leaf Disease Using Convolutional Neural Networks: Evaluation of GoogLeNet, AlexNet, and Custom CNN Architectures
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Tomato leaf diseases are major global agricultural productivity barriers. It is crucial to diagnose infections early and accurately in order to successfully control them and boost agricultural productivity. This study focuses on automated disease prediction of tomato leaves using convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The study assessed three widely used CNN architectures: GoogLeNet, AlexNet, and a custom-built CNN using an extensive dataset of images of tomato leaves. The results indicate that CNN based methods produce encouraging outcomes and the GoogLeNet architecture obtains the maximum accuracy of 92%. This means deep learning methods may be used to successfully identify tomato plant diseases. This can be portrayed as the application of CNNs in solving realworld issues in agriculture.

articleTitle: Optimizing Heart Disease Diagnosis with Machine Learning Analysis of Numerical Figures
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: A global pandemic of heart illness is confronting modern medicine. Worldwide, life expectancy has risen and the causes of death from cardiovascular disease have shifted in the new millennium. Numerous men and women succumb to heart disease during this time. The annual mortality toll from cardiovascular disease is around 17.9 million, or 31% of the total. Since cardiac ailments may have significant consequences, early detection is of the utmost importance. Despite the availability of heart illness forecasting tools and procedures, there is a dearth of effective disease detection models. We use machine learning to construct neural networks for healthcare purposes. In order to help doctors, provide patients high-quality care, these self-learning networks estimate tomography revisions with X-rays and CT photographs. Clinical decision support systems, automated billing, and treatment suggestions are just a few potential applications of ml in healthcare. The vast amounts of information generated by body area networks make machine learning an absolute need for health data classification. We want to find and forecast binary risk factors for cardiovascular disease in this study. Various ML apps provide the six ML classifications methods. It is anticipated that the implementation of the GBC that is suggested will result in the most favorable effects that are achievable on the level that is conceivable. The approach that has been presented is superior to the research that has been conducted in the past since it has an accuracy rating of 97% and a ROC-AUC efficiency of 98%. Both of these figures indicate that the technique is accurate. This is due to the fact that it has demonstrated that it has accomplished these outcomes.

articleTitle: IOT Devices and Control Systems Working Together to Improve Security
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) facilitates seamless integration and interoperability among various networks, devices, technologies, and products by placing emphasis on control schemas. End-users require uninterrupted and precise connectivity, irrespective of the integration node (e.g., tablet, laptop, television, smartphone, or other internet-connected device). Intelligent IoT devices have the capability to function as flexible connections with ever-changing configurations, enabling timely reactions and potentially worldwide reach.In response to the urgent requirement for secure real-time control operations, this research paper introduces a methodology that integrates intelligent Internet of Things (IoT) system functionalities with power system interfaces. The proposed methodology integrates computing, cryptography, signal/image processing, and communication networks to facilitate authentication and authorization operations via gateways and terminals. This results in a real-time performance environment that is not only more secure but also more adaptable and robust in comparison to conventional approaches. Moreover, the researchers delineate a framework for the Internet of Things that is applicable to power system inputs in administrative, industrial, transportation, and comprehensive monitoring environments.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Applications in Predictive Maintenance for Sustainable Logistics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The Synthetic intelligence (AI) software in Predictive Maintenance (PdM) transforms manufacturing, imparting solutions to lessen protection charges and promote sustainable logistics. By forecasting system failures, PdM allows maintenance to be scheduled proactively, keeping off the constraints of reactive and preventive techniques. This paper presents a sensible PdM version using statistics cleansing, normalization, most reliable feature selection, and prediction community selection-making. A hybrid Jaya and Sea Lion Optimization (SLnO) set of rules complements function selection, whilst an aid vector machine (SVM) aids in prediction community selection. Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), optimized utilizing J-SLnO, carry out the very last predictions. The version is confirmed using plane engine and lithium-ion battery datasets, showcasing improved preservation planning and sustainability accuracy.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Powered E-Voting: A Pathway to SDG 16 Transparent and Inclusive Elections
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Transparency, security, and access to electoral systems across the world constitute the main problems that create challenges for achievement under Sustainable Development Goal 16's vision of inclusive institutions. This paper investigates the possibility of blockchain-based electronic voting systems to meet the challenges of transparency, verifiability, and access towards conducting elections. To this end, we adopted a mixed-methods approach comprising a comprehensive literature review, conducting case studies based on the blockchain voting pilots, and interviewing election officials as well as blockchain developers. Our findings established that blockchain-based e-voting can enhance significantly electoral integrity with immutable record-keeping, end-to-end verifiability, and easier accessibility to remote and disabled voters. Nevertheless, challenges include the problem of scalability, the digital divide, and voter privacy concerns. Robust identity verification systems and user-friendly interfaces should be critical success factors in implementation. From the analysis, we conclude that even though blockchain e-voting shows promise in acceleration toward the achievement of SDG 16 goals, its effective deployment would require a phased approach—starting with small-scale elections with incremental scaling up. The present study contributes to the growing literature on digital democracy and provides practical guidelines for policymakers and election authorities seeking to address blockchain in electoral processes.

articleTitle: SecurAI: Leveraging Edge Computing and Large Language Models for Intelligent Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The SecurAI LLM-based surveillance system leverages advanced AI models to enhance real-time threat detection and decision-making in complex environments. It achieves high accuracy, reduces false positives, and integrates edge computing for low-latency processing. Claude 3 excels in handling large data contexts, providing superior performance in long-term surveillance. The system also ensures ethical compliance with privacy regulations, making it ideal for public and sensitive spaces. Future enhancements focus on improving multimodal capabilities, contextual memory, and expanding edge device adaptability for more efficient and responsible surveillance.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Insights for Early Breast Cancer Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Breast Cancer (BC) became a major disease among women in the current era. For treatment, survival and to decrease mortality rate detection of disease at early stages plays a significant role. Machine learning (ML), big data analysis, Internet of Things (IoT) and artificial intelligence (AI) are providing better and accurate solutions for early diagnosis of multiple sectors like education, health, military, weather, share market etc. In this work, ML based classifications were used to analysis and predictions. Multiple ML algorithms like J48, Random Tree (RT) and Random Forest (RF) has been used for predictive results. For analysis and predictions, an open dataset has been accessed for this work. And, data pre-processing, normalization has been applied before executing the model. Multiple selection technique has applied in this work to identify and prediction of breast cancer (BC). Two important attributes such as mps (menopausal status) and T_grade (tumor grades) from dataset has been opted to predictions. In this work the accuracy has calculated with results like, FP rate, recall, precision and F-measure. Also, correct and incorrect instances of dataset have been calculated. Perspectives of ML are highlighted to early identification of BC. The results showed that these models can be helpful to early detect the BC and can reduce the mortality rate.

articleTitle: Weld Shop Pro: Real-World Welding Workshop Application Using Micro services
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: "Weld Shop Pro" which aims at developing an online ordering and notification system for a real-world welding shop. Leveraging the power of micro services architecture, the back end of the system is built using Spring Boot, while the front end is developed using React js and DynamoDB database. Through an intuitive web interface, users can easily place orders for welding services, providing detailed specifications and requirements. Upon order placement, the system automatically generates an invoice to the user, confirming the order details and ensuring transparency throughout the process. Customers receive timely updates on the progress and status of their orders, enhancing their overall experience. By incorporating cutting-edge technologies, Weld Shop Pro streamlines the ordering process, improves customer satisfaction, and boosts operational efficiency for the welding shop. This innovative solution enables the welding shop to manage orders seamlessly and efficiently, reducing manual efforts and errors while maximizing productivity. This application also includes payment gateway, data analysis reports, making this interface very easy to use.

articleTitle: Improving Diabetes Prediction Accuracy Using Wb-Smote for Imbalanced Datasets
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Serious morbidity and early death are consequences of diabetes, a worldwide disease. Several organs are damaged by it, including the kidneys, heart arteries, eyes, and eyeballs, which leads to a rise in yearly death rates. To tackle this tendency head-on, we urgently need an advanced automated prediction system that can identify illnesses early. Producing a medical administrative model that can reliably foretell diseases via the use of ML methods is the primary goal of this research. Improving decision-making skills, transparency, and accuracy are just a few of the benefits of using computer-based algorithms. An very accurate model for predicting the likelihood of acquiring diabetes is the goal of the research. For better preprocessing methods and to fix imbalanced data, the WB-SMOTE method was created. To address datasets with class imbalances, the WB-SMOTE approach was developed independently. We include the Borderline SMOTE methodology, which chooses the oversampling of each minority dataset according to pre-set weights, to improve the algorithm. Our method handles common minority concerns and gives border points more weight than noise points while creating synthetic data. The impoverished minority class is strengthened by the resulting paradigm. We must first normalize the minority class. After that, the input dataset is supplemented with synthetic data that is created using boundary points.

articleTitle: Opinion Mining and Sentiment Analysis in Legal AI Research
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005, is a critical legislative measure in India aimed at addressing and mitigating domestic abuse against women. This paper employs Artificial Intelligence (AI) methodologies, specifically opinion mining and sentiment analysis, to analyze the implementation of this Act with a particular focus on Women Protection Officers in Mumbai City. By extracting and interpreting data from research papers, news articles, and official reports, this study identifies key themes, sentiments, and challenges associated with the Act's execution. The analysis reveals significant implementation challenges, the critical role of Protection Officers, and mixed sentiments toward the effectiveness of the Act. The findings highlight the need for enhanced training programs, better resource allocation, and advanced analytical techniques to improve the Act's implementation. This AI-driven approach provides valuable insights and data-driven recommendations to policymakers and practitioners, aiming to enhance the support system for domestic violence victims and ensure the Act's objectives are met more effectively.

articleTitle: Utilizing Empirical Mode Decomposition and Deep Learning Procedures for The Detection and Analysis of Epilepsy Disorders
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In this the establish and diagnose of the neural illness called epilepsy with the application of the deep learning approach. This is achieved by making a clear distinction between the focal EEG information and the nonfocal EEG data. In relation to this particular study endeavour, the process of identifying epilepsy sickness through the implementation of soft computing techniques is described. The components of the suggested method are feature extraction and classification that utilizes decomposition in time-scale signal as well as diagnosis. To achieve the EMD, the electroencephalogram (EEG) signal is decomposed into 6 IMF sub-bands. Each of the calculated exterior fundamental topographies of the deconstructed IMF sub bands is then fed through the suggested Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) architecture together with the quantities of each IMF sub band to be accomplished and more confidential. This process is done continuously until the right classification is made is made. It is worth stressing that the CNN classifier is used to solve the problem of focal or non-focal classification of the collected electroencephalogram (EEG) data. Last but not the least, the focal indication is categorized as moderate situation or severe case based on the strategy suggested in this research using CNN architecture.

articleTitle: Advanced Deep Learning Models For Automated Detection Of Cardiac Arrhythmia And Atrial Fibrillation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Biomedical signals provide valuable data on the activities of many bodily systems. Biomedical signals are often non-stationary and exhibit non-linear behaviour. Hence, it is rather challenging to get useful data from these signals alone by observation in the temporal domain. Because of this, signal processing methods are used to extract crucial aspects from these signals in order to diagnose various illnesses. Automated methods that do not need human intervention and have a high rate of anomaly detection may help doctors with the diagnosis and treatment of a variety of ailments. Back in the day, machine learning was the go-to approach for bio signal analysis. Deep learning algorithms are currently being developed. Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals indicate that the ANS, which regulates the heart's regular rhythm, is in a state of active regulation. This ECG signal is non-stationary and non-linear, much like any other bio signal. An electrocardiogram (ECG) may reveal symptoms of a number of illnesses. There were significant variations in the examined models' accuracy, recall, precision, and F1 score, and CNN 1-RNN, CNN 1-LSTM, and CNN 1-GRU all performed differently. While CNN 2-RNN and CNN2-LSTM models showed clear advantages and disadvantages, CNN2-GRU showed a more even distribution of the two. The CNN7 Layer model nevertheless managed to show impressive results, even with these modifications. On the other hand, CNN 7-LSTM comes out as the most effective approach, with impressive results: 93.5% accuracy.

articleTitle: Optimizing IoT Cluster Formation and Path Selection Using Fuzzy Rules and Metaheuristic Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Internet of Things has emerged as a vital technology that connects a variety of devices to enable the seamless exchange and processing of data. Nevertheless, the extensive and diverse character of IoT environments presents substantial security challenges, requiring the implementation of security mechanisms that are both efficient and robust. This paper suggests a novel method for improving the security and performance of IoT by combining Hybrid Gravitational Search Algorithm Optimisation (HGSAO) with Fuzzy Logic-based Secure Cluster Formation. The three-tier architecture that has been developed for this purpose includes mutual authentication, secure cluster formation, and optimal path selection. The methodology guarantees an optimal equilibrium between security and performance by reducing computational complexity and energy consumption. The efficacy of the proposed system in the secure and efficient management of IoT networks is underscored by its superior packet delivery ratio and throughput in comparison to existing methods.

articleTitle: The impact of digitizing India's cultural heritage on innovation and the socioeconomic front
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: India's rich historical history must be preserved and promoted through digitization in order to spur innovation and socioeconomic advancement. Monuments and cultural places have great historical and sentimental value, but they are also susceptible to human activity, environmental deterioration, and climate change. Archiving these priceless resources through digitization ensures their preservation and improves accessibility for public and scholarly usage. Understanding the digitalization processes of cultural heritage sites and their effects on India's socioeconomic circumstances and academic progress are the goals of this project. The results of a thorough literature study show that digitization protects monuments and artifacts by decreasing physical handling, facilitating remote access to qualified experts, and speeding up data retrieval. Furthermore, digital preservation encourages academic research and technical advancement in addition to protecting priceless cultural assets. As modernized techniques enable stable industrial development and contribute to the country's wider academic and economic landscape, the study emphasizes how important digitizing cultural assets is for the tourism industry's long-term prosperity.

articleTitle: Optimized Cross-Layer Cross-Domain Routing for Cluster-Based Dense Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: One of the most pressing issues in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) is finding a way to extend the life of the networks. In order to save the limited energy assets of Wireless Sensors Network, it is essential to model efficient approaches. The use of cross-layer procedures, which aim to optimize routing while also increasing the lifespan of the network, is a solution to these problems. In this paper, we provide a novel clustering-based Cross-Layer Cross-Domain Forwarding model. An innovative cross-layer cross-domain route methodology is used to discuss and improve a cluster-based heavy wireless network of sensors. To improve the functionality of complex wireless sensors, we presented a new hybrid method that combines elements of the Gray Wolf and Whale Optimize Algorithms. In the outcomes section, we compare the suggested model's performance to that of six additional typical models; we also look at the life span of the entire network as a whole and analyse the alive nodes for typical, developed, and absolutely advanced nodes in three separate test cases that vary in cluster size. Results for network lifetime and alive nodes assessment are better with the suggested technique compared to the current method. The suggested Adaptive Weighted Whale Optimization Algorithm (AW-WOA) consistently exceeds the other approaches, with an accuracy of 95% Grey Wolf Optimization (GWO), Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA), and Bat Search Optimization (BSO). This is the case when compared to the alternative methods. On the other hand, AW-WOA retains outstanding outcomes, displaying improved stability and efficacy in optimisation throughout all phases, while all other approaches see a drop in accuracy with time.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security with a Decentralized Intrusion Detection System for Sensor and Control Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: There have been several incidents of security violations with regard to the power system network in recent years. In light of this, since operation of the AGC system involves extensive use of communication technologies, there is a high likelihood of system failure if this aspect is compromised. For instance, the impostors may interfere with the announcement network of the bequest network whereby the delegation and information convenience attacks may be effective and have capability of manipulating the telemetered measures such as the wide-area sensor quantities; or the control signals. While there is significant research carried out on AGC security, previous researches have specified the detection of intrusions in the sensor capacities although, more importance has not been placed on evaluating the competency of numerous kinds of outbreaks to the controller signals. Accordingly, the following article discusses a decentralized IDS at the same time to find data incongruities in the sensor dimension and the control signals. The IDS is implemented using a new classifier called CDEL algorithm. The tentative aspect of the CDEL is shown by the ensemble principle which uses the working capability of the SVM and K means clustering model. Based on the experimental results, it is clear that the proposed CDEL is superior to all other related state-of-art ML methods.

articleTitle: Securing Against Cooperative Attacks: A Smart Extenuation Approach for Enhanced Protection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Smart cities and medical IoT were implemented via large-scale IoT end device implementation. Develop a smart city/medical IoT communication paradigm combining IoT and mobile ad-hoc platforms. The increased use of IoT devices in intelligent settings has caused QoS and safety challenges. The suggested Secure and Smart Extenuation Approach to Leverage Protection against Cooperative assaults (SECURE-SEAL) assesses causes of disruption in the IoT ecosystem caused by cooperative assaults at edge nodes. In the IoT network, coordinated attacks include several nodes collaborating to carry out an attack. The current action strategy against coordinated assaults is not very specific. Fuzzy logic is used to provide a trustworthy environment for reducing security threats in intelligent cities and medical IoT. A trustworthy environment quickly identifies adversaries and prevents combined assaults. Network calculations may be provided by nearby edge servers in edge computing. In this way, the time to contact the cloud server may be reduced. Easy SEAL is a fuzzy-based strategy to prevent and remove rogue nodes within the IoT ecosystem. The discovered nodes will be re-examined to validate their assaulting nature. The recommended genuine environment has been shown to operate successfully in malicious environments. The proposed work has a great success in minimizing coordinated attacks (almost 90%).

articleTitle: Tiny Tech Big Impact: Harnessing Nanotechnology for Cleaner Air
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Nanotechnology has emerged as a revolutionary tool in the pursuit of cleaner air, offering innovative solutions that go beyond the limitations of traditional air purification methods This paper explores clarifications of a multitude of nanotechnology applications in air quality systems, including nanomaterials and nanoparticles' synthesis and their inclusion in air filters, catalytic converters, and pollution sensors The core idea is the utilization of nano-tech solutions to form the materials with a 100% rate of efficiency by capturing and neutralizing the wide range of gaseous pollutants and airborne contagions by using highly active devices. Thus, the pollution masters are the following - particulate matter, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), and gases such as oxides of nitrogen (NOx). and carbon monoxide (CO). The paper furthers the investigation on the application of the efficiency of nanocatalysts in pollutant filters, along with one technique of nanocatalysts. Some of the topics considered the utilization of nanocatalysts to augment catalytic converter efficiency, thus, the vehicle and factory emissions are lowered and further investigated the idea of integrating nanotechnology into the pollution sensors, and establishing of devices as it facilitates real-time air monitoring is stressed in the emphasis section.
