While the paper is positively acclaimed for the benefits of nanotechnology, the associated challenges are also discussed.Scenarios like scalability, manufacturing costs, and possible ecotoxicological effects are thoroughly discussed. The majorities are asserting that nanotechnology is the way to go for air quality solutions, but we must think about the considerable long-term effects and we must have the courage to do it. This piece of research emphasizes the essential role of nanotechnology in promoting environmental sustainability, thus, it underscores the importance of responsible development in the process of using nanotechnology to make a sustainable world in which a healthy future is inevitable.

articleTitle: Cloud-Driven AI: Enhancing Machine Learning Performance Through Distributed Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The exponential data volume and complexity of Machine Learning (ML) algorithms has resulted in an increase in computational limitations, which affects artificial intelligence [AI]. This research seeks to establish whether cloud-based distributed computing can effectively address these limitations and improve the performance of ML. Our approach is a new architecture that deploys the computing load over a cloud framework in order to distribute and process in parallel some of the computational majorities of learning algorithms. To further enhance the application’s efficiency of processing the circuit data, a combination of adaptive resource allocation techniques, data partitioning strategies, and a new synchronization protocol has been proposed and implemented. This framework was assessed with deep neural networks, random forests, gradient-boosting machines to different datasets, and complex tasks. Focusing on the obtained results, it becomes possible to state that the proposed methods yield up to 87% improvement in the training speed and 5–12% increase in the accuracy of the models compared to the traditional implementations in single nodes. Moreover, our approach proved its capability of scalability did not degrade the performance and achieved near-linear speedup throughout the distributed nodes of up to 1000. These results propose that cloud-based AI can significantly reduce time to on-ramp for training numerous models on larger datasets. In light of this, distributed computing in the cloud offers a way to meet the computational demands of today’s AI applications while opening the door to new advancements in ML throughout different domains.

articleTitle: Advanced Techniques in Prompt Engineering for Large Language Models: A Comprehensive Study
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Prompt engineering is emerging as a pivotal approach to enhance the efficiency and versatility of large language models (LLMs) like GPT-4. This paper provides a comprehensive survey of key techniques in prompt engineering, highlighting foundational methods and advanced strategies. One-shot prompting, a basic yet impactful technique, involves supplying the model with a single example to guide its responses. In contrast, Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting encourages the model to generate intermediate reasoning steps, significantly improving its problem-solving abilities. Self-Consistency, an advanced strategy, involves generating multiple potential responses and selecting the most coherent one, thereby increasing the reliability of outputs. The transformative potential of these techniques is showcased through various applications in education, content creation, and programming. In education, prompt engineering can personalize learning experiences and provide tailored feedback to students. Content creation benefits from enhanced creativity and coherence in generated text, aiding writers and marketers. In programming, LLMs assist in code generation and debugging, streamlining the development process. This paper not only outlines the methodologies and their practical applications but also proposes future research directions to further refine and expand the capabilities of prompt engineering. By understanding and leveraging these techniques, practitioners can significantly optimize the performance and adaptability of LLMs across diverse domains. This framework aims to foster innovation and efficiency, laying the groundwork for future advancements in AI-driven technologies.

articleTitle: Survey and Perspectives on Deep Learning Approaches for Health Recommender system
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In Today’s world digital health record is essential feature for modern digital era and the continual addition of new electronic devices, including mobile electronics devices, wearable devices, and Electronic health records, which generates vast amounts of data. This vast amount of data must be individual analyzed in health recommendation system for tailored analysis for each patient. The proposed article focused on different approaches used for a comprehensive framework for an individualized tailored health recommendation system. To achieve this various techniques of artificial intelligence and Deep learning are studied. The Health Recommendation System (HRS) is now a vital component of medical care practice. Effective healthcare networks are therefore essential for the procedures involved in determining medical decisions. The HRS is rapidly growing as a healthcare service delivery mechanism, using advanced Artificial intelligence and Deep learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Analysis of Security Breach using IoT Devices in Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The fuse on a rapid surging of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has germinated smart cities, underscoring a new age of connection and perceptiveness in urban infrastructures. On the one hand, this technological enhancement brings out significant security issues for all the IoT devices, including the threat of data breaches. This research investigates the security breaches concerning the Internet of Things devices in smart cities with the prime aim of analyzing the vulnerabilities, potential threats as well as the implication to the ’smart cities’ security infrastructure. The study proposes a holistic assessment of challenges stemming from security breaches in smart city ecosystems. Through ana- lyzing the real-world scenarios and practicing effective mitigation strategies, the research underpins the substantial significance of having IoT device as an instrument to safeguard the smart city infrastructure integrity and reliability. Through the lens of an extensive review of the security breaches that occur from instances of IoT devices within the surroundings of smart cities, this research supplies indispensable viewpoints of the current debate on the security of smart cities. From the synopsis of the evidence coming from numerous research papers with mention of domains such as cyber security, urban planning, and technology implementation, in particular, they could highlight the necessity of not only strong but also solid cybersecurity measures in the digital age. Therefore, this research paper which is entirely based on the growing issues of IoT device security breaches in smart cities can be seen as a pioneering one with the aim of eventually setting up a foundation for better protection of the urban area from further occurrences related to growing technological complications.

articleTitle: Automatic Number Plate Detection using Deep Learning and OCR
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In recent years, the need for automated systems to recognize and process vehicle number plates has grown significantly due to increased security demands and traffic management needs. This paper presents a machine learning-based approach for number plate text detection. The proposed system employs a combination of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for feature extraction and optical character recognition (OCR) for text detection and recognition. Initially, the system captures an image of the vehicle’s number plate, which is then pre-processed to enhance the image quality and isolate the number plate region. A trained CNN model is used to detect and extract the number plate from the image. Subsequently, OCR techniques are applied to the extracted number plate region to recognize and decode the alphanumeric characters. The proposed approach demonstrates high accuracy and robustness under various conditions, including different lighting, weather conditions, and plate designs

articleTitle: Enhanced EEG Artifact Removal for Epilepsy Detection: Integrating CCA, EMD, And DFA-Based Denoising Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In this study, artifact disapproval in electroencephalogram (EEG) might be related to sound originating from eye and muscle movements. This involves a two-step procedure which increases the signal readability through filtering out noise by CCA and EMD-DFA. Thus, the concept of IMFs in a communication may help EMD and DFA identify and minimize ocular disturbances whereas CCA may help minimize interfering associated with muscles. When the developed approach generates more signals from the input and minimizes the rate of loss of data, the goal is achieved. It also discusses the use of this combined strategy with other more traditional methods such as ICA, PCA, and the Wiener filters. Signal-noise ratio is used to get the association and the mean square error of the suggested system and it is used to measure the functionality. The effectiveness study showed the effectiveness of the suggested solution is better than other approaches in terms of the elimination of eeg signal. Based on the results they brought forward, the suggest that in future investigations of neurological and cognitive sciences, integrated EEG-based systems ought to incorporate artifact reduction as a part of the process.

articleTitle: Robust Safeguarding of Frequency Regulation and Market Operations Via SVDD and Feature Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The power grid's cyber-security is becoming more important as our reliance on real-time interaction and communication technology continues to expand. Any malfunction in these technologies might cause the automated generation control (AGC) system to fail entirely since they are essential to the system's functioning. Cyberattacks, if successful, may halt power grid operations and cause major financial and personal data breaches. If an attacker wants to cause power outages, they may, for instance, use false data injection (FDI) attacks to tamper with the communication channel's network settings and send out incorrect dispatches. This introduces a novel market-operation assault template that makes use of exponential functions to enable stealthy attackers to obtain bigger cash settlements. To effectively identify FDIs aimed against the AGC system, it presents a new intrusion detection approach based on SVDD. This method employs a number of learning strategies, such as K-means clustering, SMOTE, and a number of Support Vector Data Description models serving as foundational learners. The detection technique is enhanced to capture varied patterns during standard and endangered grid states by the introduction of a new feature variable. Additionally, a novel market operation assault based on foreign direct investment (FDI) is shown in the chapter. This attack maintains frequency grid checks while unjustly increasing the output of particular GENCOs for financial gain.

articleTitle: Next Generation EV Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The "Next Generation EV Charging Station" project is a cutting-edge initiative designed to revolutionize the electric vehicle (EV) charging ecosystem through the integration of advanced hardware and AI-driven software solutions. This project aims to address key challenges in EV charging by providing a seamless, efficient, and intelligent charging experience. The hardware component centres on innovative wireless charging technology, utilizing coupling coils to transfer energy without physical connections. This system is managed by an Arduino Uno R3 microcontroller, which coordinates multiple functions, including energy transfer, user authentication, and real-time billing. Billing processes are streamlined via ThingSpeak, a cloud-based IoT analytics platform, which also enables data visualization on an integrated display screen. To further enhance system reliability and user experience, ultrasonic sensors are employed for accurate vehicle positioning and safety monitoring.On the software side, the project features an AI- powered admin dashboard designed for comprehensive system management. This dashboard automates report generation, offering detailed insights into usage patterns, energy consumption, and system performance. The AI capabilities also facilitate predictive maintenance and optimize the charging process, ensuring the highest levels of efficiency and user satisfaction

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Classification of Rice Varieties Using Image Analysis: A Comparative Study of Neural Network Architectures
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Rice is quite rich in genetic variation that has led to thousands of varieties each with unique patterns, shapes, and colors. The work of the research uses image analysis together with machine learning approaches to classify five types of rice: Arborio, Basmati, Ipsala, Yasemin, and Karacadag. The paper contains a data set of 75,000 images and an advanced architecture for a neural network that will improve quality grading of rice and help push agricultural application computer vision technology forward. The authors describe a deep learning framework capable of classifying various types of rice by using agricultural data from different collections of rice images. The model is demonstrated through experiments on activities related to image classification. The evaluation performance measures used were accuracy, precision, and recall. The experiments gave a peak accuracy of 97.59% on the dataset in question. These results underscore the fact that deep learning models can augment both the accuracy and efficiency of skin cancer diagnosis while emphasizing the necessity to utilize data from an extensive and diverse population for the training of the models. Furthermore, the higher effectiveness of AlexNet architecture compared with LeNet architecture suggests that more complex and deeper convolutional neural network architectures would perhaps be appropriate for cancer prediction.

articleTitle: The New Era of Cartography with Visual Analytics and Augmented Reality Transforming the Field of Digital Globes
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Mapping is always evolving, but virtual reality and visual data have changed it. Location knowledge was easier to grasp and utilize with them. This page discusses DSARAI, a unique and popular approach. App features include dynamic map layers, a real-time geographical data engine, and an augmented reality spatial overlay. DSARAI can alter digital globes in real time, is accurate, and has numerous user-friendly features. It compares the recommended technique to six popular mapping applications you can buy. This bundle includes MapInfo Professional, Terra Explorer, Carto Vision, Legacy GIS, QGIS, and ArcGIS. Well-designed performance indicators consider data accuracy, real-time changes, user interaction, guiding correctness, instructional efficacy, environment comprehension, and integration freedom. DSARAI outperforms modern algorithms in every area.

articleTitle: Robust Face Recognition System for Identifying Disguised Individuals
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Massive advancements in face recognition over the previous few decades have led to its widespread use in many fields, including social networking and advanced identification systems. The process of recognizing masked faces while accounting for the visual differences caused by factors like camera angle, lighting, and the coverings themselves. Modern techniques for facial recognition are embraced and enhanced in order to appropriately handle disguised faces. The proposed approach focuses on feature extraction employing a wide variety of kernel and filter sizes to detect both local and global features in masked faces. Another strategy to enhance identification performance is the use of skin segmentation algorithms. The purpose of these methods is to isolate the facial region from the masking artifacts. Comprehensive experiments are conducted using benchmark datasets to assess the efficacy of the planned technique. Using assessment system of measurement including recall, accurateness, and exactness, we test the models' ability to identify disguised faces. These measures are used to assess the approaches. According to the results, the ensemble model is more reliable and accurate than competing methods, and it also has better robustness.

articleTitle: Enhancing Human-Computer Interaction with Generative AI
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Modern Chatbots represent a significant advancement in human-computer interaction by integrating emotional intelligence into their design. Unlike traditional chatbots that rely on predefined rules and keyword recognition, these advanced systems use affective computing and sentiment analysis to understand and respond to user’s emotional states. By using large LLMs, this innovation brings several key benefits. It enhances efficiency by providing immediate, relevant answers without users needing to search through multiple sources. The chatbot delivers precise information tailored to the emotional context of the interaction. Additionally, these chatbots offer greater convenience by consolidating information into a single query, streamlining the user experience and reducing the need to navigate through various platforms. They have improved so much yet are so much limited. An emotion sensitive chatbots should recognize and respond to emotional cues, fostering a deeper connection with users, encouraging regular interaction, creating a more interactive and personalized experience while also offering valuable insights into user behavior and preferences, enabling organizations to refine their marketing strategies and product development efforts. Overall, emotion-based chatbots should bridge the gap for human digital interactions. In this view, this paper explores how Generative AI, its technology, various applications, how it can be improved via enhancing the Human-Computer Interface, how does the improved version fare against current version, its various new applications, and additional key challenges and research prospectives.

articleTitle: ViewOS: Integrating Web Browsing with Virtual Reality for an Immersive Experience
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: ViewOS is a virtual reality (VR) platform designed to merge traditional web browsing with an immersive 3D environment. Developed using Unity, it offers users the ability to switch effortlessly between conventional web interaction and VR navigation using an intuitive interface. By integrating standard web features with spatial exploration, ViewOS overcomes significant challenges faced by existing VR browsers, providing a more engaging and accessible experience. This paper examines the system's architecture, design approach, and implementation, highlighting its potential to redefine how users interact with web content in VR environments.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and Human Resource Recruitment : The Most Proliferated Use of AI
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Due to rising progress of Artificial Intelligence at workplace, HR can be viewed from a new and different perspective. AI helps in building employee resilience by providing various intellectual insights for dealing with various unforeseen contingencies. AI helps in improving the objectivity and efficacy of HR processes thereby allowing the human recruiters to focus on important tasks. The main focus of the paper is to recognize the significant contribution of AI in the field of recruitment. It also emphasizes on the application and proliferated use of AI tools in recruitment. Focussing on the present state of AI-driven HR, a bibliographic count of various reviews depicted that AI technology is majorly used in the recruitment area of HR domain producing highly effective results. AI technology has a significant role to play in the quality of recruitment process and it also helps recruitment agencies in handling many candidates but still there is resistance in using AI in the organisation.

articleTitle: Leveraging Pre-trained Models: A Comparative Analysis of Transfer Learning Strategies for medical image analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This role is critical for the early diagnosis and detection of diseases, among them cancer, through the analysis of medical images. In this paper, different transfer-learning approaches are compared regarding the task of breast cancer detection using deep pretrained Convolutional Neural Networks. Custom model CNN and transfer learning using VGG16 architecture were implemented. Such a dataset consists of images of breast cancers labeled as healthy, 0, and cancerous, 1. Finally, all this work integrates a performance metric evaluation that enables Gradio for the prediction of the real-time interactive user interface. Our results show that this fine-tuning significantly increased accuracy with less training time compared to custom models; hence, it may be useful for extensive medical image classification tasks.

articleTitle: Barriers to AI Adoption in Sales: Challenges and Implications for Sales Professionals Using the Total Interpretive Structural Modelling (TISM) Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This study examined the barriers that exist in the adoption of AI among various industries’ sales processes. Using the Total Interpretive Structural Modelling (TISM) approach, eight key barriers to the process of AI sales integration have been identified as data quality problems, inefficiency in the management of data, lack of skill sets, reluctance to adopt AI, loss of human-driven interactions, customer discomfort, unclear benefits of AI, and lack of predictive systems. The study identified three major challenges to AI adoption in sales: insufficient AI and human skill sets, reluctance and fear of AI, and ineffective data management and silos. Major challenges highlighted were inadequacies in training, lack of trust in AI systems, and resistance to organisational change. These challenges are very interdependent, meaning that resolving one challenge could have several positive impacts on others. As such, the sales professional, the developer of the technology, and the policymaker have been given great significance from these results, with a notion that investments should be made regarding training, development of trust in AI, and support of organisational change. The study also emphasizes proactive practices by companies by setting up the required structure for integrating AI into it and fostering an open culture toward technologies of AI.

articleTitle: The Rise of Intelligent Guardians: Leveraging AI for Robust Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This paper delves into the realm of Intrusion Detection Systems powered by Artificial Intelligence, specifically examining the revolutionary impact of machine learning algorithms in enhancing threat detection capabilities. Traditional intrusion detection methods often falter against novel threats and the sheer volume of network data. We delve into how machine learning, through anomaly detection and behavioural analysis, offers a dynamic and adaptive approach to identifying malicious activities, including the elusive "zero-day" attacks. Furthermore, we examine the crucial role of integrating these intelligent algorithms into Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tools. The fusion empowers organizations to achieve comprehensive network visibility, real-time threat correlation, and proactive security posture management in the face of evolving cyber threats.

articleTitle: Detecting Fraudulent Marketing in Online Social Networks and Mitigating Cyber Threats with Advanced Security Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Using their fake marketing postings on social networking platforms, the unscrupulous people attempt to grab the attention of the customers. When it comes to Social Networking Services (SNS), it might be difficult to spot fraudulent postings that are posted by fictional individuals. It is for this reason that there is a need to identify fraudulent postings on social networking sites. Specifically, a technique known as SNS Fraudulent Detection (SFD) is being suggested in order to identify these harmful marketing postings. The DFA-T and WC based WC-NFS are both components of the SFD scheme that has been presented. A Penalty Score (PS) is computed by DFA-T based on the hazardous words that are included in the extracted URL. This score is determined by the properties of the URL. WC-NFS receives from PS the URL characteristics that were retrieved from DFA. After then, the WC accesses the URLs that are added to the WC-NFS in order to get the numeric value of the WC-Index (WCI). Both the current data set from social networking sites and appropriate machine learning methods are used in order to detect harmful URLs and posts. The malicious posts are identified using the data set. The suggested SFD distinguishes between benign and malicious URLs with a high mark of accurateness, as shown by the results of the experiments.

articleTitle: Effective Seizure Recognition from EEG Data by Asymmetrical Back Propagation Neural Network (ABPN) Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: A significant task within neurology and epilepsy management is the differentiation of seizures from the Electroencephalogram (EEG signal). The current work of research focuses on suggesting an idea to enhance the detection of seizures by applying the Asymmetrical Back Propagation Neural Network (ABPN) classification. This dynamic aspect of ABPN is ideal for learning the details of the features and patterns of EEG since seizures are usually unilateral. We also compare our ABPN classifier with the standard neural networks to confirm that our proposed classifier perform better in sensitivity, specificity, and the overall assessment of the classifier in the global environment. According to the experiment, the authors are convinced that the ABPN model can solve the problem of lowering the false-positive rate along with the increase in the speed of detection to make it suitable for real-time seizure observation. This research will be useful in the improvement of better equipment to detect the seizures with a positive implication on patient health.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Signcryption Approach for Blockchain-Based Secure Communication in IoMT Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: To safeguard an EHR conversation via empowered device transfers with low encryption and signature overhead, it suggests a HySSA, a small-size BC, and a premeditated structure. HySSA functions in two phases. The first step of the process involves implanting proximity sensor nodes (PSNs) into the patient's body, which will set up a WBAN. The decision of which nearby cluster head (CH) may transmit data including EHR meta-data to the WBAN's GSN rests on the nodes themselves. Second, during its second phase of development, GSN combines data encryption and signing using a lightweight signcryption mechanism that is implemented for approved stakeholders. The data is securely accessed using an interplanetary file system (IPFS) that uses open channels to exchange keys. Storage of data mining findings helps keep computer costs down, and global chain topologies make use of block ledgers. In relationships of computational and communication costs, transaction throughput, and signature and transaction expense factors, the suggested HySSA approach is less expensive than competing schemes. Transaction throughput was 142.78 Mbps, well above the average of 102.45 Mbps. The proposed method is competitive with existing methods in terms of security, with CC of 2.953 ms and CCM of 1980 bytes for 3 messages.

articleTitle: EVAL IQ: Intelligent Educational Assessment and Recommendation Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: EVAL IQ is an innovative educational assessment platform designed to simplify the evaluation process for both educators and learners. It offers separate portals tailored to each group’s needs. Teachers can manage student data, create, and organize courses, design questions, and assess performance using automated scoring and in-depth analytics. The platform also includes a feedback system to facilitate continuous improvement. For students, EVAL IQ provides an easy-to-use interface for completing assessments, meeting deadlines, and providing feedback. Built with modern technology, EVAL IQ ensures efficient, transparent, and effective educational assessments, enhancing the overall teaching and learning experience.

articleTitle: Leveraging Deep Learning for Access Control and Data Security in Cloud Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Cloud computing emerged as a promising model for delivering services over the internet, offering users a pay-as-you-use structure that grants access to infrastructures (Infrastructure as a service), platforms for running various programs (Platform as a Service) and software (Software as a Service) at minimal cost. Surprisingly, as cloud environments evolve and expand, access control has become a critical concern to ensure that the data stored in these systems maintains confidentiality, integrity, and availability. The increasing complexity of cloud architecture highlights the urgent need for a robust access control model, as the consequences of inadequate protection could be disastrous. This article provides a novel approach to addressing the vulnerabilities in cloud security, emphasizing the need for enhanced access control measures. It investigates how deep learning can provide a defense-in-depth strategy to detect and prevent unauthorized access and data breaches by analyzing current gaps in cloud security research. Through a systematic analysis, this study aims to bridge these gaps, offering insights into how deep learning models can strengthen cloud environments against potential threats. By combining deep learning with traditional methods, the model dynamically optimizes access control decisions and strengthens data confidentiality. Results show that the proposed outperforms current works with accuracy of 94.39% that demonstrates considerable gains in data security, resilience, and overall performance that effectively addresses anomalies in cloud environments.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Bleisure: Analyzing the Social Dynamics of Work-Leisure Integration in Multicultural Contexts
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This research looks at the impact of artificial intelligence in bleisure travels in multicultural environments, with the key aim of seeing how advanced AI technology can improve people’s social lives and work and personal lives balance. The goals of the study are to determine how elements of artificial intelligence like customized travel advice, language translation, and actual cultural exchanges enhance the travelling experience.Problem Statement:Due to the rising modern trends of globalization, business people have the problem of managing time between work and recreation while on working trips, including those in multicultural environments. Bleisure travel and AI may be useful in how professionals engage with different cultures as they continue to perform their careers. Therefore, it is important to identify general social processes and difficulties that occur in this case to design better solutions.Methodology:This research adopts a quantitative research design with a supplementary qualitative element. It incorporates the narratives of bleisure travellers, questionnaires with the professionals in the industry, and the examples of the AI-based implementations of bleisure. The statistical findings form the basis of supporting the qualitative analysis to get quantitative results on social responsive occurrence, technological capabilities, and work–life balance.Outcome:The future studies conducted as a result indicate that AI improves the travelers’ experience not from the point of view of productivity only but also in terms of interactions and appreciation of culture. It is possible to note that AI-based developments have helped to a great extent to eliminate the obstacles to multicultural tourism, establish a reasonable ratio of work and free time, and adapt to social environments. Please, also, ethical concerns and guidelines for the application of Artificial Intelligence for bleisure travel with an aim to present a framework of socially responsible and responsible global mobility are presented.

articleTitle: High-Efficiency Algorithm for Cardiac Anomaly Detection and ECG Signal Denoising
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The main objective of the study is to establish a new approach for the filtering of noise ECG signals that will in turn help in enhancing detection of CVDs. Their early diagnosis is important if the patient is to survive because they are among the main causes of death around the world. Electrical interference such as noise, baseline wander and mobility artefact are forms of noise that are frequently observed when interpreting ECG. These disturbances reduce the possibility of identifying causes of the illness. To minimize noise in the ECG data, this research employed the Fourier Decomposition Method (FDM). For dealing with complex, nonlinear and non-stationary nature of ECG data, FDM, a Fourier based adaptive decompression technique, has been used. To denoise the signal, the technique splits the noisy information on the group-limited Fourier intrinsic band functions (FIBFs) while preserving the signal essentials. For most comparisons with real-time ECG signals and other databases, FDM is superior to other denoising methods like EMD and WT based on the outcome’s signal to noise ration (SNR) and percentage root mean square difference (PRD). This paper further presents that by employing FDM as a preprocessing mechanism, CVD detection in ECG is enhanced.

articleTitle: Identifying Autism Spectrum Disorder from Facial Images based on Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder that is known for causing issues with socio-communication behavior, including anxiety, improper emotional expressions, and sensory sensitivities. Currently, there is no cure for ASD. Early identification, along with proper therapy, can help control behavioral and language development. Traditional methods of ASD detection, which include subjective questionnaires and behavioral observations, are often time-consuming, costly, and require specialized expertise, delaying critical and early inventions. To overcome these challenges, this proposed method provides a novel approach to detecting autism from facial images, utilizing deep learning techniques and the pre-trained convolutional neural network model (VGG16) for feature extraction and classification. The proposed model is validating in real-time scenarios to ensure its effectiveness and practicality in clinical settings by supporting healthcare professionals in delivering timely and effective inventions.

articleTitle: Crisis Management and Consumer Perception: The Case of the McDonald's Boycott in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This research investigates the perspectives of Indonesian consumers towards McDonald's during the period of boycott that emerged after the 2023 Israel-Palestine conflict. More precisely, it examines the public's opinions toward the fast-food franchise following McDonald's Israel's decision to offer complimentary meals to Israeli soldiers, a move that led to demands for a boycott in Indonesia. The study utilized sentiment analysis to gather data from the social media site X (formerly known as Twitter) between October 2023 and August 2024. Python was employed for data extraction, and the Naïve Bayes method was used for sentiment classification. The findings indicate a substantial disparity in public perception, with the majority expressing unfavorable attitudes towards McDonald's, influenced by political, cultural, and religious elements. The study underscores the influence of global events and social media on consumer behavior, underlining the necessity for firms to implement strong crisis management plans. These findings are essential for the restaurant business to effectively handle unexpected problems like boycotts, indicating the necessity for strong brand resilience, customer loyalty, and social responsibility activities. The findings provide significant insight for both small and large organizations on properly handling force majeure situations.

articleTitle: Mitigating Website Vulnerabilities: A Comprehensive Analysis of Security Mechanisms and Emerging Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The worldwide community now places a great deal of importance on the Internet. The biggest issue facing the corporate sector right now is web security. It is thought to be the main foundation for the global data society. Security flaws can affect web applications. An online application layer is shielded from attacks by unauthorized users by means of web security. Erroneous client input is the root cause of a lot of web application issues. This essay discusses the various components of online security as well as its shortcomings. The main components of online security mechanisms, including passwords, encryption, authentication, and integrity, are also covered in this essay. There is a thorough discussion of the attack techniques and the structure of a web application attack. This study investigates a variety of approaches for combating this type of danger and evaluates why they have not been more effective. This research provides a more effective method for reducing these types of website vulnerabilities. It also provides the most effective security methods against these kinds of assaults.

articleTitle: Secure Mobile Payment Scheme Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The paper examines portable installment systems' expanding acknowledgment and the security imperfections that come with them. Whereas protecting client security and comfort, it highlights how direly security measures must be moved forward. The consider puts out a intensive arrange that fortifies security forms with machine learning, permitting for the quick recognizable proof and relief of dangers. The Arbitrary Woodland classifier is a principal component of this procedure since of its strength and capacity to oversee complex information intelligent. The objective of the inquire about is to accomplish a adjust between effective defense against creating assault vectors and consistent client encounter by combining progressed machine learning methods, such as Irregular Timberland, with current security systems. Careful testing is done to evaluate this approach's viability versus.

articleTitle: Predicting Ischemic Heart Disease Using Supervised Learning Techniques on Clinical Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Ischemic Heart Disease (IHD) continues to be one of the world's leading causes of death, accurate predictive models are fervently needed to enable early intervention. Traditional risk assessment methods often fall short in timely detection and prevention, necessitating the development of advanced machine learning (ML) models. This review critically evaluates recent advancements in ML-based IHD prediction, focusing on their objectives, performance metrics, limitations, and datasets. Our analysis identifies Random Forest and Support Vector Machines as the most frequently adopted models, achieving accuracies often exceeding 90%. However, challenges such as small, imbalanced datasets and data privacy issues persist. Emerging trends highlight the importance of comprehensive datasets and personalized approaches to enhance model reliability and clinical applicability. Additionally, there is a growing emphasis on feature selection and data quality to improve prediction accuracy. This research proposes RF model for accurately predicting IHD. The results show that the proposed model outperforms current works with 0.93 accuracy and 0.95 Area Under the Curve.

articleTitle: ECG Signal Analysis with QRS Complex Detection for Accurate Cardiac Abnormality Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: To improve the ECG signal interpretation helping to diagnose the indicated cardiac pathologies, the research concentrates on the formation and analysis of the QRS complex detection methods only. The QRS complex is widely used for diagnosing most cardiac disorders such as arrhythmias and myocardial infarction among others. Proposing a series of QRS complex classifications that enhance the existing solutions in terms of sensitivity and accuracy, the suggested approaches are built using advanced signal processing methodologies combined with logical focalization governed by the fuzzy formalism. This proposed approach showed better results than the benchmark fuzzy rule-based classifiers: classifications based on classical ICA and PCA algorithms in favor of accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and the F1 score. Essential strengths of this method were higher accuracy due to the improved detection algorithm highlighted, paving way for real-time ECG to monitor and diagnose cardiac disorders. This research has also pointed out the strategies for the advancement of other non-invasive replacements for cardiac monitoring by utilizing wearable or portable ECG devices and constructed a technique for the efficient and accurate QRS complex differentiation in ECG. The future work also includes the fine tuning of the proposed model, expanding the applicability of the model in the hospitals and improving the diagnostic accuracy by implementing more complex machine learning techniques.

articleTitle: Recognition of Major Depressive Disorder via Alpha Power and Theta Asymmetry in Publicly Available EEG Datasets Employing Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: A person’s thoughts, actions, and emotions may be profoundly impacted by despair, also known MDD (as Major Depressive Disorder). Presently, millions of individuals are impacted by MDD, making it a prominent condition. Depression is diagnosed using a questionnaire rather than any objective criterion. This research presents a method for diagnosing depression using features taken from EEG signals. Features employed included alpha, alpha1, beta, delta, and theta supremacy, as well as theta asymmetry. Theta asymmetry, alpha1, and alpha2 were also used as features. Feature selection using feature combination was done using MCFS. SVM, LR, NB, and DT were the classifiers that were used. In every classifier that was tested, alpha2 outperformed alpha1 and alpha power in terms of classification accuracy. The t-test revealed a statistically significant difference between the left and right hemisphere theta powers of healthy individuals, but no such difference in depressed individuals. The average theta asymmetry is greater in healthy individuals compared to those with MDD, however this difference is not statistically significant. The best classification accuracy in SVM was 89.46% when alpha2 and theta asymmetry were combined.

articleTitle: AI/ML Based Malware (.exe) Detection Software using Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The threat in cyberspaces is becoming more pronounced in the Windows environment and this carries significant risks for confidentiality. The variety of space like AI/ML technologies has also played a role in advancing such attacks. It has also been observed that several efforts have been made in eliminating the problem by using only the signature-based method but such problems can be resolved through AI/ML approaches efficiently. These studies derive a malware detector exploiting the Feature selection using extra-trees and other ensemble learning methods for example Decision Tree, Random Forest, Adaboost, Gradient Boosting, GAUSSIAN NB and Linear regression. Return on extra tree from random forest is highest at 99.6% compared to other techniques such as 98.5% for Adaboost, 98.8% for Gradient Boosting, 70.1% for Gaussian NB and 57.7% for Linear Regression which is the least. The voting on the other hand yields an accuracy of 90.1% that is low and not competitive with random forest. The final model thus achieved is made to work concurrently with a malware detection algorithm designed to detect malware through the PE attributes of the exe that is being assessed. The results of the research suggest that the tree-based ensemble method is effective and efficient in malware classification.

articleTitle: Hybrid Machine Learning for Cardiovascular Risk Assessment in Obstructive Sleep Apnea Patients
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The study looks at how Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA) affects cardiovascular disease (CVD). It details the ways in which OSA increases the risk of cardiovascular problems involving hypoxia, oxygen depletion, high blood pressure, and a host of others. The SHHS information was utilized to create a hybrid approach to learning that can categorize individuals with OSA into three hazard groups: On the cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk scale, including 0–5%, 10%, and 20%. The model achieved a classification accuracy of 98.89% in high-risk patients and 97.87% in no-risk patients using the ResNet101 DNN combined with decision trees. Additionally, the study takes into account HDL saturated fat, blood pressure, and cholesterol in connection to the risk of CVD. More scholarships have shown that increased oxidative stress is a major risk influence for CVD in OSA patients. Sleep and heart rate, two crucial metrics for risk categorization, were measured using a polysomnography (PSG). By highlighting the need for a real-time assessment of CVD risk in OSA patients, the present suggested model outperforms earlier methods. Further studies will expand it by incorporating other factors like stress and obesity to enhance the machine learning model's prediction capabilities.

articleTitle: Enhancing Emotional Health with Data-Driven Mood Tracking and Mindfulness
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This project empowers emotional wellbeing through data driven insights and personalized recommendations. Utilizing machine learning, it provides a comprehensive platform for tracking and improving emotional health.[2] Key features include mood logging, mindfulness exercises, and personalized insights, all aimed at enhancing self-awareness and promoting emotional health.[1] By addressing the critical issue of mental wellbeing, the project offers users actionable insights and strategies for improvement. The platform's tools for mood tracking, goal setting, and mindfulness exercises empower users to achieve better emotional wellbeing, making it a valuable resource for enhancing emotional health through data driven self-awareness and personalized care.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Dental Radiograph Classification: Overcoming Imbalanced Class Challenges in Multi-Condition Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: It is very important to classify dental radiographs; this helps medical people get diagnosed with some oral health conditions. This paper focuses on the application of convolutional neural networks in dental radiograph classification, where such images are classified accordingly into five categories: Cavity, Fillings, Impacted Tooth, Implant, and Normal. In implementing a deep learning model using TensorFlow and Keras, efficient image classification is conducted. The dataset is augmented using data augmentation for better performance of the model. These modifications help to overcome the challenge in data imbalance and variation in dental images. A lot of care has gone into designing the CNN architecture, and it was trained using the pre-processed dataset. The result from the model evaluation shows the overall performance of the model at 89%. In the precision, recall, and F1-score by category, a very high value for Normal is 0.93, while Implant is 0.86, showcasing practical competency in dental diagnosis. On the contrary, performance in those categories like Cavity is low, showing an F1-score of 0.30, indicating further improvements to be able to identify the subtle categories of dental conditions. This will further provide a details analysis of the classification results by pointing out strengths and limitations for the model. These findings underline the possibility of CNNs to create automated dental image classification, which could enhance diagnostic precision and reduce manual interpretation to assist early detection and treatment planning in dental care.

articleTitle: Hybrid Optimization of Data Replication in Mobile Edge Computing using Flower Pollination and Simulated Annealing to Minimize IoT Latency
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Mobile Edge Computing or MEC is one such paradigm that can be useful in making improvements in IoT networks and decreasing the latency. The rising IoT applications that call for low latency in application point to the challenge of data replication. The purpose of this study is to find the most suitable approach to utilize FPA and SA in reducing IoT latency. Implementation of FPA and SA results in efficient local search and also the exploration of the entire solution space. These two algorithms improve the replication of data solutions in a MEC environment. The proposed approach, therefore, aims at placing data and replicating it appropriately at different MEC nodes to minimize total latency within IoT networks. In regards to different aspects such as reduction in latency, the amount of resources employed, overall system efficacy, the result of the simulations suggest that the hybrid approach surpasses the conventional approaches on a regular basis. This work fits into the current literature on MEC by proposing a feasible solution to the novel question of latency in IoT networks apart from providing guidance on how to use MEC in real-world applications. Furthermore, it provides a feasible approach to future MEC networks and increases the perceived satisfaction in applications with high latency constraints like IoT.

articleTitle: Ensemble Learning for Detection and Analysis of Depression in Women Using Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: One of the biggest global health issues is cardiovascular disease, which kills a staggering number of people every year. The requirement for early detection pushed the introduction of strong deep learning computational methods, which have enhanced diagnostic accuracy. The goal of this study is to provide a method for detecting cardiovascular disease risk factors using machine learning. This method combines Bagging the classification algorithms (BaC) and boosting basic learners (BoC), using the heart diseases databases given by UCI, to increase prediction accuracy. This kind of classifier takes into account important metrics including maximal heart rate, age, cholesterol levels, and resting pressure in the blood. We beforehand the dataset and run the model via a tenfold cross-validations procedure to ensure its correctness. In order to reach the highest possible level of efficiency, the Bagging Classifier employs a total of 200 estimators, whilst the Boosting Classifier makes use of 100 estimates and a learning rate of 0.134 throughout the training process. In terms of performance criteria such as data delivery rate and data packets loss rate, the suggested system is superior to the current system in terms of its overall performance. When the bagging and boosting classifiers are combined, the total result is superior than the results obtained by either approach alone 98% in data delivery rate. This system's exceptional success may be attributed to the increased reliability it has as a diagnostic instrument for facilitating the early identification of heart illness. It is possible to improve the generalizability of the model by using deeper learning models in a more efficient manner and by using bigger datasets.

articleTitle: Advanced Neural Network Approach for Fetal Heart Rate Classification with Multi-Attribute Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Electronic fetal monitoring is an essential diagnostic aid in pregnant women for the evaluation of fetal status and possible pathology. In this research, a sophisticated neural network model is suggested as a means for the arrangement of fetal heart rate indicators with multi attribute analysis to assist in maximizing the classification. We thus use an ANFIS that incorporates the capability of learning from the neural network on the one hand and the reasoning of fuzzy logic on the other. The system employs ECG data and the signals are processed by Independent Component Analysis method to extract the fetal signals. Further, PSD transforming of a signal and RR-interval measurements are incorporated to obtain significant signal characteristics making the discrimination more sensitive and specific. The investigational outcomes also show that the proposed model achieves a much higher overall accuracy than the traditional methods, providing an effective means for the fetal heart monitoring in practice.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and Transgender People Friendly Hiring Practices: Opportunities and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Artificial intelligence is transforming the way humans work in various fields. It is supporting causes that enrich human lives. Employment accessibility to marginalized people like transgender people is still a challenge. Artificial intelligence helps recruiters ease the hiring process and obtain the right candidates for the job. With diversity, equity and inclusion becoming current norms, this research attempts to comprehend the opportunities that artificial intelligence can provide in enhancing the transgender friendly hiring practices. As technology can be a boon and a bane, the challenges of using artificial intelligence to create transgender friendly hiring practices are discussed. Key themes are explored and summarized from existing literature and industry reports for further empirical dissemination in future. The study is unique in its approach as it focuses on transgender people challenges specifically as opposed to abundant blended studies looking at LGBTQIA+ issues.

articleTitle: A Gap Analysis On Blockchain Frameworks For Managing Academic Transcripts
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Academic transcript systems have traditionally been managed independently by educational institutions, leading to challenges in interoperability, security, and data integrity. Blockchain technology, characterized by decentralization, immutability, and transparency, presents a promising solution to these issues. The introduction of blockchain technology offers a transformative approach to managing academic transcripts, providing a unified, secure, and transparent platform. This literature review examines current blockchain based academic transcript frameworks then critically and graphically analyses them based on the identified research objectives and gaps. The review’s critical analysis resulted in significant trends, patterns and insights as follows. The current research’s major objectives and their adoption percentages are enhancing security (33%), improving scalability (27%), ensuring transparency (23%) and addressing interoperability (17%). The major gaps identified are lack of interoperability (42%), security issues (42%) and high cost (11%) and others. Based on these insights, this work recommends current researchers to concentrate more on enhancing security and interoperability in academic transcript frameworks.

articleTitle: Enhancing Qos and Energy Efficiency in Routing Protocols for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In recent years, Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) have been leading studies and developments. Sensors, CPUs, and Bluetooth communication modules are in battery-operated remote sensor nodes. WSNs intentionally monitor and gather data on humidity, temperature, illumination, stress, and vibrations. Using wireless transmission, a centralized base station (BS) or gateways sends the data to a centralized server for processing and evaluation. In an evenly distributed network, cluster leaders are elected by maximum remaining energy and minimal base station distance using mobile sensor network methods. Based on simulations, our protocol surpasses LEACH in network lifespan, usage of energy, packet transfer, and rounds. Further FEEC protocols are suggested for WSNs with low properties. FEEC protocol sends statistics from regular stations to a superior cluster head (SCH) for dissemination to the primarily Station. Network efficiency is enhanced by FEEC compared to LEACH, SEP, TSEP, and CAFL. The suggested FEEC protocol with SCH improves network lifespan and packet delivery ratio (PDR) according to simulation findings. Monitoring regions with the base station in the middle or outdoor of the intended field is possible with this protocol. Simulations reveal that including SCH into the suggested FEEC technique increases the network’s lifespan and the delivery of packets ratio, while experiments demonstrate that FEEC beats LEACH, SEP, TSEP, and CAFL with higher packet delivery rates and greater number of active nodes.

articleTitle: Integrating Multi-Resolution U-Net for Morphological Segmentation with Multi-Scale Processing in Shape Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Biological research, medical imaging, and satellite image processing all rely heavily on morphological segmentation. When dealing with complicated geometries, different intensities, and noise, traditional approaches fail miserably. The U-Net architecture of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) has demonstrated promising results in capturing both local and global picture characteristics. Nevertheless, when dealing with intricate morphological structures, their performance can be enhanced. This research presents a new method for morphological segmentation using a multi-resolution U-Net, which improves upon the classic U-Net design by adding a multi-resolution framework. Because of this adjustment, the network can now interpret picture characteristics at many scales concurrently, picking up both detailed information and larger contextual cues. If the borders between regions are not clearly defined or if morphological structures show a lot of variability, this method will be very helpful. Multiple resolution branches flow into the network’s encoder and decoder paths in the proposed multi-resolution U-Net design. The network receives feature maps of varied resolutions from each branch, which runs on a separate image scale. Through the use of multi-scale feature fusion, the network is able to get a deeper understanding of the image’s object hierarchy, leading to more accurate segmentation of smaller, more complex structures while still accurately representing larger regions. In benchmark datasets, the model outperforms other state-of-art segmentation techniques such as the classic U-Net in pixel accuracy along with other evaluation criteria such as Dice coefficient and Intersection of Union (IoU). This is particularly true in the medical images applications.

articleTitle: Secure AGC Systems: Attack Detection via a Novel OC-SVM Ensemble Learning Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The explore aims to provide a Semi-supervised Learning method for spotting irregularities in power systems' Automatic Generation Control loops. An ensemble approach using a Gaussian One-class SVM, K-Means, and a novel technique known as REO is proposed as the methodology. The proposed method differs from previous work in this field as it can learn from just vigorous class information that is voluntarily obtainable in ancient databases or may be gained via offline reproduction. During training, the attack samples are not used since it is advised that the algorithm be built with the notion that defenders can't predict the assault sequences in advance. To see how well the suggested method identifies attacks that haven't been seen before, we've produced two additional kinds of intelligently generated attacks on top of the usual False Data Injection attacks. Initially, a well-coordinated stealth attack is planned, which might compromise the stability of the system. Coordination and secrecy characterise this assault. Second, a new strategy for financial gain-oriented market operation attack is created. More cash settlements for the attacker-selected producing firms are the goal of this assault. Lastly, we compare the recommended ensemble method's performance to that of existing one-class classifiers. The comparison shows that the suggested ensemble framework outperforms the alternatives with higher TPR (99.8%), TNR (98.9%), and Accuracy (99.4%).

articleTitle: Elderly Care: Elderly Well-Being Through Volunteer Engagement
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The growing need to support the well-being of elderly individuals has led to the development of a comprehensive Elderly Care system that leverages volunteer and caretaker involvement. To address the challenges faced by the elderly, the system is designed with three key modules: Elders, Caretakers, and Community Members. It offers critical features such as emergency assistance (SOS), medication reminders, volunteer scheduling, and real-time updates to family members. By focusing on user-friendly design and efficient user experiences, the system ensures that the health and safety of elderly individuals are prioritized. Moreover, it fosters community engagement through a volunteer reward mechanism, encouraging sustained involvement. Evaluation of the system highlights its effectiveness in providing timely interventions and consistent monitoring, significantly enhancing the quality of elderly care. Future enhancements aim to extend its capabilities and scalability, ensuring broader impact and adaptability to the growing needs of elderly care.

articleTitle: Epilepsy Detection Through EEG Signal Classification Using Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In this exertion demonstrates the application of a deep learning algorithm to the analysis of focal and non-focal EEG data for the finding of epilepsy. This research presents a strategy for automating the diagnosis of epilepsy by making use of a soft computing resource. By using the ANFIS classification technique, focal and non-focal samples may be distinguished. Structures computation, features classification, and features transformation are the three pillars upon which this technique rests. For an electroencephalogram (EEG) data, the Approximate and Directional bands are produced when the suggested NSCT is used. NSDF and Non-Subsampled Pyramid Filter are the two main components of this NSCT. These fall into two categories: low pass, which includes power frequencies, and high pass, which includes high frequency noise. To do this, we construct directed subbands and reroute the high-pass signal using NSDF. Step two of decomposition involves creating high and low frequency sub bands by passing the low pass sub band signal via the Non-Sub Sampled Pixel Frequency (NSPF). The directed sub bands that are created are achieved by retransmitting the high-frequency sub band signal via NSDF. Using the statistical properties obtained from these sub-bands, the ANFIS classification method divides the overall EEG signal into focal and non-focal samples. Applying the proposed method to a collection of EEG signal extraction measurements allows for validation.

articleTitle: Congestion Control in IP Networks using Machine Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Congestion control (CC) across the entire network serves as a crucial component of TCP, effectively managing packet loss caused by network congestion resulting from overload. The emergence of numerous network technologies such as SD-WAN, Wi-Fi 6, 5G cellular, network automation, and satellite communications has introduced a multitude of diverse network data transmission scenarios. This expanded landscape poses significant challenges to conventional CC methods, which rely on rule-based approaches and may not guarantee optimal performance across diverse network environments. Consequently, there is a demand for an intelligent CC module that facilitates seamless communication while maximizing resource utilization. Machine learning techniques have demonstrated their significant role in various applications, including communication, networking, and network management. Notably, learning-based TCP CC schemes have garnered considerable attention due to their ability to learn from network interactions and adapt accordingly. This research endeavour aims to develop an experience-driven approach that empowers the congestion module to learn optimal congestion control strategies based on its own historical data, such as runtime statistics. By leveraging reinforcement machine learning algorithms, the proposed approach enables dynamic and intelligent decision-making, ultimately minimizing packet loss and enhancing network performance.

articleTitle: LSSS-System: Fake Content Detection Using Linguistic Features
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In our study, we employed web scraping techniques to collect data from PolitiFact.com, a reputable fact-checking platform maintained by the nonprofit Poynter Institute, known for distinguishing political fiction from fact. We analyzed over 6,000 political, celebrity, financial, and economic statements using linguistic features such as syntactic, sentiment, stylistic, and lexical aspects to differentiate between authentic and fraudulent information. Machine learning models were used to extract and evaluate these features to identify which ones were most predictive for detecting fake and real content.Our analysis revealed that syntactic features, like punctuation count and verb count, had the highest positive importance, meaning they significantly contributed to the model’s accuracy. However, features like sentiment polarity, vocabulary richness, and noun count exhibited negative importance, indicating they may introduce noise or reduce the model’s performance. By identifying which features positively or negatively impacted the model, we refined our detection framework to enhance the reliability of fake content classification.

articleTitle: Detailed Analysis of Advancements in Cryptocurrency with Blockchain's Optimization on Fintech
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The optimization algorithms in Bitcoin and blockchain technology have attracted significant interest and debate due to their convergence with the financial sector, known as Fintech. Cryptocurrency and blockchains are comprehensively examined in this paper, along with their evolution, adoption trends, and implications for financial transactions. The potential for blockchain technology to revolutionize traditional banking and monetary services is discussed, as well as the role it can play in facilitating decentralized and secure transactions. In addition, we discuss regulatory considerations and technological advancements associated with integrating cryptocurrency into mobile payments and e-commerce. In a multidisciplinary review, this review explores cryptocurrency's potential to reshape the financial industry through a multidisciplinary lens.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Powered Decentralized Platforms for Secure Healthcare Data Exchange
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The Blockchain-Powered Decentralized Platform for Secure Healthcare Data Exchange revolutionizes private healthcare data management. It protects patient privacy and ensures data accuracy while making data exchange more efficient and secure. We use AES in Galois/Counter Mode (GCM) and SHA-256 hashing to encrypt and verify data. This protects the system against illegal access. Blockchain technology improves site functionality. Keeping an unchanging audit trail allows diverse healthcare systems to operate together without issues. Performance tests reveal significant improvements in latency (150 milliseconds), performance (1000 events per second), and security (9/10) over previous and shared systems. The platform is scalable, fault-tolerant, and cost-effective, making it a solid long-term alternative for the ever-changing healthcare industry. By making healthcare more collaborative and making crucial information easily accessible, this strategy benefits patients. We achieve this by resolving fundamental data processing and exchange issues.

articleTitle: Enhancing Road Safety with IoT-Based Smart Alert Scheme for Drowsy Driver Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The term "Internet of Things" (IoT) refers to a network that allows various physical items, such as sensors, connecting devices, motherboards, etc., to exchange data amongst themselves without the need for human intervention. On a global scale, drowsy driver identification is perhaps the most important technology for preventing many traffic accidents. The goal is to develop an alert system that can detect when a motorist is becoming too sleepy and take appropriate action when necessary. The human body experiences lethargy for a variety of reasons, but it is a normal occurrence. Accidents may easily happen, therefore it's important to have a reliable alarm system in place. Based on the notion of eye blinking, we calculate the VSP using the EAR and the distance of the eye. This allows us to create a system that alerts for sleepy drivers. Appropriate methods for eye identification also make use of face land mark algorithms. With the use of a Raspberry Pi monitoring system, an IoT module is able to send a warning message to the driver when driver weariness is detected. This message includes the potential effect of a collision, the vehicle's position, and the ability to notify via voice speaker.

articleTitle: Optimized Secure Data Retrieval System for Encrypted Outsourced Databases
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Ensuring data security is a critical requirement for databases outsourced in cloud computing environments. Existing systems often face challenges related to revocation management, data leakage, key management, and user authentication. This study presents a solution that employs an improved row-level encryption method, in which each database row is secured using a distinct encryption key, effectively mitigating security risks. To boost system performance, the approach also incorporates client-side memory utilization and selective encryption. In addition, a revised Diffie-Hellman key exchange protocol is implemented to safeguard communication between the user and the cloud service provider, ensuring protection against interference from malicious actors.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Communication Framework for Node Localization in WSN using Hyperbolic Least Square Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The method of positioning, localization, and geographic location in WSNs is investigated in this thesis. Anchor nodes, location-aware nodes with GPS, and nodes that are manually positioned during deployment make up the three main categories of sensor nodes that contribute to a WSN's scalability, which may go from tens to thousands. Common nodes that need localization techniques to be pinpointed are non-localized sensor nodes. The resolution at which localized nodes calculate the positions of other nodes varies with the use case. Time Difference of Arrival (TDOA) may be measured in two ways: first, by utilizing anchor nodes as a reference to identify sensor nodes; and second, by having the anchor nodes send RF signals to all of the nodes and then measuring the noisy TDOA. This thesis examines the surveillance configuration and TDOA, which factors in the time transformation of entrance and the speed of signal propagation in dry air, assesses the distances from transmitter sensor nodes to anchor nodes. Another way to find a sensor node's position is to set up a single node to communicate with the anchor nodes, and then use methods like triangulation, maximum likelihood estimation, and multiliterate to calculate its exact location. There is an impact on the sensor network lifetime and increased energy usage using this approach.

articleTitle: Innovative IDS Model Incorporating Machine Learning and Feature Reduction Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: It is becoming more difficult to promptly warn any harmful activity to avert the loss of sensitive data and money. This is because the quantity of new assaults on ever-growing system circulation is rising. Consequently, when it comes to network security, ID is one of the most important areas of apprehension. The real-world techniques that are being practiced frequently nowadays are mostly based on the technique known as Anomaly-based Network ID. The effectiveness of the strategies is therefore relative to the performance of the dataset that was used off to test the strategies. Unfortunately, this dataset does not, in most cases, paint the real picture of traffic flow in the network. It is for this reason that this research is about the study of several ML algorithms that is used in IDS. These algorithms are assessed on two datasets like the current network traffic in the real world and a modified KDD’99 dataset called NSL-KDD. This study was also planned to design a new composite model of IDS if explorations of various intruder detection systems on both sets of data showed promising results. Thus, this creative integration, employing stacking technique, of decision tree and random forest, yields an accuracy of 85 per cent. The recall is 2% while the precision is 86. G Wav: 1% and NSL-KDD: 2%. Also, it provides an accuracy of 98.99% and a precision of 98.99% on the CICIDS2017 dataset while obtaining such performances.

articleTitle: Backdoor Exploitation Using Social Engineering and Gephi
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This paper explores the integration of Gephi, an open-source network analysis and visualization tool, to identify and analyze the sources and vectors of cyber attacks, particularly phishing. By visualizing network relationships and attack flows, Gephi enables security professionals to trace malicious activities to their origin. The study further investigates the creation of phishing attacks using Python scripting and the Kali Linux platform to simulate realistic phishing scenarios. This paper demonstrates how Gephi helps trace attack vectors, and how phishing links, crafted and deployed using Python and Kali, can be utilized in offensive cybersecurity strategies against anti-social elements. Ethical considerations are discussed to ensure proper use of these techniques for educational and security purposes only.
