articleTitle: Cyberstalking and Mental Health: Advancing SDG 3 Through Prevention and Support
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Cyberstalking is a common form of digital harassment. The growing trend of cyberstalking poses a threat to mental health and well-being, and it undermines the realization of the sustainable development goal to "ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all" (SDG 3). This paper examines the psychological consequences of cyberstalking, taking into account the effectiveness of prevention and protection activities available on the Internet in order to mitigate these consequences. We used a mixed-methods approach that includes a systematic review of 50 peer-reviewed articles, data from 1,000 survey respondents, and in-depth interviews from 30 cyberstalking survivors and 20 mental health professionals. Our findings show that victims have higher rates of anxiety, depression, and post-traumatic stress disorder, and 68% report that overall quality of life has dropped. Key risk factors and patterns of cyberstalking behavior were identified and framed the development of the new prevention framework. In addition, our study demonstrates the significant influence that early intervention and individualized support services may exert on the long-term psychologic effects of cyberstalking. Based on this evidence, we propose an integrated model of general cyberstalking prevention and mental health support based on technological measures, legal approaches, and psychological interventions. This multi-faceted approach will have the potential to significantly add to the success of SDG 3, through support towards that goal by addressing the growing threat of cyber stalking to mental health in the digital age.

articleTitle: Designing An Energy-Efficient Virtual Cell-Based Data Propagation Scheme for Wireless Sensor Networks with Single Mobile Sink
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: WSNs are very crucial for smart city and environmental monitoring application. Low power for sensor nodes may reduce the transmission of data but since a sole mobile bowl is sufficient to sustain the system and reduce multi-hop communication. This manuscript presents a new approach to data dissemination using virtual cells notion, or groups of sensor nodes. A designated CH gathers information from all the member nodes and it interact with a mobile sink when it is nearby, that will act as a relay for the other virtual cells. To minimize the outcome of influence ingesting in the transmission process from a long distance, a mobile sink receives the data after aggregation but follows a specific route pattern. This strategy fully optimises the energy consumption, minimises the loss of data packets and enhances the lifetime of the sink mobility mode. There is potential for applying it in energy-limited WSNs with a single mobile sink since this procedure contributes to the decreased energy ingesting, network lifetime, and improvement in the speed of data delivery compared with the slowing of routing protocols as simulations have revealed.

articleTitle: Magnetic Resonance Image Analysis: A Healthcare System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In today’s medical image, analyses are captured very rapidly due to early detection of the brain tumour being very important. The tumour could be plainly visible in the neurological magnetic resonance imaging study, but the doctor must also quantify the tumour area at a certain level in order to conduct additional research. Machine learning has witnessed remarkable consideration over the past few years. From the analysis of medical images to natural language processing, several machine learning models spanning many fields appear to be able to detect tumours and are widely used in applications in academia, business, and medical science. These advancements have a significant impact on healthcare in a broad range of areas, including healthcare, medical imaging technologies, medical diagnostics, and medical data analysis. We give a broad summary of current developments in machine learning used for medical processing and evaluation of images as well as related difficulties. Magnetic Resonance Image (MRI) analysis using IoT involves collecting data from connected medical devices and sensors to create MRI images. Machine learning algorithms can then be used to analyze this data in order to find trends and forecast the health of patients. It can assist medical professionals in making better decisions that will enhance patient care and outcomes.

articleTitle: BLOOD SNAP - Blood Group Detection using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In case of emergency blood transfusion, identification of the blood group is essential to verify the donor’s blood type. It is a fast as well as a simple procedure to ensure the right type of blood is being given to you in surgeries or wounded cases. Incompatible blood intake can be fatal and can also cause agglutination. Conducting some specific tests before the blood transfusion process is important. One of the tests carried out immediately before blood transfusion in emergency cases is the determination of blood type.Microscopy has at times been found to be unsuitable because of its long processing time and the difficulty in repeating the results. The test publisher should be an expert. Therefore, image-processing software has been developed which detects the blood group in an emergency situation by analyzing the digital images acquired from the slide test. After processing the images that are captured, the blood group can be identified by observing the clumping of the blood. Thus, this automated developed technique will help in the identification of the blood group using the concept of image processing.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach for Denoising and Recognition of Handwritten Characters Using Deblur GAN-CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Handwritten Character Recognition (HCR) is a critical area of research within pattern recognition and artificial intelligence, with applications spanning from document digitization, optical character recognition (OCR), and handwriting analysis. Despite significant technological advancements, accurate recognition of handwritten characters remains challenging due to variations in writing styles, sizes, and inherent distortions.This paper presents a novel approach to HCR, utilizing a combination of Deblur Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to effectively address these challenges. Unlike traditional deblurring methods, which often introduce artifacts or blur the edges of characters, Deblur GAN is specifically trained to enhance the clarity of handwritten images while preserving essential character features. This allows the subsequent CNN to extract more accurate and discriminative features, leading to improved character recognition.Through extensive experimentation on benchmark datasets such as MNIST, an approach that significantly outperforms the existing methods is demonstrated in terms of recognition accuracy, particularly in scenarios involving blurred or indistinct handwriting. These findings highlight the potential of integrating deblurring techniques with deep learning models to address persistent challenges in handwritten character recognition, paving the way for enhanced automation and efficiency in text analysis tasks.

articleTitle: Ensemble Representation Learning for Land Use Land Cover Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Representation learning techniques are used to extract meaningful feature set from raw data for classification or analysis. This study examines the possibility of various traditional and deep-learning-based Dimensionality Reduction Mechanisms such as Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA), Principal Component Analysis (PCA), and Auto-encoder, for Land-Use-Land-Cover (LULC) classification in the field of Remote Sensing. Comparison on performance of individual and ensemble methods is examined by using a Logistic Regression Classifier as a baseline model for a 10-class classification problem. The results show that the combination of LDA and Auto-encoder gives superior performance in results with reduced running time in classification. The study also explores future research directions of simultaneous feature extraction methods and multimodal representation learning in Remote Sensing. Representation Learning techniques can enhance the performance of algorithms in real world scenarios involving high resolution spatial band data. The study can be utilized as a base for integrating multiple representation learning techniques to efficiently classify observations in Remote Sensing.

articleTitle: The Competitive Advantages of the Malaysian Batik Workshop
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Batik has its unique interactive activities for tourists. This research aims to provide competitive advantages needed in the Batik activities business use case study on My Batik, one of the batik workshop businesses. To extract the competitive advantage of the batik workshop, this research employs natural language processing with a Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) model to predict the main categories from the dataset. The dataset is built from public reviews from TripAdvisor and Google reviews. The LDA model identified five key themes: friendly and helpful services, qualified and knowledgeable trainers, various activities, cultural authenticity of products, and a conducive learning environment. These themes represent the workshop's competitive strengths and offer insights into enhancing visitor experiences and promoting cultural tourism. The findings provide a framework for similar cultural enterprises to understand customer preferences and improve service offerings.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Detection and Analysis of Depression in Women Through Advanced Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Global Health Data estimates that 450 million individuals throughout the globe deal with some kind of mental illness. Also, from their present position of fourth place, depressive disorders are projected to move to the position of most frequent ailment globally by 2020. A frequent and grave mental condition, depression causes a person to feel gloomy and apathetic all the time, making it hard for them to focus on their everyday tasks like work or school. Nearly half of all attempts to commit suicide are influenced by depression, which affects one in fifteen individuals annually. Roughly 30% of persons may experience anxiety throughout their lifetimes; it's a serious mental illness. We provide a method for diagnosing anxiety and depression, two of the most prevalent mental health issues. Machine learning algorithms provide its basis. It would be helpful to know the severity of the patient's condition. Talking to psychologists at different hospitals in India made it quite evident that when first diagnosing common mental problems, the majority of Indian psychologists utilize a standard scale. Bharath Multispecialty Hospital's psychology department gathered anxiety and depression standard scale questionnaires from urban patients (aged 18 to 35). Before the five machine learning approaches were applied to this data, they were pre-processed. When applied to datasets for anxiety and depression, our proposed model has shown five distinct AI strategies to be effective: Our CNN-based model outperforms the competition across a range of metrics, including accuracy, recall, and precision. With a 96.41% accuracy rate for anxiety and a 82.25% accuracy rate for depression, it notably surpasses current algorithms. Furthermore, among urban women aged 18–35, 7.4% suffer from severe anxiety and 15.6% from chronic depression, according to our study.

articleTitle: Efficient Trust Management for Blockchain-Enabled Smart City and Medical IoT with Eigenvector-Based ETMS
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Safe environment is aimed at creating within the context of Internet of Things (IoT) networks through the use of the Enhanced Trust Management System (ETMS) with the capability of detecting and eliminating the presence of malicious nodes and their contributions from the trust data. This is achieved using an eigenvector technique, which is integrated into a smart contract during the entire process. This allows edge nodes to invoke the contract at any time when it is necessary to invoke contract. To further enhance the security of the compiled trust information, the trust information is stored within a blockchain in blocks. As for routing the packets to the desired destinations, the result of the simulation demonstrates that ETMS is more effective than the systems currently in existence. In contrast to the systems that are currently in use, the suggested mechanism has a tool that will enable detection of contributions that have been faked in dispersed contexts and will therefore overcome a major deficiency. Moreover, the integration of ETMS into a number of circumstances that involve the Internet of Things, for example, Smart Cities, Medical IoT, and Industrial IoT, is entirely possible without any sort of complications. In the same regard, there is need to undertake further assessment on the capability of ETMS operating in real time across all these scenarios.

articleTitle: An Analysis for Livelihood Women Entrepreneur Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The entrepreneur is the person who puts resources together and takes up the responsibilities for reaching the targets and is the risk bearer related to the work. The task of the entrepreneur changed from time to time according to the situation. According to the researcher’s entrepreneur interests in developing countries are less than in developed countries. For last few decades, India is experiencing rapid changes in entrepreneur activities and its benefits among poor and needy people especially women from the weaker section of the society who runs their own business for the upliftment of their livelihood. An entrepreneur is a key development towards the industrial sector which gives rise in per capita income, an increase in the standard of living giving employed to others, it generates revenue to the government through taxes such as sales tax, income tax etc. According to Bihar Entrepreneur Association, there are more than 2000 entrepreneurs created including men and female. There are more than 150 startups that had been started and running successful. Using ML analysed the livelihood women entrepreneur. Main objective of the research to evaluate over regular employment. It is considered a catalyst for economic growth, entrepreneurship, self-funding, sustainability, and innovation-driven corporate practices.

articleTitle: Enhanced Security Approaches for Online Social Networks Using Honeywords to Counter Cyber Threats
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Some of the many uses for online social networking sites include promoting products and services, interacting with friends and family, and sharing information. Password theft, insider assaults, harmful bots, and deceptive marketing are some of the big security concerns they are up against. When a hacker get access to a database and steals passwords, they have committed password theft. When a criminal intentionally targets a person in order to compromise their vulnerability, this is known as identity theft or an insider attack. Launching phony websites with the intent to defraud customers of their money or personal information is known as fraudulent marketing. This study develops three security methods—Honeyword as a Trapp, Social Network Malicious I insider Detection (SID), and Social Network Fraudulent Marketing Detection (SFD)—to counteract these dangers. Decoy passwords called honeywords are used to safeguard password databases, whereas real passwords used by users are called sugar words. Honeyword As a Trap (HAaT) is an innovative approach that has been suggested to enhance OSN password security. By boosting the difficulty of password guessing attempts, HAaT is an upgraded honeyword generating technique that employs a salt-chlorine technique for hashing. By using user data to create "honeywords," the proposed HAaT lays the trap for attackers who misuse password guessing. To further reduce server shutdowns caused by denial-of-service assaults, it uses a modified alert policy. When compared to current honeyword generation methods, the experimental results show that the suggested HAaT which incorporates RHG and SCG approaches is far more resilient.

articleTitle: Secure Anomaly Detection with Light GBM and Enhanced Privacy Preservation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Cloud infrastructure is essential for modern businesses and other services since it allows for scalable and reliable operations. This work entails storing and retrieving gigantic amounts of information that have the potential to revolutionize human life cycle, business, education, and related domains, so altering the world in profound ways. The term "intrusion detection" refers to the steps used to find instances of data breaches in cloud infrastructure that do not adhere to established security protocols. In order to find out how machine learning algorithms have worked in real-world situations, that is what this thesis is all about. More specifically, this effort aims to provide a secure anomaly detection system that can be implemented and has higher performance in terms of execution time and classification accuracy. As a means to increase the algorithms' verifiability, a hybrid approach was developed, combining the Light GBM algorithm for classification with RFE for feature selection. In a cloud setting, the Trusted Authority may give key pairs to both the user and the compute engine, enhancing the efficacy of the RSA method in protecting data privacy. In order to identify features and classify them, the computation engine uses the NSL-KDD dataset.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Intra-Regional Trade in Africa: A Case Study of COMESA
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Understanding the sentiment nature of Trade Policy documents is a crucial step in both fostering global and regional trade. Moreso, the sentiments present in trade policy documents offer valuable insights into the direction, attitudes, and political atmosphere amongst member countries. This research aims to provide a sentiment analysis of one of Africa’s crucial trading blocs, COMESA, using Natural Language Processing. By using Machine Learning techniques, we arrived at the conclusion that the COMESA Trade Policy document has mostly positive sentiments with preferences for ’Member States’, ’Transit of Goods’ and ’Common Market’ to name a few. The research will lay the groundwork for future sentiment analysis of other global and regional trading blocs.

articleTitle: Deploying Hybrid Deep Learning Methods In Conjunction With One-Class SVM For Anomaly Detection In Crowded Spaces
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The importance of public security and smart city initiatives like the proliferation of monitoring networks and the ability to automatically identify suspicious activity in surveillance footage is growing. Modern methods for recognizing moving objects rely on context modeling. Noise and background movement are introduced because current anomaly detection algorithms focus on geographical information while ignoring temporal information, either entirely or partially. There is a lot of visual and behavioral diversity among the many people in a crowded situation, making it challenging to keep track of individual subjects.To get better and quicker tracking results, a strategy that combines strong segmentation with deep learning is suggested. This method involves taking an extracted video frame and then applying a two-dimensional variance plane and a GLCM to the highlighted pixels inside the video. A hybrid deep learning model is trained using one-class support vector machines using spatial data for robust abnormality detection, and Fuzzy C-Means is used to subsequent frames for segmentation. It assesses recall, precision, and accuracy. When compared to existing approaches, the suggested one achieves better results in experiments when measuring accuracy, precision, and recall. The technique is put into action in MATLAB using the PETS2009 and UCSD datasets.

articleTitle: An Effective Utilization of Convolutional Neural Networks for Brain Tumor Detection from MRI Scans
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Healthcare AI refers connected to the use of several AI technologies, including deep learning, ML, and NLP, to enhance the experiences of both healthcare professionals and patients. By analyzing data and making predictions, AI helps healthcare providers make better use of their resources and take the initiative in many areas of patient care. Health managers can quickly access electronic health records, patients may get faster, more personalized treatments, and doctors can improve the accuracy of their diagnosis with the use of these technologies [1]. A brain tumour detection system has been created using MRI pictures and CNN technology. A new approach of detecting brain tumors, benign and malignant alike, will be made possible by this technology. Both the Dropout regularization method and a 2D-CNN were used to create the approach. By using this approach, the problem of overfitting has been eliminated, leading to the network's precise item classification. The CNN has been tested with several convolutional layers, and the best result was a peak accuracy of 97% with just two convolutional layers. Participants in this area have compared and contrasted the efficacy of this strategy with that of other kinds of classification.

articleTitle: Advanced Liveness Detection in Facial Recognition with Disguises
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In recent decades, technology for recognising faces has advanced, making it popular in online communities and complex recognition systems. Face recognition is harder when people conceal themselves. Masked face recognition performs poorly in restricted spaces and big datasets. Face recognition systems must recognise disguised faces for security and dependability. This applies especially when individuals intentionally exploit the system. Ignoring disguised faces as actual faces is a major issue. Masks appear genuine because of their unintentional nature. Disguised faces are changed for style, culture, or personal preference, unlike spoofed ones. These individuals actively participate in recognition, making their masked faces true representations. Masked faces are treated as actual faces, authenticating people by their existence. By considering disguised identities as live faces, aliveness detection algorithms must handle their difficulties. Detecting spoofing became less important than proving identification, even with disguises. New techniques and algorithms are needed to accurately gather and analyse facial features from masked people to determine individual identification. We create an ensemble model to identify and distinguish real and counterfeit faces to address this issue. The ensemble model enhances face recognition by combining RGB and LBP photo texture information. Traditional methods are less accurate and reliable than the ensemble model, which is more resilient.

articleTitle: Optimized ECG Signal Compression and Security for Efficient Cardiac Abnormality Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Protecting biological data during dissemination, this ECG waves, is becoming more important, and this work is relevant to that requirement. It is of the extreme importance to guarantee the security of transferred medical information as the amount of data sent over the web continues to rise. It proposes a watermarking approach for compressing the ECG waves in addition to securing the information. By including subject information in ECG waves in a way that doesn't change their diagnostic usefulness, watermarking makes signal blocking possible. The frequency region and the domain of space are the two primary categories of watermarking methods. Improving signal quality to accept watermarking is also covered in the chapter using the Fourier Decomposition Method (FDM). In a setting with a large amount of ECG information moving around, FDM is used to accomplish realistic data compression as well, which is similar to decoding. This prevents the expansion of storage and bandwidth requirements while yet achieving a viable signal. The proposed technique beats its predecessors in relations of SNR, PRD, and compression coefficient, as shown by simulation results. As a whole, this approach improves the security of ECG signals and data minimisation for hospitals that are handled electronically.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Diverse Deep Learning Techniques for Facial Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In this paper a different methodology of deep learning algorithms is presented in facial emotion recognition. In this paper, we jump right into computer vision and affective computing by studying how different deep learning approaches applied to a dataset composed of facial images annotated with emotional expressions will work. We employ algorithms such as AlexNet, LeNet, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTM), VGG16, and Residual Networks (ResNet). By leveraging the intrinsic properties of these algorithms, we conduct a comprehensive study on facial features to enhance emotion recognition. For this investigation, we use a dataset that includes the data necessary to train and test models. We selected a variety of algorithms to enable an accurate comparison of their performance in recognizing facial emotions, utilizing metrics like precision, recall, and F1 score. Following the advent of AlexNet and LeNet, we explored the general application of CNNs and specifically adapted LSTM for facial recognition. We also investigated VGG16 and ResNet to determine how each algorithm excels in identifying emotional expressions on faces. This work makes a significant step forward in emotion recognition in computer vision and it also explores the algorithm selection for similar tasks.

articleTitle: Spatio-Temporal Motion Pattern Analysis for Anomaly Recognition in Crowded Sections using Kernel SVM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The advancement of information technology, the proliferation of monitoring networks, and the automated detection of anomalous behavior in surveillance video are all becoming more crucial for the purpose of public safety and smart city development. Context modeling is the foundation upon which the new methods for recognizing moving objects are built. Consequently, these systems are vulnerable to noise and background movement. It is a challenging endeavor to keep track of individuals in crowded scenarios because of the variations in movement and appearance that are brought about by the vast number of people present in the picture. An efficient Kernel Support Vector Machine is constructed for the purpose of anomaly identification in congested settings by making use of spatio-temporal movement pattern models. This is done to find solutions to these challenges. At the outset, the movie is divided into frames by making use of the threshold value. Protracted Kalman Filters are used to segment the motions of the objects to enhance the accuracy of the categorization. The textural characteristics are used to determine which item is in the front and which is in the background. To track objects in an effective manner, enhanced vector quantization is used. To categorize the abnormalities, the Kernel Support Vector Machine is used.

articleTitle: Digital Marketing Trends in the Finance Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: DFS (Digital Financial Services) are financial services that may be accessed and supplied via digital channels. In other words, DFS are services that are supplied and accessible by customers through their own mobile phones, laptops, Point-of-Sale (POS), ATMs, and so forth. The benefits of DFS may be used to payments, credit, savings, remittances, insurance, and financial information access. The goal of this research is to investigate the impact of digital financing, digital marketing, and digital payment factors on financial performance. Data analysis results demonstrate that digital finance has a favourable and significant impact on financial performance. The report focuses on the digital financial transactions trend and the path forward to increase digital transactions.

articleTitle: Freelancer Website with Code Store
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The objective of this project is to develop a website which brings together the freelancers and people who wish to avail their services. A Freelancer can use this website to showcase themselves and their skills and get opportunities to work and earn money. The website also contains a code store where in people can develop generic codes useful for developing various applications and put up their code for sale. The website aims to provide a platform with a user friendly interface for people to easily hire a Freelancer or purchase codes required for their objective.

articleTitle: The Role of IoT in Enhancing Sustainable Supply Chain Management in MSMEs
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This paper explores the transformative role of IoT implementation in enhancing sustainable supply chain management (SCM) for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs), addressing resource optimization and environmental responsibility. It delves into how the adoption of IoT fosters operational efficiency and sustainability by enabling data-driven decision-making and reducing environmental footprints. Using a case study approach, the research examines the practices of a dominant parcel service in India’s logistics sector, showcasing how IoT integration has optimized operations. We will go on to use a case study approach to find out how the dominant 3PL service in India implements IoT and how it has optimized its operations by showing how IoT integration helps them optimize logistics, improves real-time tracking, and transforms towards paperless and greener practices in support of sustainability goals. Such innovative systems, using GPS, QR codes, and ERP systems, have helped the betterment of routing schedules, predictive maintenance, and customer satisfaction with data transparency in real time. The paper is written with the data of a leading 3PL service in India, an MSME utilizing IoT in its SSCM, to effectively describe the operational challenges without IoT such as inefficiency, lack of visibility, and higher costs. The study highlights the operational challenges faced without IoT inefficiencies, lack of visibility, and higher costs—and presents a comparative analysis of operations before and after IoT adoption. The findings reveal significant improvements in delivery speed, cost efficiency, and sustainability, demonstrating how IoT empowers MSMEs to overcome resource constraints, enhance competitiveness, and achieve environmentally responsible operations.

articleTitle: Digital Guardians: A Wrist-Worn Autonomous Drone Pilot for Live Safety Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The growing demand for individual well-being in public and private spaces has prompted the development of innovative mechanical and technological solutions. This paper presents Digital Guardians: Wrist-Worn Autonomous Drone Pilot for Live Safety Surveillance, a wearable IoT-based safety device intended to address threats in real-time. The proposed framework integrates a wrist-worn control unit with an autonomous drone that streams live video to enhance situational awareness. Leveraging advanced sensors and AI-powered threat detection, the device autonomously deploys the drone to follow the user, capture live video, and communicate it to emergency contacts and law enforcement. The wristband's control unit allows users to manually deploy the drone during suspicious activities, providing an aerial perspective of the surroundings via a smartphone application. This system also integrates GPS for location tracking, artificial intelligence for emotion and threat detection, and NLP for verbal harassment recognition. With its potential to prevent crimes and respond rapidly to emergencies, the Digital Guardians device offers a new level of personal safety, harnessing the power of AI, IoT, and autonomous robotics.

articleTitle: Optimized Fetal ECG Feature Extraction with Genetic Algorithm Based Heart Rate Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Congenital heart problems are the most common primary cause of death that can be attributed to birth defects. It is possible to identify cardiac defects by analyzing the geomorphology of cardiac electric indications. Additionally, the examination of fetal cardiac signals, which does not involve any intrusive procedures, can be an efficient method for monitoring the health of the fetal heart and identifying cardiac abnormalities at an early stage. One method that can be utilized to evaluate the health and condition of the fetus is the ECG signal, which is a graphical copy of the electric potential that is generated in conjunction with the action of the heart. However, there are several technical issues that arise during the process of non-invasive FECG extraction. These issues include interference from maternal electrocardiograms and maternal electromyograms, interference from power lines operating at 50 Hz, and baseline drift. Extraction and analysis of the fetal electrocardiogram signal are the key goals of electronic fetal monitoring; they are the primary objectives. In the process of extracting features from the fetal ECG indication, which is a nonlinear mix of the gentle ECG, the fetal ECG indication, and other interfering signals, digital signal processing techniques constitute a key part of the process. It is possible to find solutions to problems involving abnormality detection by employing data mining techniques and soft computing approaches for categorization.

articleTitle: Data Privacy Preserving in Cloud ERP using Cryptographic Algorithm with IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has become one of the increasingly popular and rapidly growing technologies in the IT sector. Sensors are integrated into networked physical equipment through wireless or wired connections and engage in mutual interaction. The ERP system is an evolving implementation of the IoT-Cloud. Multiple research efforts are undertaken to guarantee the confidentiality of ERP data. The main focal points of the IoT-cloud based ERP system are data security and the computational loads. This paper presents a novel method for safeguarding our data by using sophisticated cryptographic techniques, including the Elliptic Curve Cryptography Algorithm and the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) algorithms. The objective of this technique is to bolster the security of ERP data in the IoT ERP Cloud system. The Cloud Service Provider (CSP) authenticates the user access policy and transmits the encrypted data to the user. One way to assess the recommended approach is by conducting tests on different performance metrics, such as key generation time and query processing time.

articleTitle: A Survey on: Design, Implementation, and Evaluation of a Secure and Anonymous Communication Platform Utilizing the TOR Network for Enhanced Privacy and Data Protection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This study presents an advanced anonymous messaging platform that integrates Tor network, VPN, and dynamic IP rotation to provide strong privacy protection for users. Tor network onion routing masks user identities with multilayer encryption between distributed nodes, while a VPN adds an encrypted tunnel, improving security by hiding the user’s real IP address. The main innovation is the automatic rotation of the IP address of both the sender and the receiver every 10 seconds, which prevents backtracking and significantly complicates traffic analysis. This dynamic mechanism ensures that even if a user’s communication is intercepted, it becomes impractical to trace it back to its original source or destination. By addressing weaknesses such as Tor network’s potential exit node tracking and risks of VPN One Content Failure, the platform effectively reduces timing attacks and traffic correlation. The design balances latency and performance, ensuring minimal disruption while maintaining high scalability and resilience against adversaries. The combination of these technologies provides a state of the art solution for secure and private anonymous communication. Keywords: anonymous communication, Tor network, VPN, dynamic IP rotation, onion routing,

articleTitle: MRI Image Compression Using Deep Convolutional Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Image compression is a type of data compression applied to digital images to reduce their cost for storage or transmission. Supervised learning with convolutional networks (CNNs) has seen widespread adoption in computer vision applications. Comparatively, unsupervised learning with CNNs has received less attention. In this research work, a class of CNNs called deep convolutional generative adversarial networks (DCGANs) has been developed. These networks have certain architectural constraints and demonstrate that they are strong candidates for unsupervised learning. Training on various image datasets shows convincing evidence that the proposed deep convolutional adversarial pair learns a hierarchy of representations, from object parts to scenes, in both the generator and discriminator. Additionally, this research uses the learned features for novel tasks, demonstrating their applicability as general image representations.

articleTitle: Cardiac Health Assessment System Using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The Cardiac Health Assessment System leverages machine learning algorithms to enhance the early detection and management of cardiovascular diseases (CVDs). By analyzing patient information including medical background, lifestyle factors, and results from diagnostic tests the system can accurately predict the likelihood of cardiac events. Classification models like calculated relapse, choice trees, and Credulous Bayes are used to categorize patients into different risk groups, aiding healthcare providers in making well-informed decisions. The system also offers personalized health recommendations to mitigate identified risks, thereby improving patient outcomes and reducing the burden on healthcare resources. Continuous learning is embedded within the model, enabling it to refine predictions based on new data. This proactive approach aims to shift CVD management from reactive treatment to preventative care, reducing CVD-related mortality and enhancing overall heart health outcomes.

articleTitle: Intelligent Heart Rate Classification with Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The human heart is considered among the most crucial internal organs found in the body. An ECG signal is defined as the widespread name given to any electrical signal that is generated by the circulatory system*. By using the ECG signal, one can estimate anomalies present in a heart. This study is aimed at grouping the electrocardiogram (ECG) signals, and thereby using an adaptive neuro fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) algorithm. In this study, the ANFIS which is associated with the back propagation approach is used in order to perform the categorising task. ANFIS can be developed from the integration of fuzzy logic which is a qualitative technique with the neural network aspect in allowing adaptability. Attribute selection is done before the classification exercise is conducted. Four different types of ECG beats can be retrieved from the datasets available at PhysioBank. Classification of the cardiac signals is done employing four ANFIS classifiers. The fifth ANFIS decoder is used to get a higher discrimination ratio in order to classify the electrocardiograms accurately.

articleTitle: Prediction in Stock Market Value using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Currently, investments made via the purchase of stock shares account for the majority of international trades among countries and significant quantities of cash are traded on stock markets around the globe. However, one of the most important things is to figure out how to efficiently condense & visualize stock market data in a way that people or organizations may use it to make well-informed investing decisions. In order to identify patterns in chaotic and nonlinear systems, this paper proposes a smart stock market forecasting system that uses fuzzy inference and neural networks. This study aims to predict the price of stocks using the financial data of a company.By utilizing a probe to look at a sample of the entire population. The prediction was made by a nonlinear fuzzy-neural network framework with the stock market acting as an external variable.

articleTitle: Hy-Tech Shopping Cart Using Object Detection and Human Following Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Recent advancements in artificial intelligence and robotics have transformed the retail industry, leading to innovative solutions that enhance the shopping experience. Our paper presents the High-Tech Shopping Cart, an intelligent system that leverages object detection and human-following technology to provide a seamless, hands-free shopping experience. The cart utilizes state-of-the-art object detection algorithms to identify and track items selected by shoppers while employing a robust human-following mechanism to navigate autonomously through stores. Our system integrates computer vision techniques, sensor fusion, and advanced path-planning algorithms within a modular framework, featuring cameras and depth sensors for real-time processing. Extensive experiments demonstrate high accuracy in object detection and reliable navigation in complex environments. User satisfaction surveys indicate a positive reception, highlighting the cart's potential to significantly enhance the shopping experience.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Load Analysis in MANET Routing Protocols: AODV vs. AOMDV
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The paper compares load analysis in Mobile Ad Hoc Network routing protocols, focusing on Ad hoc On-Demand Distance Vector (AODV) and Ad hoc On-Demand Multipath Distance Vector (AOMDV) protocols, examining their performance in load distribution, network efficiency, and overall performance under different traffic conditions. Through extensive simulations and performance evaluations, the results demonstrate that AOMDV outperforms AODV in handling high-traffic scenarios, offering superior load balancing, enhanced network throughput, and reduced packet loss. Additionally, AOMDV's ability to leverage multiple paths for routing significantly improves both the security and quality of service (QoS) in multipath routing situations. The findings suggest that integrating enhancements into the AOMDV protocol can further optimize network performance, especially in high-traffic areas, and provide robust solutions for managing network load, security, and QoS. The paper suggests that enhancing AOMDV routing can enhance the efficiency and reliability of MANETs as a strategic approach.

articleTitle: Harnessing AI to Combat Hate Speech: Analyzing Machine Learning vs. Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: one major challenge characterizes the era of digital communication. It is controlling hate speech on the internet. Derogatory or discriminatory remarks directed at particular groups are considered hate speech. Race, gender, and religion are characteristics that set these groups apart. Social media sites made a move in the right direction. They put in place instruments for moderation. Automated systems are used by the tools. However, there are still flaws in automated systems. We investigate and contrast machine learning techniques in this work. deep learning (DL) ones as well. They are intended to identify hate speech. Conventional algorithms are assessed. These consist of Gradient Boosting, Random Forest Decision Trees, and Naive Bayes. DL algorithms also accompany them. These are BERT, CNN, and LSTM BiLSTM. AUC F1 score, recall, and precision are evaluation measures.. Emphasizing approach strengths is the aim. It also serves to highlight restrictions. Results show. Deep learning algorithms are particularly noteworthy. Specifically, BERT yields outstanding outcomes. Compared to conventional machine learning techniques, these perform better. They present the possibility of upcoming improvements. This is a crucial field of study.

articleTitle: Advanced Cryptographic and Clustering Techniques for Privacy and Anomaly Detection in Heterogeneous Cloud Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The study delves at machine learning methods that can spot out-of-the-ordinary occurrences in real life. The development of a secure anomaly detection system that enhances deployment-ready classification accuracy and execution speed is one goal of this endeavor. According to studies, data privacy and classification accuracy may both be enhanced with the right cryptography approach. Two components of privacy protection in commercial cloud systems are processing of information security and integrity. While processing, data processing security safeguards user data, and data integrity guarantees that data syntax and semantics remain unaffected while being sent. Hackers may take use of user data by breaking into key pairs using existing cryptography methods. There is a lack of consideration for noisy data in current anomaly detection systems. In response to the difficulties encountered in scientific research, we presented a low-computing-cost method for protecting user privacy while simultaneously detecting anomalies in cloud data. An efficient privacy-protecting cloud-based anomaly detection approach is introduced. For data collected by sensors on a massive scale, the method enhances cryptographic techniques. Data encryption is performed in the cloud on both individual and group servers. A more secure and private encryption method called RSA based on LPGWO (Local Pollination Grey Wolf Optimizer) is used for the encryption. To efficiently classify large datasets, the proposed method partitions them. Collaborative public servers detect anomalies using the NCM (Neutrosophic C-Means) method.

articleTitle: Differential Privacy in Federated Learning Using Noise Multipliers: An Analysis on MNIST Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Federated learning enables decentralized learning to run on multiple clients by training locally on each client’s data and sharing new instances only on a central server. However, if privacy is not protected, sensitive information about any customer can be accessed via model updates. Differential privacy (DP) provides a robust method of preserving data privacy by combining controlled noise with gradient updates sent to a central server This paper explores the application of differential privacy to federated learning using different noise factors on the MNIST dataset. We investigate the trade-off between accuracy and privacy protection by analyzing test loss and accuracy over several communication channels, with noise factors of 0.2, 0.3, and 0.7. The results show that increased noise reduces model accuracy but provides better privacy protection. We also emphasize the importance of balancing accuracy and confidentiality in official learning processes to ensure for example safe yet efficient sampling operations.

articleTitle: Counteracting Unobserved Cyber-Attacks in AGC and HVDC Schemes Using a Multi-Agent Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: A novel approach to safeguard the AGC circlet and supremacy modulation controller of a high voltage direct current system from cyber-attacks is discussed in this research employing a multi-agent-based architecture. To achieve this, we propose adding a Master Agent (MA) and many Slave Agents (SAs) into the current AGC layer. For intrusion detection, the wide-area signals of the MA are processed employing a OCC. Used in the problem domain to minimize attacks by the SAs, are SVR models that utilize local knowledge. The suggested method moves to another training method for OCC which excludes the use of instances that are contaminated by noise in favor of protected data. The next step is to propagate a structure that the AGC system may employ for setting the online SVR models. When evaluating the tested solution’s performance, we consider a set of test scenarios that reflect the secured case, which includes normal and stressed system behavior; the attacked case, which pertains to various types of threats targeting data integrity and availability, as well as grid states. Interestingly, there is decent accuracy in identifying the assaults using the OCC, specifically the SVDDM. It is also observed that the SVR models operate well and optimally in terms of performance and at the same time effectively counter cyber-attacks.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid Dragonfly-Cuckoo Search Algorithm For Optimized Mobile Robot Navigation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Based on the fact that the robot’s mobile navigation problem is an NP-hard optimization problem, this study investigates potential solutions to this issue by using optimization algorithms that draw inspiration from natural design. Autonomous mobile robot navigation problems may be broken down into three interrelated parts: map making, route planning, and movement. These factors inform the development of a mobile robot route planning algorithm that finds the best, most efficient way to move from A to B in a complicated and confusing environment, without crashing. The suggested study primarily focuses on mobile robot route planning. Many different optimization methods that draw inspiration from swarm intelligence and biotechnology are now used in the navigation of mobile robots. Some examples are the Firefly algorithm, ACO, PSO, and DA. Hybridization integrates the strengths of two or more algorithms to provide superior optimum solutions for problems with many objectives, as compared to the strength of each algorithm alone. The adaptability and capacity to achieve optimum solutions for complicated optimization problems led to the selection of the DA and the Cuckoo Searching algorithm (CS) for hybridization in this study.

articleTitle: Optimizing Depression Detection and Analysis in Women with Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Depression affects people globally, especially women. This abstract discusses the several causes of depression in women. Women acquire depression due to sociocultural influences, biological variables, psychological stresses, and hormonal variations. The interconnectedness of gender, race, ethnicity, and financial background affects depression among women. Understanding these distinctions is essential to offering depression-specific support, therapy, and interventions to women. This abstract raise awareness of gender-specific mental health care challenges to help depressed women recover. Some disorders may worsen with depression: Asthma, arthritis, and cardiovascular disease. Diabetes, obesity It is important to recognise that depression is a normal aspect of life. Everyone faces unpleasant and upsetting circumstances. Across all trials and measures, the ensemble binary classifier beat all baseline methods. The suggested ensemble model was trained using the processed depression dataset. This study links depressed symptoms to quality-of-life metrics for women. Previous research and comparisons to current approaches show that the suggested strategy produces more accurate findings. Next, we assessed its performance using the mental screen inventory and discussed comparable expectations. Finally, we suggested future study directions. This information may help researchers and medical practitioners understand the origins of depression and other mental health concerns.

articleTitle: Sustainable Wireless Sensor Networks: Energy-Efficient Clustering Protocols for Extended Operation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Because of their widespread use in contexts with constrained resources, wireless sensor networks' (WSNs) ability to conserve energy is of the utmost importance. Assigning cluster heads to each group of sensor nodes and classifying them as a cluster is the standard method for clustering. But it’s not easy to get the network performance and energy usage just right. Several hierarchical methods, several levels of clustering, and dynamic clustering models are covered in this study as energy-efficient clustering protocols. We evaluate these protocols' impact on network lifetime, energy consumption, and data transfer reliability using simulation results and performance metrics. Among the most recent developments in the field of energy-efficient clustering include the use of machine learning for the purpose of predicting network behavior and adjusting cluster formation, and the development of intricate protocols that combine several energy-saving techniques. The research highlights the importance of enhancing and incorporating clustering techniques into WSN systems to meet their future demands and adapt to their dynamic nature. Improving the operational life of WSNs and building sustainable and optimal solutions are both made possible by energy-efficient clustering methods.

articleTitle: Real-Time Detection of AI-Generated Deepfake Audio: A Novel Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The rise of AI-generated deepfake audio presents a significant challenge in audio forensics, as traditional detection methods are inadequate against sophisticated manipulations. This study proposes a novel approach combining deep learning algorithms with signal processing techniques to detect deepfake audio in real-time. By leveraging voice pattern recognition and anomaly detection, the method achieves high accuracy and low latency. Experimental results show a significant improvement in detection performance, with the integrated system outperforming traditional methods. The proposed solution demonstrates potential for enhancing security and digital forensics by enabling the swift identification of deepfake audio.

articleTitle: Practicing Green HRM- A Step towards Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Recently, the concepts of ecological management and green human resource management have emerged together across business, urbanization, industrialization, and many other contexts. Its involves managing human resources and ensure that the working environment is favorable. The primary goal of green HRM practices is to lower each employee's carbon footprint and the holding association's intellectual capital. Additionally, it helps persuade staffs to protect resources and take part in excess management to reduce pollution. It is advised that industries become more knowledgeable about all of the features that make human resources administration environmentally friendly. This paper aims to explore most recent green human resource management performs used by Indian corporate giants. To be environmentally conscious is moral and ethical duty of every organization's towards their nation. Green practice is not only limited up to operations and production, beside that HRM too has a lot of room to grow environmentally conscious. As a result, this paper also makes an attempt to address the moral implications of implementing green HR practices. It also exhibits the role of organization as a responsible corporate behavior. A lot of businesses concur on green management. Green HRM is practiced by companies in India including Wipro, TCS, ACG Associated Capsules Pvt. Ltd. to promote eco-friendly sustainability. The study also efforts on the use of GHRM (Green Human Resource Management) ideas by Indian business organizations.

articleTitle: DIP AI-Driven Architecture for Enhanced Project Management Using Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs), such as GPT-4, Claude, and Gemini AI, into project management systems has revolutionized how tasks are automated, tracked, and optimized. This paper presents a comparative analysis of LLMs in the context of project management, evaluating their performance in scheduling, resource allocation, and decision support. By leveraging both primary data from real-world simulations and secondary data from literature, the study highlights GPT-4’s superior accuracy, task completion speed, and scalability over other models. The findings suggest that AI-based systems can enhance efficiency and reduce human error in complex project management workflows.

articleTitle: A QoS-Aware Energy Optimization Framework for Mobile Devices Using DRL and Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The proliferation of computationally intensive mobile applications like Augmented Reality (AR), Speech Recognition, and Mobile Gaming has led to an alarming rise in mobile energy consumption, raising the need for frequent recharging of mobile devices. This frequent recharging leads to degradation of mobile device’s battery health resulting in reduced battery capacity, shorter usage cycles, and ultimately increased costs associated with battery replacements. The current mobile energy optimization frameworks are unable to effectively handle the dynamic and realtime nature of mobile environments with unpredictable variables. This research proposes a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) model to optimize energy efficiency in mobile devices using Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) to handle varying workloads and dynamic environment while maintaining Quality of Service (QoS) where computationally intensive applications are optimally offloaded to edge cloud servers. The result shows that the proposed outperforms current works by reducing energy consumption and average latency by 27.5% and 35% respectively.

articleTitle: Social Media Intelligence: Development of a Parsing Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Social media platforms are treasure troves of unstructured data, offering unparalleled opportunities for intelligence gathering. However, challenges such as data diversity, evolving APIs, and privacy regulations hinder effective data utilization. The Social Media Intelligence Parser (SMIP) is a versatile cross-platform tool designed to extract, structure, and analyze social media data using advanced machine learning algorithms. It provides real-time insights into suspicious activities and patterns, catering primarily to investigative and counter-terrorism needs. By integrating features such as sentiment analysis, multimedia processing, and dynamic API adaptation, SMIP transforms raw social media data into actionable intelligence. This paper presents the architecture, methodologies, and potential applications of SMIP, emphasizing its scalability and adaptability to evolving digital landscapes.

articleTitle: Efficient Real-Time Human Activity Recognition with IoT Sensor Data Using Conditionally Parametrized Convolutions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) is a trading area in computer vision and deep learning. However, boosting the performance of deep learning models often necessitates increasing their size or capacity, which raises computational demands. The high operational costs present challenges for real-time HAR on sensor-based devices. Shallow learning approaches, while computationally efficient, generally fail to deliver comparable performance. Consequently, there is a critical need for deep learning methods that can effectively balance accuracy and computational cost, a topic that remains largely underexplored. This paper introduces a computationally efficient CNN that utilizes conditionally parametrized convolution, designed specifically for real HAR on sensor-based devices. The model is tested on the OPPORTUNITY dataset, achieving existing accuracy without increasing computational load. Through extensive ablation studies, we show that this high-capacity network surpasses baseline models while maintaining a similar level of computational efficiency. The proposed method can directly replace existing deep HAR frameworks and be easily implemented on sensor-based platforms for real-time applications.

articleTitle: Assessing Cyber-Attack Impact in Smart Grid Cyber-Physical Systems with Time-Based Indices
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This study presents two new metrics for gauging the effects of cyberattacks. Building a single, easy-to-use platform to evaluate the effects of cyber intrusions on various vital infrastructures across time is its primary goal. The primary metric is the "Service Unavailability Cyber Impact Factor", which may take on values between zero and one; zero signifies a cyber catastrophe and one shows no breach. Accurate information on system downtime or failure is necessary for score estimation. For systems where comprehensive cyber-physical infrastructure details are lacking, it may be used for analysis. A second indicator, "Time Based Cyber Impact Factor (TBCIF)," is similar to SUCIF in that it employs a graph-based problematic node identification approach to compute the score point. An important factor in determining the impact score is the ideal and predicted times for invasion detection. If the physical or cyber layer architecture of the test system is understood, then this index will work. This study assesses the effect of hacking on the UPG and the AOGC using the SUCIF index. Various IEEE test systems have used TBCIF scores to compare the intrusion effect, lending credence to the score. The smart grid network follows this index more closely.

articleTitle: 5G Applications Using High Gain Broadband 2x 2 MIMO-Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Fifth Generation has become the most trending topic to be researched in the field of wireless communication. This paper has worked on 5G MIMO antenna for compact structure, high gain & wide bandwidth. The proposed design consist of two input & two output ports and each port consist of 10 arbitrarily shaped patches arranged in tapered type of array. The complete designing& simulation is performed on CST-Microwave studio. With the help of software, in this paper different characteristics parameter has been calculated. The proposed design is able to achieve broadband from 27.446 GHz to 30.518 GHz which is around 3.072 GHz bandwidth. From the results, for the entire bandwidth from 27.446 to 30.518 return loss is better than -10 dB, VSWR is less than 2:1, gain is higher than 13 dBi, ECC is less than 0.0018, TARC is shifted for the different excitation angle and CCL is less than 0.3 bit/s/Hz. Lastly, in this paper proposed design is compared with previous research papers.

articleTitle: Enhancing Automated Diabetes Diagnosis by the Use of More Advanced Spectral Characteristics in Heart Rate Readings
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Biomedical signals may reveal body component function. Basic biological signals are unpredictable and irregular. This makes temporal data from such signals is difficult to get via observation. Signal processing technologies have been used to extract meaningful information from these signals. so many illnesses may be found and identified. Technology that is non-invasive and beneficial Its high anomaly detection accuracy may help physicians identify and treat patients. control many illnesses. Machine learning was formerly the standard for bio analysis of signals from processes. Currently, deep learning approaches are applied. ECG signals show how the ANS maintains a regular heartbeat. ECG signals are non-linear and unrelated to nature. Some disorders may be more effectively diagnosed using ECG analysis. Diabetes, a serious condition, may be detected by an ECG. Diabetes is incurable. Diabetes may lead to cardiovascular disease, renal disease, and stroke if not effectively managed with medicine and insulin. Early diagnosis improves diabetic management. This thesis aims to illustrate that electrocardiogram (ECG) heart rate variability (HRV) values can detect diabetes. More sophisticated spectral (HOS) properties are required for the interpretation of non-linear HRV data. This research combines regular and diabetic ECG data to uncover HRV-generated HOS characteristics. These collected attributes were given to seven classification algorithms, including naive bayes, SVM, and others. Classifier performance was measured by accuracy, positive prediction value, sensitivity, and specificity. The results are compared to other methods and two parameters of the at its peak, the classifier using SVM achieves a predictive value (PPV) of 98.3% and a specificity rating of 98.4%, with an accuracy of 86.5%.

articleTitle: A Decentralized Application for Car Rentals: Towards Blockchain Application
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Revolutionizing the car rental industry, the innovative decentralized application (DApp) for car rental utilizes the transformative capabilities of blockchain technology. The DApp streamlines operations and empowers users with increased control by removing the need for traditional intermediaries. By implementing smart contracts on a decentralized blockchain, users can confidently engage in rental transactions knowing that the technology's tamper-proof nature ensures their security. The DApp also provides real-time tracking features, allowing users to monitor vehicle status and location at all times, which benefits both renters and providers in terms of convenience and fleet management. he utilization of blockchain guarantees that all rental activities, from initial transactions to contract agreements and vehicle returns, are securely and immutably recorded. Transparency and security are integral to the DApp's design, promoting trust among users and reducing potential disputes or fraudulent activities. Furthermore, the decentralized nature of blockchain ensures data integrity by safeguarding against unauthorized modifications. By creating a trustless environment and eliminating intermediaries, this DApp enhances the efficiency of rental operations, promoting accessibility and inclusivity. With its secure and globally accepted platform, the DApp aims to redefine the standard for car rental services.

articleTitle: Assessing the Participation of Villagers in a Participatory Rural Appraisal Based Study: An Amrita Live-In-Labs® Project Case Study
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Participatory Rural Appraisal (PRA) is a key methodology in the socially inclusive development of Indian rural communities. Even though there are various organizations and government agencies involved in the ’real’ implementation of PRA for identifying the root causes and solutions of poverty, health issues, societal imbalance, and so on, the actual participation of the beneficiaries in the process is still a question mark. In this paper, we try to analyse the effect of actual participation of the people from the local community in the application of some PRA tools to do surveys and identify the root cause of the economic backwardness, and societal imbalance in a rural village in the state of Maharashtra, India. Most of the similar projects are done by management or social science students/researchers/scientists. In this paper, the analysis is done and presented from an engineer’s perspective. This project is part of the Live-in-Labs<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup> project of Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham to encourage students to live and interact with society and to learn and solve the community’s problems. In this paper, we try to explain the various levels of complexities faced during the study, with an emphasis on both failed and succeeded steps. We believe this paper supports practitioners and policymakers who are working towards improving the methodologies and approaches involved in PRA to ensure an inclusive and holistic community integrated development in rural India.

articleTitle: Elderly Healthcare IoT through Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Health sector is one of the important foundations of nation. The nation will stand if people get enough health facilities in normal as well as emergency level. The increase in the cost of medical treatments, the upsurge of last stage disease detection, delay in getting the treatments or right treatment and increasing population. Every stage of living being is important, but major concerns are about the elder ones the aged population. The aged old are getting helpless without care and medical facilities on the other side is the tremendous costing of medical facility. This balance is tried and maintained by the Healthcare Internet of things framework using Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics. The sensors and artificial intelligence are not only tracking the health data but also providing the safety and predictions for further coming health scenarios. The different algorithms like rule-based classification, recurrent neural networks are used to detect and prevent the diseases whose dataset is used for the same purpose.

articleTitle: AI-Generated Privacy-Preserving Protocols for Cross-Cloud Data Sharing and Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence into cross-cloud data-sharing frameworks opens up completely new vistas for novelty in preserving privacy while at the same time increasing collaborative efficiencies. This project closely examines designing and implementing AI-generated protocols that protect sensitive data privacy exchanged between heterogeneous cloud environments. These would be the protocols using machine learning algorithms for runtime vulnerability and risk detection, dynamic flow encryption, and predefined privacy policies. This research would be based on leveraging federated learning and differential privacy techniques to ensure that the best way to optimize shared model accuracy is to follow all data protection regulation compliances. The empirical results indicate that the proposed protocol metrics outperform the state-of-the-art methods in maintaining data integrity, minimizing leakage risks, and enhancing data interoperability in a multi-cloud architecture. It contributes toward bettering secure collaboration processes across various verticals, including healthcare, finance, and telecommunications. The study further underlines the importance of AI-driven solution imperatives toward strengthening data privacy across distributed cloud systems.

articleTitle: Developing and Securing Trust-Aware Routing Protocols: Integrity-Proofing and Authentication In WSN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Integrity Proofing Trust Aware Routing Protocol (IPTARP) is a protocol that improves network security by verifying nodes and relays via the use of Cluster Head Proactive Key Authentication Standard (CHPK). As a result, the current protocols are contrasted with the projected NSSR's strategically secure real-time trust-aware routing, which offers the objective of enhancing security while preserving efficiency and has the potential to excel in safeguarding data integrity. The overall conclusion of this research is that it contributes significant role in the advancement of wireless sensor WSN (wireless sensor network) technology, which ensures the best efficiency and improved safety in many aspects of daily life in contemporary society. Traditional routing protocols that have been in existence Compared with NPBNS, and NSSR, the proposed IPTARP: Integrity Proofing Trust Aware Routing Protocol IPTARP, which shows a significant enhancement in the area of safe routing and quite best since it was not limited to exploring new boundaries or expanding the corporation’s customer base, but it was an important step in ensuring the corporation was practicing safe routing. That is, an accuracy of 95%, which gives clear evidence of its effectiveness, maintaining confidence and reliability of routing information in a network, is a identification of enhanced capacity in the demonstration of these capabilities.

Author Keywords: CHPK Other indicators include Delivery Ratio

articleTitle: The Role of Data-Driven Strategies in Enhancing Marketing Effectiveness Within the Personal Care Segment of the Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The research paper explores the importance of data-driven marketing strategies in improving promotional effectiveness and consumer engagement within the personal care segment of the fast-moving consumer goods industry. In our research work, we have used primary data collected from 40 respondents and the study inculcated cluster analysis and conjoint analysis to segmentation of the consumer base and identify key marketing attributes that influence brand perception and purchase behavior also, the research paper employed the Balanced Scorecard (B.S.C.) framework for the practical evaluation of the strategic alignment of these strategies with performance metrics of the organization. The findings of the work indicate that when adopting given marketing strategies, we get a 30% increase in consumer satisfaction and a 20% improvement in R.O.I. of campaigns, also we provided recommendations to optimize marketing effectiveness, leveraging consumer insights that are advanced, nuanced and aligned them with business KPIs.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms for Fake Currency Detection: A Probabilistic Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: With the increasing rate of counterfeit currency in the market, the need for efficient fake currency detection systems has become essential. The circulation of fake currency poses a great threat to the stability of financial systems and affects the integrity of economies worldwide. This project presents a comparison on the application of five distinct machine learning algorithms—Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine (SVM), k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Gradient Boost Classifier, and Naive Bayes—in the development of a fake currency detection system. The aim of the this project is to examine the accuracy and other evaluation criteria of these models’ performance in identifying counterfeit money. Leveraging a probabilistic approach, Logistic Regression models the likelihood of a banknote being counterfeit based on extracted visual and texture features from currency images. SVM's ability to operate effectively in high-dimensional spaces makes it particularly suitable for our diverse dataset, accommodating various features crucial for accurate detection.
