K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), a proximity-based algorithm, is utilized to classify banknotes by considering the characteristics of their nearest neighbors in the feature space. The Gradient Boost Classifier is employed as it adapts to complex relationships within the dataset, making it well-suited for finding difficult or complicated patterns of counterfeit banknotes. Naive Bayes models the conditional probability of a banknote being counterfeit given its features, offering a computationally efficient solution for real-time detection scenarios. The Gradient Boost Classifier, which obtains the 99% as highest accuracy of the five models, is demonstrated to be effective by the experimental findings.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid Clustering Method for Secured Cross-Layer and Cross-Domain Routing in Dense Wsns
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Discovering a method that would allow the networks to last for a longer period of time is one of the utmost grave problems in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN). It is necessary to model method that is efficient in order to conserve limited power assets that are available for the Wireless Sensors Network. One solution to these issues is the use of cross-layer rules, which are designed to improve the efficiency of routing while additionally extending the lifetime of the network. An innovative model that allows the routing of data across layers and domains is revealed, and subsequently the model is optimized for use in safe clustered inside vast wireless networks of sensor. A unique hybrid technique that combines features of Moth Flame Optimization (MFO) and Dragonfly Algorithm (DA) is presented in this study. The purpose of this strategy is to improve the effectiveness of a density wireless sensor. A comparison of the effectiveness of the suggested model with five other standard techniques is presented in the last section. We examine the impacts on the network over a lengthy period of time, as well as the analysis of living nodes, divided into three distinct groups: normal nodes, evolved nodes, and superior nodes. In terms of both the assessment of whether or not a node is alive and the longevity of the network, we discover that the technique that was provided gives satisfactory results. When compared to Adaptive Lion Optimization Protocol (ALOP), Genuine Grey Wolf Search Optimization (GGWSO), and Adaptive Whale Optimization Algorithm (AW-WOA), the Moth Flame Integrated Dragonfly Algorithm (MFI-DA) technique proposes achieves the highest level of accuracy, which is 96%.

articleTitle: Blockchain and ICT For Strategic Integration Of ESG Compliance And Financial Innovation In The Banking Sector: A Pathway To Enhanced E-Governance And Government Transparency
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This study explores the strategic integration of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) compliance with financial innovation in the banking sector. It mainly emphasizes the transformative role of blockchain and Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) in e-Governance and governmental operations. Banks mainly navigate an increasingly complex regulatory landscape and heightened expectations for sustainability. However, the adoption of innovative digital technologies has emerged as a crucial driver in order to achieve ESG objectives and to enhance operational efficiency. Basically, this research examines how blockchain and ICT can facilitate transparent, secure, and efficient ESG compliance and financial innovation. This study is based on a mixed-method approach that includes data analysis, case studies, and expert interviews. The study identifies key enablers and barriers to this integration. The outcomes reveal that blockchain technology enhances data transparency and security. Whereas, ICT solutions improve regulatory compliance and reporting efficiency. The study also outlines a framework for banks to adopt these technologies effectively with both strategic and operational perspectives. Recommendations are provided for policymakers and financial institutions to nurture a more sustainable and innovative banking environment. This research contributes to the knowledge of how digital transformation can support the banking sector’s commitment to sustainability and innovation.

articleTitle: Recognition Of Obstreperous Sleep Apnea And Cardiovascular Diseases Using Machine And Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This study examines the SHHS database and analyses and contrasts the performance of several ML and DL techniques for OSA and CVD detection. The dataset is primarily focused on diagnosing sleep apnea and associated breathing disorders, as well as evaluating the potential influence of sleep apnea on cardiovascular events. It contains polysomnography recordings from over 6,000 people. The current study evaluated ten top-notch ML and DL models, including SVM, DT, RF, NB, ANN, 1D-Convolutional Neural Networks (1D-CNN), ResNet, ResNet-100, ResNet-50, and ResNet-18 as well as Artificial Neural Networks (ANN). They suggested a 50:80:20 split for training and testing; however we evaluated the models with data splits ranging from 50:80:20 to see how well they predicted CVD risks in OSA patients. When compared to the other ML models, DT's 86.5 accuracy and 84.4 sensitivity were the best. Similarly, ResNet101 surpassed competing DL models, with an accuracy of 85% and a sensitivity of 85.5%.

articleTitle: Employee Performance Measurement Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Employee performance measurement is a critical aspect of organizational management, aiming to assess and improve the productivity, efficiency, and effectiveness of employees. With the advancement of technology, machine learning (ML) has emerged as a powerful tool in enhancing how organizations measure and manage employee performance. This work implements three machine learning models such as Support Vector Classifier (SVC), Random Forest (RF) and Multi Layered Perceptron (MLP). The training accuracy of support vector classifier model 97.63% and testing accuracy is 95.15%. The training accuracy of Random Forest model 100% and testing accuracy is 92.25%. The training accuracy of MLP model 99.63% and testing accuracy is 96.61%. This clearly shows that MLP model performs better in this case with highest accuracy.

articleTitle: Advanced Algorithm for Cardiac Arrhythmia Classification and Efficient Detection of Abnormalities in ECG Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: High-Performance Algorithm for Cardiac Arrhythmias Classification and ECG Abnormality Detection Aspecific heart rhythms that are not found upon initial examinations, often lead to heart failure and stroke. Arrhythmias have to be diagnosed early through precise classification of ECG signals. Conventional methods employ ineffective and tedious manual intervention in interpreting the time series and the filtering of noise. To boot, we apply intricate deep learning and the Superlet Transform (SLT) for detection’s automation and enhancement. A superior time-frequency analysis tool, the SLT, transforms 1D ECG signals into 2D spectrograms to identify transient oscillation phenomena such as arrhythmias with higher resolution than STFT and CWT. SLT spectrograms are classified by deep Convolutional Neural Networks. This duty is accomplished by some advanced CNN models such as AlexNet, GoogLeNet, DenseNet-201.Due to the flexibility of information flow and gradient propagation in DenseNet-201, it achieves a high accuracy of classification. There are three classes of ECG signals, namely, healthy heart, atrial fibrillation, and ventricular fibrillation. The model is tested and demonstrated in various ECG database such as MIT-BIH arrhythmia and AF termination challenge. This method simplifies the hardware by the removal of various noise reduction processes and enables real-time monitoring of heart rates. The utilization of SLT and deep CNN models for early detection of cardiac arrhythmia is current trends that enhance clinical diagnosis and accurate results.

articleTitle: Exploring Self-Supervised Learning Architectures for Image Processing: Milestones and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) is a deep learning paradigm, having the capacity to learn from unlabeled datasets. SSL has demonstrated effectiveness in various applications of computer vision and image processing. The study examines milestone advancements in SSL methodologies applied to image processing, with particular attention to datasets, pretext tasks and different architectures that have been implemented to perform representation learning from unlabeled data. The persistent challenges in SSL are also discussed. Newer models, such as DINOv2 and iBOT, along with hybrid approaches has offered improvements in feature extraction and task adaptability. As per the current trends, the domain of SSL has the potential to revolutionize image processing, by enabling more efficient and accurate training of model without extensive labeled data.

articleTitle: Deep Learning For Improved Diabetes Detection: Integrating Lstm, Convolutional Neural Networks And Svm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Diabetes is one among the eminent anomalies which can be identified using ECG derived signal. This implies that if diabetes is not adequately managed with medications /insulin support it is likely to escalate into severe complicated diseases such as stroke, kidney failure, and heart attack. Early diagnosis of diabetes is also important in the management of the condition. The overall purpose of this thesis is to discover approaches to identify diabetes employing heart rate variability (HRV) signals as measured by deep learning such that to achieve very high level of correctness in the detection process. From the comparison of accuracies, CNN 1 - SVM begins at 68. 4%, while CNN 2 - SVM improves to 75. CNN 3 – SVM cast further has the highest accuracy of 93 percent. On the other hand, when we incorporate LSTM with SVM, the network configuration of CNN 1- LSTM - SVM results in an accuracy of 74. 2%, which is slightly higher than the CNN 1 –SVM. CNN 2 - LSTM - SVM further improves the accuracy to 76. 4% while and the highest accuracy is observed with CNN 3 - LSTM - SVM at 95.7%. In most cases, a combination of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and support vector machine (SVM) provides a better accuracy over the various models.

articleTitle: Synergistic Integration of Rough Set Theory and Fuzzy Metric Spaces for Enhanced Decision-Making in Uncertain Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Decision-making under uncertainty is a critical challenge in various fields, including healthcare, finance, and industrial automation. Traditional decision-making models often struggle to handle the inherent vagueness and imprecision in real-world data. This paper proposes a novel framework that integrates Rough Set Theory (RST) and Fuzzy Metric Spaces (FMS) to address these challenges. By combining the granularity of RST with the nuanced expressiveness of FMS, our approach enhances the accuracy and reliability of decisions made under uncertain conditions.By leveraging the strengths of RST in handling imprecise information and the capabilities of FMS in modelling vagueness and partial truth, our approach provides a robust mechanism for decision-making. We validate our framework using real-world datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness in diverse applications such as medical diagnosis, financial forecasting, and industrial process control. Experimental results show significant improvements in accuracy, robustness, and interpretability, underscoring the potential of this hybrid approach in tackling complex decision-making problems.The Fuzzy-Rough Decision Support System (FRDSS) is an advanced decision-making platform developed from the integrated concepts of Rough Set Theory (RST) and Fuzzy Metric Spaces (FMS). This system leverages the analytical strengths of RST in managing imprecise information and the nuanced capabilities of FMS in modelling vagueness and partial truth. Designed to handle real-world scenarios where data is often incomplete and uncertain, FRDSS offers a comprehensive solution for a range of applications, including healthcare, finance, and industrial automation.

articleTitle: CulturalEcho and Educator App for Tourists
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Language barriers frequently stand in the way of successful communication in a society where languages are widely spoken. Moreover, the limited availability of educational resources on Indian history and culture hinders learning and cross-cultural exchange. The CulturalEcho AR Translator employs augmented reality (AR) technology to facilitate real-time translation of text written in Indian languages when viewed through a device’s camera. The system utilizes Optical Character Recognition (OCR) technology to identify the text in Indian languages and translates it into English. Users can quickly comprehend and interact with the content in English. Additionally, the application features a comprehensive content management system that includes a diverse collection of multimedia, historical, and cultural articles and images about India. The AR interface enables users to explore this educational archive, fostering interactive learning experiences enriched with cultural insights. The inclusion of a chatbot further enhances the experience by providing assistance and information, addressing user questions related to translations and cultural topics. The system employs authentication methods, including verified language databases sourced from reputable language authorities and government entities, to ensure the accuracy and legitimacy of translations. Additionally, it offers virtual tours of popular tourist attractions and historical landmarks to enhance the customer experience. With interactive 3D models and panoramas, users can explore historical sites and learn about their significance, deepening their understanding of Indian heritage and culture.

articleTitle: Enhancing Home Security Using Internet Of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The rapid expansion of technology has led to considerable breakthroughs in home security, particularly through the integration of the Internet of Things (IoT). IoT offers seamless connection between devices, allowing for increased surveillance, automated systems, and real-time monitoring. This study addresses the role of IoT in improving home security, covering existing solutions, major technologies, difficulties, and future perspectives. With the increasing popularity of smart home devices, knowing how IoT may be exploited to build safer living environments is vital. This research highlights innovative applications, discusses related works, and explains potential barriers, providing a thorough overview of the current state and future possibilities of IoT in home security.

articleTitle: Advances in Big Data and Data Mining: Techniques and Applications in Data Fusion for Enhanced Insights and Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Big data's explosive growth has transformed several businesses by making it possible to glean insightful information from big, complex databases. This study examines new developments in big data and data mining methods, concentrating on data fusion as a means of improving decision-making. Data fusion, the act of combining many data sources to get more accurate and thorough insights, is becoming essential in industries including cybersecurity, healthcare, finance, and marketing. The study looks at how cutting-edge data mining methods, such as anomaly detection, classification, and clustering, might increase the efficiency of data fusion. Important issues are also covered, including managing heterogeneous data, guaranteeing data quality, and scalability. This paper shows how data fusion approaches may enhance decision-making processes by offering more comprehensive perspectives and useful insights via an analysis of real-world applications. The paper's conclusion discusses potential future developments, emphasising how machine learning and artificial intelligence may be used to improve data mining and fusion procedures, potentially leading to even higher levels of precision and effectiveness in decision-making across a range of industries.

articleTitle: Blockchain Technology and Smart Contracts for Transformative Energy Trading
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The trend in renewable energy calls for safe peer-to-peer(P2P)energy trading in a microgrid. Blockchain technology (BCT) addresses this by providing a secure, tamper-proof ledger that enables transparent and sustainable energy exchange. This paper explores how smart contracts can make energy trading more efficient for microgrid users while securely recording all transactions for easy verification. The architecture designed for these smart contracts ensures reliable mechanisms such as simultaneous submission of bids, user registration, order placement and sorting, and automatic execution of the trading system. The proposed smart contract-based energy trading system improves energy efficiency and flexibility while supporting decentralized control within the microgrid. BCT directly contributes to the Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 7 (Affordable and Clean Energy) by promoting this technology, increasing renewable energy in the global energy mix, and improving energy efficiency. Furthermore, BCT supports SDG 9 by creating a resilient and sustainable infrastructure through technological innovation. This paper provides a detailed analysis of the P2P trading scenario, smart contract pseudocode, and visualization of the smart contract implementation in Solidity, aiming to navigate the real-world application of P2P energy markets.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Resonating Rhythms of Regulations and Resources in Business Management
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This research introduces the "Regulatory Resource Synchronization and Optimi-zation (RRSO) Framework," a novel perspective on regulations and how they effect business managers’ resource utilization. Computer programs can predict how humans will obey laws, use resources efficiently, and consider morality. These programs allow for ethical, economic, and legal resource allocation. The RRSO Framework was compared to ten other methods, including RIAs, compliance au-dits, cost-benefit analyses, ethical impact assessments, resource allocation mod-els, EIAs, compliance scorecards, stakeholder analyses, RegTech, and scenario plans, to see which worked best. The research measured success by accuracy, fu-ture prediction, resource optimization, compliance, budgeting, following regula-tions, and ethics. Results demonstrate the RRSO Framework outperforms alter-native techniques in several areas. It excels in morals, precision, forethought, economy, and rules. The higher mean scores reflect how complete and adaptable the RRSO Framework is.

articleTitle: An Adoption of Zero-Trust Technique in Hierarchical WSNs - A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Several studies have reported a growing challenge of sophisticated denial-of-service (DoS) and persistent threatsin hierarchical wireless networks. These attacks expose critical organizational data and network resources to unauthorized access. The most adopted perimeter defense security model is unable to defend against these sophisticated security challenges in WSNs. The zero-trust technique is the most preferred in wireless networks to secure sensitive data. This model uses ‘never trust, always verify’ principle. This article reviews and analyzes various wireless sensor networks hierarchical routing protocols and lightweight authentication techniques in relation to the zerotrust technique. This work highlights key causes of migration from traditional defense technique to zero-trust technique. This article highlights the zero-trust technique key elements and examines its adoption rate by different computing fields. Andlastly, we identify the common challenges and propose future techniques for effective adoption of zero-trust technique.

articleTitle: Exploratory Data Analysis and Algorithmic Comparison for Early Depression Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Early depression detection is very significant for timely intervention and treatment in mental health. This study introduced an extensive system for the early detection of depression, utilizing basic experimentation and analysis techniques. The system is built upon the ‘Detailed_PHQ8_Labels.csv’ dataset, derived from the ‘Extended Distress Analysis Interview Corpus (E-DAIC)’. The dataset contains responses to eight key questions from the ‘Patient Health Questionnaire (PHQ-8), covering symptoms such as ‘No Interest’, ‘Depressed’, ‘Sleep’, ‘Tired’, ‘Appetite’, ‘Failure’, 'Concentrating', and ‘Moving’. The proposed methodology used a ‘thresholding technique’ on the PHQ-8 total score to classify depression into four categories: minimal or no depression, early signs of depression, moderate depression, and moderate to severe depression. This study is based on various algorithms of ‘Machine Learning’ and ‘Deep Learning’. Additionally, the study includes advanced technology for multimodal, such as an ‘Ensemble Model (LSRG)’ and late fusion techniques to improve accuracy. This study focused on the ability to combine traditional thresholding methods with advanced ‘Machine Learning’ and ‘Deep Learning’ algorithms for the early detection of depression. It proposed a robust framework for further development in mental health diagnostics in the medical field.

articleTitle: Aerial Surveillance Land Classification using Global Sum Pooling in CNNs: A Study on EuroSAT Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Global sum pooling (GSP) is a recent pooling approach in neural networks that provides an alternative method for feature aggregation. In this work, we explore the applicability of GSP to various deep-learning tasks, paying special attention to satellite-image classification on the EuroSAT dataset. GSP sums all the feature map values while maintaining full intensities of activations, whereas conventional pooling techniques, such as max-pooling and Global Average Pooling (GAP), pay greater emphasis to extreme values and averaged summaries. This property is uniquely valuable in applications, for example, land use classification for satellite photography, where the total strength of features matters. This paper evaluates the effectiveness of GSP by conducting heavy experimentation on the EuroSAT dataset, which showed a great potential in improving model accuracy robustness, and capabilities of generalization. The authors show that GSP outperforms traditional pooling methods, especially in scenarios where the difference in features makes a huge difference. Therefore, it emphasizes the integration of GSP in Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and how it performs its functions in a flexible and beneficial manner compared to other modern deep learning architectures associated with remote sensing and satellite imagery.

articleTitle: VaLiDiFy – Certificate Validation using Blockchain and AI
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The latest data demonstrates that 34% of resumes, 5% of academic certificates, and 23% of job applications in South Asian countries contain anomalies. The non-verification rate of academic certificates is found to be around 12.9% in certain developed countries. This emphasizes the issues pertaining to fraud with respect to certificate verification. The above figures demonstrate the need for a secure system that maintains the trust and transparency of credentials. To resolve this, we offer a robust solution that is based on Blockchain Technology for certificate validation by combining features of AI and advanced machine learning algorithms to enhance the verification process and thereby reduce credential fraud. The AI system detects anomalies or tampering attempts within each block; it also analyzes the pattern in block data, then verifies consistency and identifies suspicious changes, which may indicate manipulation of data. The user database is maintained through MongoDB. When compared to other approaches, the emphasis is on robustness through established cryptographic methods, which maintains its own secure database of hashes. Such an integration of technologies results in this cohesive system, ensuring efficient and secure digital certificate management as a scalable and adaptable solution. The focus on fundamental elements of blockchain makes it distinct when compared to more complex or isolated methods in other existing research works.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Strategies for Enhancing Indonesian Batik Export
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Batik is one of Indonesia’s export commodities with great potential for growth. It holds deep cultural value that is appreciated by the global market. However the data shows that Indonesian batik exports have been decreasing over time. This research focuses on exploring the patterns of batik exports to analyze the potential opportunities in the global market. The KNN algorithm is used to cluster export data and identify the characteristics of eacg market segment. The result shows four distinct clusters: high-value markets with exceptional export volumes and values, medium-sized markets with consistent demand and growth potential, and small-scale markets with limited contributions but significant opportunities for expansion. These findings highlight the unique features of each segment and provide insight into creating targeted strategies to improve the position of Indonesian batik in the global market. This research suppport better decision-making for stakeholders and offers a data-driven approach to enhance the competitiveness of Indonesia’s batik Industry.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality for Real Estate: Revolutionizing Property Visualization and Enhancing Client Engagement
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Modern Virtual Reality with a huge impact on the ever-diversifying branches of this new digital economy, Virtual Reality is now such an integral part of our contemporary reality. Several factors – from decreasing component prices, fast technological market maturity to the easy availability of wide array of high-tech products that can leverage this new technology has made it a practical idea. In this article, we would like to address an investigation in the sense of what it is about establishing anything resembling a real estate management system using artificial intelligence and virtual reality technologies. At its core, this research centers around augmented reality and virtual reality applications and use cases for real estate. The panorama camera feature allows you to photograph an entire space in a 3D plane, which can then be stitched together resulting your viewer having the ability to look around within this room and view other events as they happen from his point of view. This allows for the option of presenting content in an entirely new light. Although 360-degree camera can shoot in better quality, not all of the people have it so scanning with smartphone is enough. This application indicates that virtual reality enriches the understanding and increases clients’ intention to purchase, while the manipulation of virtual reality content remains as an important factor affecting both clients’ satisfaction towards future housing sales, as well as developer’s acceptance.

articleTitle: Scalable Ddos Attack Detection in Cloud Computing Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In a Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) assault, hackers sneakily insert malicious data packets into client networks' internet traffic, causing a catastrophic outage for end users in a cloud computing environment. This is a major issue with cloud computing as detecting and mitigating intrusions is a difficult operation that will impact the whole architecture's functioning. In order to construct machine learning algorithms that can correctly and efficiently detect intrusions, rigorous literature studies are conducted to explore different machine learning approaches, neural network models, and optimization algorithms. The goal is to discover any gaps or flaws and then create these algorithms. Intrusion detection tactics based on Back Propagation Neural (BPN) and Multi-layer Perceptron (MLP) are created in the ANN model to identify DDoS. This paper proposes a hybrid optimization method that combines the exploration and exploitation capabilities of PSO and HHO in order to achieve performance. The suggested hybrid optimiser successfully addresses the drawbacks of traditional algorithms, including the problems of local stagnation, delayed convergence, and optimum trapping of both the local and global levels. The neural network models' weight and bias variables are fine-tuned using the suggested hybrid Harris Hawks Optimization and Particle Swarm Optimization (HHO-PSO) method, which is also used for feature selection. The suggested technique, HHO-PSO with BPN, has a 95.73 percent success rate. When compared to MLP, BPN, and HHO-PSO with MLP, alternative approaches exhibit poorer accuracy, precision, and recall levels that are reflected by their respective F1 ratings. The suggested hybrid method, on the other hand, shows that it is more effective than these models.

articleTitle: Efficient Detection of DDoS Attacks in E-Government Clouds Using Sparse Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: E-government (Electronic Government) refers to the use of information and communication technology (ICT) by governmental bodies to provide public services, manage government operations, and facilitate communication with citizens, businesses, and other government entities. E-government platforms have expanded significantly in recent years, offering a range of services such as online tax filing, license renewals, healthcare services, and more. These services, often hosted on cloud-based infrastructures, benefit from improved scalability, efficiency, and accessibility through the use of cloud computing technologies. However, the growing volume of legitimate traffic from a diverse range of users on e-government platforms makes distinguishing between normal and malicious traffic, such as DDoS (Distributed Denial of Service) attacks, increasingly difficult. To address this challenge, this manuscript proposes the use of Sparse Neural Networks (SNN) for DDoS attack detection in cloud-based e-government systems. Initially, data from the CSE-CIC-IDS2018 dataset is collected and processed through a feature selection phase. The selected features are selected using the Energy Valley Optimizer. These optimized features are fed into the Sparse Neural Network, which categorizes traffic as benign, DDoS, or DoS. To further enhance the accuracy of DDoS detection, the Ladybug Beetle Optimization (LBOA) is employed to optimize the Sparse Neural Network's parameters, ensuring optimal performance in classifying attacks. This approach aims to safeguard cloud-based e-government systems from cyber threats while maintaining reliable public service delivery. In comparison to current methods such as data clustering for the detection of DDoS attacks in the cloud for e-government (DBSCAN), e-government impact factor analysis cleverly using enhanced machine learning (ML-EGOV), and Problems with Machine Learning in Cloud Computing E-Government Models in Developing Nations, the proposed DCNN-QSA-PDOA method achieves 17.43%, 8.44%, and 11.64% higher accuracy, respectively.

articleTitle: Recent and Future Automotive Applications and Technology in Sustainable Supply Chain Management Logistics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Using up-to-the-moment information on traffic patterns in the city, intelligent transportation systems (ITS) aim to give users actionable advice on how to reduce their carbon footprint without sacrificing the efficiency with which they navigate the roads. The transportation industry increasingly relies on cloud computing services for tasks like processing, communication, and storage, and this has increased the load on the systems monitoring traffic. Modern ITS includes dynamic pricing, which enables more efficient and cost-effective management of problems like congestion control and peak load reduction. Both conventional and alternative fuel transportation can benefit from dynamic pricing. Cutting down on unnecessary travel time and gas use is one way to make people more eco-aware in our society. There has been a long-standing problem with developing dynamic pricing structures for ITS. Longer waiting times, more air and noise pollution, wasted electricity, and other resources are all possible results of inefficient vehicle management. However, it is possible that both service providers and users may benefit from well-implemented dynamic pricing models. A thorough transition from conventional to sustainable supply chains has long been underway in several industries. One of the biggest and most significant industries in the world, the automotive sector, could significantly affect the shift to a sustainable society. The report concludes by outlining research gaps, offering suggestions for additional study, and offering a helpful framework for creating a sustainable automotive supply chain.

articleTitle: Optimized BIGRU-Attention Network for OSA and Cardiovascular Disease Prediction with Risk Factor Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Cardiac illness is a rapidly rising worldwide killer. The development of an automated prediction framework for OSA-related cardiovascular problems is tough given that to the extensive information needed to effectively forecast heart illness. Several algorithms have been developed for use in IoT-based medical oversight systems, which utilize sensor data to identify ailments specifically.We deploy new learning models to improve prediction results. The existing methods lack the ability to forecast accurately, making them unsuitable for successful diagnosis. This study proposes BGEAN, a revolutionary framework that combines deep learning with computing devices to identify cardiac issues accurately. Data are pre-processed utilizing Studentized Residual Methods to address missing values and outliers. Improved Gated Recurrent Neural Networks help classify pre-processed data as normal or abnormal. Thorough testing and comparison to top deep learning techniques are conducted. Performance indicators, such as accuracy (99.99%), recall (99.35%), specificity (90.12%), precision (99.5), F1-score (99.99%), and Model Building Time (MBT) (0.212sec), are computed. The findings show that the technology that was suggested surpassed current algorithms in accuracy, error, and reaction time. With its many user situations, BGEAN provides the most diverse environment for forecasting cardiac diseases.

articleTitle: Integrating Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) with Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC): Combining BB84 Protocol with Lattice-Based Cryptographic Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: As quantum computing technology advances, our traditional methods of securing information are becoming vulnerable to new types of attacks. To counter these threats, Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) methods like the BB84 protocol offer a way to create extremely secure keys. However, QKD alone can have practical limitations and might still be exposed to certain types of attacks. On the other hand, Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) provides a robust defense against quantum attacks through complex mathematical algorithms. This research aims to combine the best of both worlds: using the BB84 QKD protocol to generate secure keys and then using these keys with PQC algorithms for encrypting information. By integrating QKD for key generation and Lattice based (Kyber) PQC for encryption, we hope to create a cryptographic system that is both incredibly secure and practical for real-world use. This project will involve designing the hybrid system, testing it through simulations, and evaluating its performance and security against traditional methods.

articleTitle: Efficient Service Provisioning in Fog Computing for Multimodal Fall Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Our capstone project makes use of an actual-world app that can be efficiently managed by an Edge-Fog-Cloud system. Fall detection is an issue that we have taken up and aim to solve by providing decisions with the lowest feasible delay. We propose a three-stage process that makes use of multimodal data (sensors, video, and pictures). An edge device's convolutional neural network infers the visual data used for the first inference. To improve weight distribution and training speed, the neural network is constructed utilizing transfer learning. The optical flow method removes the background noise and focuses just on the individual by representing moving objects as vector fields. A condensed neural network is able to operate on a resource-constrained edge device. After that, the sensor data is classified by the fog layer using SVM, Random Forest (RF) and Gradient Boosting (XGBoost). The fog layer also uses visual and sensor data to make the ultimate fall judgment. The ensemble decision-making process relies on the inferences drawn from the fog and edge layers to arrive at this conclusion. Model construction and durable data storage are carried out at the cloud layer. For more accurate evaluations, our work also deals with false negative rates. To do this, we use augmentation of images on the misclassified photos; this improves the classification and adds value to the dataset. Last but not least, the suggested models are containerized for simple deployment, maintenance, and scalability. With an accuracy of 99%, the proposed technique surpassed all of its competitors, including SVM, XGBoost. Every approach has its advantages, but the Proposed technique clearly outperforms the others and is hence the best option for this specific job.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive survey on Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Facial emotion recognition is crucial for interaction between human & computer. This paper delves into understanding various methods and techniques used for emotion recognition. Moreover, this study goes beyond emotion recognition to enable real-time depression analysis by correlating detected emotions with potential indicators of mental health. This approach underscores the importance of comprehensive datasets and robust methodologies in advancing facial emotion recognition and its applications in mental health assessment, offering insights for future research in this evolving field.

articleTitle: Combined Cloud and Deep Learning Models for Enhanced Decision Support
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Cloud computing and deep learning are changing decision-support systems. This combination was driven by cloud computing and deep learning models’ complimentary data processing capabilities. Traditional decision-support systems typically fail due to the complexity and variety of current information, particularly unstructured and semi-structured data. Innovative methods are required to overcome this restriction and exploit big data’s immense potential. Cloud computing is essential for handling and storing huge amounts of data because to its design, scalability, and storage capacity. Company data is securely accessed, processed, and stored while being cost-effective and flexible. Deep learning models—a subset of AI—offer a great toolbox of neural networks and algorithms for analyzing complex data patterns. These models are versatile, train well, and can find patterns in unstructured data. However, ideal outcomes demand a lot of processing power. Deep learning and cloud computing operate together better than traditional decision-support systems. Instead of static, rule-based models, the decision-support system may now react to complicated, ever-changing data. Modern cloud-based algorithms enable organizations to make accurate, personalized choices in real time. These changes will affect healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and autonomous automobiles. Convergence causes actual concerns. Data security, privacy, and equality are key concerns. Cloud systems are difficult to balance between usability and safety. Since deep learning algorithms may be prejudiced and provide unfair outcomes, we must continue to promote fairness and transparency. Additional challenges to the effective implementation of these converged systems include controlling scalability, ensuring compliance with laws, and addressing interoperability.

articleTitle: Computational Geometry and its Applications in Advanced Algorithm Design
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Computational geometry improves numerous processes. Mathematics and computer science underpin this strategy. This abstract discusses computational geometry's importance and how it may address new math challenges. Geometric notions are employed in numerous ways to constrain space. Examples include Delaunay triangulation, convex Hull techniques, spatial splitting, and Voronoi diagrams. Some line overlap methods can find multidimensional data. This may be utilized in R-tree spatial sorting and CAD. Robotics and shape analysis often employ form centers and medians. The proposed approach has all of these properties, making it a flexible method for problem-solving. Because of its versatility, we propose the R-tree-based technique. People are continually creating and discovering new algorithms in computational geometry. This method can teach geography, build robots, and advance technology.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Automatic Answer Script Evaluation Using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In the current era of Automation, there is a growing need for automated systems to evaluate descriptive answer sheets more effectively. Manual grading has become labor intensive, time consuming and prone to make errors. While automated systems exist for objective and brief answers, but often lack in descriptive evaluation. The pre-processed system processes the scanned handwritten answer sheet, then using Optical Character Recognition (OCR) it converts the handwritten answer script images to Text. Finally using Natural language processing (NLP) techniques, including tokenization and word embeddings are used to analyze text based on keywords and length criteria provided by the moderator. A Feedforward artificial neural network (ANN) with back-propagation algorithm is used for classifying and recognition of the content. This System mainly focuses on accurate, consistent evaluation and feedback, reducing traditional manual efforts and to improve grading efficiency. The proposed model is providing higher accuracy level compare to existing method.

articleTitle: Optimized Dilated Convolutional Neural Network with Quantum Self-Attention Based on Hyper Spectral Remote Sensing Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Hyperspectral remote sensing (RS) involves capturing and analyzing data across numerous, narrow spectral bands in the electromagnetic spectrum. With this technology, it is possible to identify what has been on the Earth surface with unprecedented depth that cannot be done with the mere multispectral images. A Hyperspectral sensor is able to capture hundreds of bands of data, and is therefore able to distinguish between very small differences in surface materials that we cannot even see or conventional multispectral sensors. Hyperspectral remote sensing is widely used in applications like agriculture, environmental monitoring, geology, and defence. To overcome the limitations of current approaches, new strategies are needed. In this manuscript Optimized Dilated Convolutional Neural Network with Quantum Self-Attention Based on Hyper Spectral Remote Sensing Image Classification (DCNN-QSA-PDOA) is proposed. The Indian Pine dataset is where the data is first gathered. The multidirectional shearlet transform based feature extraction (MDST) model is then utilized to extract the hyperspectral image (HSI) features. Following the completion of the feature extraction procedure, the Dilated Convolutional Neural Network with Quantum Self-Attention (DCNN-QSA) is trained on the feature extracted images and used to classify the category information. Here, (PDOA) is utilized for tuning hyper parameters of DCNN-QSA. The proposed DCNN-QSA-PDOA method provides 37.23%, 18.74% and 24.84% higher accuracy compared with existing method like Classifying images from hyper spectral RS using a DCNN-HIS, Dense residual three-dimensional convolutional neural networks are used for hyper spectral RS picture classification (DR-3DCNN-HIS), Fully convolutional neural networks are used for the categorization of hyper spectral remote sensing pictures (CNN-HIS) respectively.

Author Keywords: Dilated Convolutional Neural Network with Quantum Self-Attention

articleTitle: Designing Biometric Automated Teller Machine: Opportunities and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The increasing sophistication of fraud in the financial sector, particularly in Automated Teller Machine (ATM) transactions, demands advanced security measures to protect users and their accounts. Despite the widespread use of Personal Identification Numbers (PINs), literature is replete with evidence that biometric authentication provides better security than PINs. However, a survey on ATMs around the globe shows that biometrics are not widely used for authentication compared to PINs. In an effort to close the gap, this paper presents a two-pronged approach to uncover the challenges and opportunities of their adaptation in Namibia. A literature survey was carried out to establish what is known and identify the gaps. Secondly, some semi-structured qualitative interviews were conducted with purposefully selected key personnel for banks in Namibia and law enforcement agencies to understand ATM security landscape in the country. From these two approaches, biometric designs used in authenticating ATM systems are discussed to unearth strengths and weaknesses that will guide the designing of secure biometric ATM systems. The researchers hope the findings will improve the adoption of biometric security systems, particularly in Namibia, where questionnaires and interviews were administered to ATM experts and the Police.

articleTitle: Energy Simulation and Analysis on Residential Buildings using BIM Tools
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The way in designing buildings is very important for energy usage. Several structures lack energy efficiency in their design, which leads to increased energy usage resulting in higher energy costs. While developing buildings, architects and builders should propose energy-efficient designs as their first priority. With Building Information Modeling, the energy efficiency of a traditional structure may be assessed to see where it stands currently and to look at the possibilities for improvement. Accounting for components like the Heating Ventilation and Air Condition system, lights, and equipment, this research helps in determining the building’s energy usage and costs. Building Information Modeling allows for effective decision-making and design processes as well as a comprehensive and coordinated approach to energy analysis. It also provides helpful information on the structure’s energy effectiveness. The results of the energy analysis can be used to make decisions about retrofit and upgrade projects, improve building operations, and encourage the adoption of sustainable building practices. This research highlights energy analysis for a building resulted in 20.8 USD/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/year for the consumed energy. By using energy optimization there is a scope to reduce this energy cost as per ASHRAE standards and the reduced cost of energy consumption is 8USD/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/year.

articleTitle: Neighborhood Selection for Secure and Efficient Data Transmission in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Various fields have recognized the significant relevance of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) for their effective data collection from the real environment. A major issue, however, is making sure that data gathering and transfer in WSNs are both secure and efficient. Therefore, current protocols are contrasted with the suggested NSSR's strategic secure real-time trust-aware routing, which seeks to improve security without sacrificing performance and may provide superior data integrity protection. Important metrics for evaluating these protocols include the following: throughput, packet delivery ratio, average amount of hops, end-to-end delay, failure to detect ratio, and false accusation ratio. At the end of the day, this study makes a big splash in the world of WSN advancements, which are crucial for maximizing performance and security in all kinds of applications. Impressively, NSSR achieved the greatest PDR at 96%, surpassing both FAEM (74%) and NPBNS (92%). This demonstrates its efficiency. With each passing iteration of the simulation, NSSR maintains its advantage in PDR. Among the three, NSSR continues to lead with the shortest End-to-End latency at 5.1 seconds, followed by FAEM at 9.0 seconds and NPBNS at 8.4 seconds. This effectiveness remains throughout the simulation, with NSSR continuing to efficiently detect problems while reducing the number of unfounded assertions. The NSSR indicating the best accuracy of 96% in decreasing false charges. Because of its track record of accurate problem identification, NSSR is a great option for WSN applications that need reliable network fault detection.

articleTitle: FitMate AI-Powered Fitness Companion: Revolutionizing Health and Wellness through Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: AI is changing the way people approach fitness and loses weight in the age of digital health, as well as giving recommendations that were only available from trainers and nutritionists before. FitMate is a Chatbot built to help users be fit with technology help, with an added advantage of using Artificial intelligence. It utilizes technologies like AI and Web development to recommend workouts, diet plans, and other health related questions via a user input options such as BMI, age, and fitness objectives. This paper aims to analyse the development, purpose and further possibilities of FitMate, alongside its significance within the context of advanced AI-fostered tools for fitness improvement.

articleTitle: Optimizing Cancer Forecasting with Cutting-Edge Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The needs of the machine learning domain are especially pressing in the medical field. The information as in the medical area is quite complicated, and in order to arrive at an accurate diagnosis, it is necessary to analyse many and diverse forms of data, making these needs all the more important. Because of the high stakes involved, areas like cancer detection need the highest levels of accuracy and dependability in the method of detection. The location of a tumour determines the kind of cancer that has developed. As a result, there is a great deal of variation in the parameters of different cancer types. The lung cancer values for prediction are established by the first contribution. The multi-model framework that this work provides may be utilized to effectively forecast lung cancer. The model's clustering techniques are a hybrid of Decision Tree and K-Means. The prediction process is enhanced by the varying degrees of integration between the two models. An efficient pre-treatment method is included into the model to offer a data purification The system with the basic data being acquired from real-time. Predicting how long the patient will survive levels is done using the decision tree framework, which is a form of regression. The accuracy analysis among the three methods indicates that the suggested method Decision Tree and K-Means based survival prediction (DKSP) markedly surpasses both the Decision Tree (DT) and K-Means techniques. The Decision Tree technique exhibits the lowest level of precision, although K-Means shows an improvement; nonetheless, it still fails to equal the effectiveness of the proposed approach. The DKSP model, achieving an accuracy of 99.23, exhibits an important enhancement, establishing it as the most proficient tool for cancer prediction among those evaluated.

articleTitle: Integrating Embedded Systems with Natural Language Processing: Innovations and Applications in Intelligent Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The amalgamation of Natural Language Processing (NLP) with Embedded Systems signifies a revolutionary progression in the creation of intelligent systems, permitting them to participate in interactions that are akin to those of humans. This study looks into the creative ways that NLP and embedded technology can be used in a variety of industries, such as healthcare, automotive, and smart homes. The paper illustrates how NLP enables embedded devices to comprehend, interpret, and react to human commands, improving user experience and operational efficiency, by looking at the underlying principles. The main obstacles to this integration are thoroughly examined, including resource shortages, the need for real-time processing, and environmental restrictions. The study emphasises how important it is to use low-power, compact NLP models that enable real-time language processing without sacrificing system efficiency. Additionally, the research discusses the fundamental approaches for improving these models’ using methods like transfer learning, quantisation, and model reduction. In the end, this work seeks to shed light on the enormous potential of voice-enabled intelligence in embedded systems, opening the door to more interactive, intuitive, and adaptable technologies that can easily adjust to changing human needs. This study advances the continuous development of smart gadgets by bridging the linguistic and technological divide, increasing their usability and accessibility in daily life.

articleTitle: Improving Trust Management in IoT-Edge Networks with Blockchain and Enhanced ETEE Approach for Sybil Attack Reduction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: There may be a plethora of new collaboration possibilities accessible to the linked smart devices in the IoT network because of smart city/medical IoT developments. Thanks to their constrained resource capacities, IoT devices in smart city/medical IoT settings can't handle heterogeneous and cross-layer services. Due to the large amount of data generated by IoT devices, processing must take latency into consideration. Cloud computing cannot provide a real-time response for critical smart city/medical IoT applications owing to network boundaries. A solution to the issues with traditional cloud computing has emerged: edge computing. An effective method for dealing with problems caused by heterogeneity and delay is edge computing. The widespread deployment of such small edge nodes raises several valid security issues, however. Threat actors have a lot of room to maneuver when targeting edge nodes because of their susceptibility to identification-based assaults like the Sybil attack. Given that the attacker node masquerades as legitimate nodes, conventional defenses are helpless against these types of attacks. Resilient defense against Sybil attacks is provided by the proposed edge-based technique. The last step in verifying the stated benefits was to assess the effectiveness of the planned trustworthy environment.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Multipath Routing and Load Balancing Methods in MANET
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Mobile Ad Hoc Networks (MANETs) are wirelessly linked networks that automatically configure themselves. The dynamic nature and absence of fixed infrastructure provide distinct problems, necessitating effective routing and load balancing to ensure optimal network performance. Multipath routing and load balancing are critical solutions for addressing these difficulties. The primary challenges include dynamic topology, limited bandwidth, energy constraints, and node mobility. In this article provide the comprehensive study about multipath routing, energy aware and load balancing techniques which strengthen the QoS of the network. Multipath routing involves establishing multiple paths between a source and a destination. This technique enhances reliability, fault tolerance, and load distribution. Load balancing in MANETs aims to distribute traffic uniformly across the network to avoid overloading any single node or link. Combining multipath routing and load balancing can significantly enhance MANET performance. Protocols need to dynamically select multiple paths and balance loads based on real-time network conditions. Multipath routing and load balancing are essential techniques for enhancing the performance, reliability, and longevity of MANETs. Future research should focus on scalable, secure, and QoS-aware solutions that can adapt to the dynamic nature of MANETs.

articleTitle: Optimizing Congestion Control in Wireless Sensor Networks Using a Trust-Based, Security-Aware Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Both random events and self-centred nodes may trigger network congestion. In Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs), bad nodes may cause congestion-like conditions by discarding data packets or transmitting duplicate, fraudulent packets. So, congested mitigation strategies alone won't guarantee level delivery. Consequently, isolating these points from the rest of the network is an essential first step in preventing this kind of trouble. Current work on congestion management solutions relies on the unrealistic and mistaken premise that every node is genuine and behaves correctly. To address this, researchers have developed a Security-Aware Congestion Control (SACC) algorithm, which accounts for both the usual and unexpected causes of congestion and how malicious nodes might prevent packets from receiving their intended recipients. These networks parameters—nodes' spare energy, reservoir utilization, and delivery of packets ratio—have been chosen for the purpose of establishing trust indicators because of the critical roles they play in detecting malicious behaviour and avoiding overcrowding. The suggested method outperforms similar current systems in energy efficiency, throughput management, and security, all thanks to its robust ability to resist several internal assaults. The suggested technique, Security-Aware Congestion Control (SACC), demonstrates its remarkable efficacy in guaranteeing safe and effective data transfer in wireless sensor networks with an astounding 96% accuracy rate. SACC performs better than other models like Low-Energy Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy (LEACH), Trust-based Congestion Control and Energy Efficiency Routing (TCEER), Secure Quality of Experience Energy Efficient Routing (SQEER) indicating its capacity to manage congestion and lessen the effect of rogue nodes, providing a more dependable and secure solution.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches In Automatic Number Plate Recognition: Result and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Systems known as Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR), license plate recognition or LPR are now widely used in many sectors such as law enforcement, traffic control, vehicle access etc. This is a technology that uses object detection and optical character recognition to identify the numbers on number plates from input images or video. These systems use high-level hardware and software components together to automatically capture, recognize and process license plate information. Key elements of any ANPR system include high-resolution cameras, image processing algorithms, and optical character recognition (OCR) methods. The operational workflow of an ANPR system comprises several steps like image acquisition, preprocessing, license plate localization, character segmentation, OCR, and post-processing stages. Different applications of ANPR technology include traffic flow monitoring; helping police track stolen vehicles; congestion detection for traffic management purposes; and automated entry/exit processes based on authorized number plate recognition among others for supporting vehicle access control. A accuracy of 90% was achieved by proposed, ANPR systems represent a significant technological advance that improves accuracy; efficiency as well as automation in various critical areas of our lives.

articleTitle: Yoga Posture Monitoring Using CNN and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This paper introduces "YoJa," a state-of-the-art posture monitoring system for yoga using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and machine learning techniques to achieve the accuracy of practicing correct yoga postures. With yoga becoming increasingly acceptable and popular across the globe due to the multifaceted benefits of both physical and mental well-being, great care must be taken to avoid injury while at the same time availing oneself of such practices. This system is training the model using a curated dataset of diverse images and videos to give real-time feedback on a user's pose. Results were an accuracy of 97% on the test dataset with YoJa, and thus it has shown the ability to classify yoga postures effectively. User experience is improved further through integration of immediate visual and auditory feedback, making learning faster and performance enhanced. The importance of this study lies in the evidence that technology can actually propagate good yoga culture and safe practices, translated into well-being.

articleTitle: A Conceptual Framework for Soil Classification and Crop Recommendation Using Machine Learning and Satellite-Sensor Data Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This paper introduces a conceptual framework for integrating machine learning techniques in soil classification and crop recommendation, aiming to enhance precision agriculture practices. The proposed system comprises two key stages: in the first stage, soil attributes such as pH, moisture content, temperature and various other factors are analyzed using the Random Forest algorithm to classify soil types. In the second stage, these classifications are fed into a Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM) to provide optimal crop recommendations based on the integrated dataset. This conceptual framework leverages the synergy of multiple data sources to enhance agricultural decision-making by offering tailored recommendations suited to specific soil types. Unlike conventional methods, which often treat soil classification and crop recommendation independently, this integrated approach aims to provide more accurate and context-specific recommendations. Although this paper primarily outlines the theoretical framework and methodologies, the ongoing development and implementation will demonstrate its real-world applicability in future research. The potential for this system to contribute to sustainable agriculture, improved crop yield, and resource efficiency is significant, making it a valuable tool for modernizing agricultural practices.

articleTitle: Ubiquitous Sensing the Convergence of WSNs and IoT in Contemporary Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Ubiquitous sensing, which combines WSNs and the IoT, makes settings smarter and more efficient for numerous procedures. For "Ubiquitous Sensing: The Convergence of WSNs and IoT in Contemporary Scenarios," this research examines a strategy to increase dependability, security, energy efficiency, and data accuracy. Recommended features include adaptive power management, data fusion methods, edge computing nodes, blockchain technology, and robust identification systems. These pieces improve the system and address common issues. The major research findings suggest that the strategy performs effectively in numerous success categories. Power management systems optimise energy consumption, reducing costs and environmental impact. Advanced data fusion and fault-tolerant designs improve data accuracy and reliability, allowing you to integrate data appropriately and keep the system functioning. Latency-sensitive applications may move and react to data in real time with reduced network delay and greater performance. Strong authentication and blockchain-based encryption maintain data accuracy, user privacy, and legal compliance while reducing hacking threats. The study describes the method's comprehensive approach to ubiquitous sensing, establishing a standard for IoT advances. Making systems more efficient and dependable, while prioritising data privacy and security, improves IoT infrastructure dependability and resilience.

articleTitle: Diabetic Retinopathy Detection Using Image Analysis with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Correct diagnosis of retinal disease is important for timely intervention and effective treatment is extremely significant. Our approach is to improve image reconstruction using neural networks (CNN) and provide an accurate and practical method for eye disease detection. Retinal diseases such as glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, high blood pressure, and atherosclerosis have many causes and require comprehensive evaluation. We focus on extracting key features of the eye, including eye structure, properties, and disease, using data from Research on the Retina (STARE) to train a CNN model that can identify a variety of eye diseases. Our approach includes extensive testing, using a variety of visualizations to illustrate the design, and integration into Django's website for deployment. The results were successful in classifying different types of retinal diseases, successfully detecting specific diseases, and demonstrating the potential of deep learning for modification of retinal diseases, thereby improving clinical outcomes and advancing the field of ophthalmology.

articleTitle: System Logs Anomaly Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a solution based on deep learning methods to face the growth of number of logs in system log data. The technique includes the collection of log data followed by these data passing through LSTM neural nets to be ableto infer temporal items. Through training LSTM over multiple historical samples, we form the rule set capturing that normality of the system. In stark contrast to prior detection methodologies that have been centered exclusively around anomaly types that are known, our model is driven by the goal of detecting unknownanomalies to which no category is assigned in advance. The Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS log dataset) that hasbeen provided by experts in the domain, is used by us. The approach to be presented offers a competitive way of performing log analysis of systems with a notable capacity of identifying the abnormal activity of the systems of scales in processing operations. Since the development of the project is based on the principles of simplicity and scalability. We enable identification of abnormal patterns with less effort by systematically streamlining this process consequently saving operations time and utilization of labor resources.

articleTitle: Tackling Big Data Challenges in Large Language Models with An Emphasis on Sharing, Security, and Scalability
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel approach to huge data challenges in large language models (LLMs) that prioritises sharing, security, and scale. Our solution leverages modern encryption algorithms, distributed computing tools, and edge computing principles to secure data and speed up computers. We routinely outperform previous methods in accuracy, precision, memory, and model fitting rates. Our research found that the strategy protects private data, reduces interaction costs, and speeds up model training. Cutting-edge technology allows accurate forecasts and seamless computer operations in many contexts. Ablation studies also demonstrate how our approach's components work together to improve performance. This paper advances AI-driven LLMs by demonstrating a secure, affordable, and scalable method for today's data issues. Future research may concentrate on blockchain and shared learning's larger applications and advancements as data security and computer scale become more important. Our strategy is a huge step towards creating safe and dependable AI systems that can manage today's data-driven situations.

articleTitle: Advanced Techniques in Data Ingestion and Pipelining for Scalable Big Data Platforms: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In the era of big data, effective data ingestion and pipelining are critical for organizations to harness the power of vast and diverse data sources, such as IoT devices, social media, and transactional systems. Data ingestion refers to the process of systematically collecting and importing data for processing, while data pipelining ensures the continuous flow of this data through various transformation stages, preparing it for analysis. As data volumes grow, platforms like Hadoop, with its HDFS (Hadoop Distributed File System) and MapReduce, have become essential in managing large-scale datasets by providing distributed storage and parallel processing capabilities. Additionally, tools such as Apache Kafka and Apache Flume facilitate both batch and real-time data ingestion, ensuring flexibility in handling different types of data streams. However, challenges remain, especially with the increasing complexity of datasets and the growing need for real-time processing. Emerging technologies such as cloud-native ingestion frameworks, edge computing, and AI-enhanced pipelines offer solutions to these challenges by improving scalability, performance, and cost efficiency. Machine learning is also playing an evolving role in optimizing pipeline workflows, enabling more intelligent and adaptive data processing. This paper reviews key technologies for data ingestion and pipelining, discusses their limitations, and explores cutting-edge trends aimed at enhancing the efficiency of big data platforms. These advancements promise to reshape how organizations handle big data, offering improved agility and operational effectiveness. In addition to established technologies, the rise of cloud-native architectures and AI-driven solutions is revolutionizing data ingestion and pipelining. Cloud platforms offer scalable, on-demand resources, while AI and machine learning enhance automation, anomaly detection, and predictive analytics within pipelines.

articleTitle: Detection of Bleeding Events In EHR Notes Using A Graph Dynamic Autoencoder Based Riemannian Residual Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Identifying occurrences of abnormal bleeding based on unstructured and structured medical data, such as patient notes, vitals, and laboratory findings, is the problem of recognising bleeding events in Electronic Health Records (EHR). The problem is in accurately recognising these occurrences by analysing temporal patterns, extracting significant information, and distinguishing catastrophic bleeding occasions from typical medical fluctuations given the complexity of EHR data, which is frequently longitudinal, heterogeneous, and packed with noise. The goal is to create a Graph Dynamic Autoencoder combined with a Riemannian Residual Neural Network (GDA-RRNN) with Elk Herd optimizer (EHO) model that can identify and display bleeding incidents in electronic medical data. The EHO optimizes the hyperparameters GDA-RRNN to improve the performance of the suggested method. We extracted 300 electronic health records that contained leukaemia or bleeding diagnostic codes from the International categorization of Diseases, Tenth Revision. The electronic health record has annotations indicating whether a sentence was positive or negative for bleeding. A proposed model that can identify bleeding at the sentence and note levels was created using the annotated texts. The best-performing suggested approach achieved a sensitivity of 0.99, specificity of 0.99, and a negative prediction value of 0.99 on an equal test set of 1178 phrases.

articleTitle: A Deep Q-Learning Approach to Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems: Enhancing Cybersecurity through Intelligent Adaptation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: A Deep Q-Learning approach to Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (IDPS) offers a cutting-edge solution for enhancing cybersecurity by leveraging intelligent machine learning models. This method dynamically adapts to evolving threats, learning optimal defense strategies through a reward-punishment system. The presented architecture integrates sensor-based traffic monitoring, feature extraction, and real-time decision-making to strengthen network resilience. The system leverages sensor nodes to monitor traffic and uses traffic analyzers to extract critical features from network data. A Deep Q-Learning model is employed to analyze these features, dynamically adjusting security policies by learning through reward and punishment mechanisms. The system interacts with network infrastructure, such as firewalls, routers, and switches, to mitigate threats in real time. Threat intelligence is continuously updated in a dedicated database, while an action executor enforces security measures and policies. This intelligent adaptation ensures proactive threat prevention and network resilience.

articleTitle: Ethiopia’s Small and Medium Sized Business Performance: An Investigation from Gindeberet District of Oromia Region
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The contribution of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises either directly or indirectly impact the metrics of growth of developing countries by lowering the unemployment factor with minimal capital investments. To witness the small and medium business model as a development model in the implementation of Ethiopia’s Growth and transformation plan, is given top priority and recognized as one among the core pillars of development. It was observed that SMBMs located in rural districts of the Oromia region are not transforming to the next levels within the stipulated period as per MSE plan. Hence, the investigation was aimed to analyze key factors which lead to SMBMs performance in the Gendered District of Oromia region, Ethiopia. To get more insight into this investigation, we have considered almost 133 business models from different sectors chosen from three Gendered district kebeles using multistage random sampling technique. The effect of internal factors such as entrepreneur characteristics, enterprise characteristics, the firm innovations within the enterprises as well as external factors viz. social platforms, and business environment regarding the efficiency of the enterprises were studied using bivariate and ordered Probit regression models. Overall, two third of the enterprises were observed in the middle performance category in terms of performance index constructed on economic and social indicators. Compared to other sectors, SMBMs in manufacturing and construction were performing at higher levels.
