Though, education is one of driving forces for better performance, the study revealed that highly performing entrepreneurs were having only an average education of 8.6 years against around 11 years for the low performers. It was due to the reality that less educated people want to be in the business for the long run and highly educated people want to shift to formal employment. The study concluded that motivation and risk taking, years of enterprise operation, vocational training, market innovation, and social network were significantly determining the variations in the performance of SMBMs. But an entrepreneur's age, sex, previous experience, creativity, enterprise’s location, product and process innovation, business environment, and business network were insignificant in explaining the variation in performance while considering the multiple effects. It was suggested that at policy level there is a need for linking the process of Registration and Licensing of SMBMs with the Administrative Training Programmed as a measure to increase the performance. Initiatives are needed to recognize the best business practices, experience sharing and exposure deliberations at district, regional and national levels.

articleTitle: Automated Detection and Classification of Orange Diseases Using DenseNet121: A Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Disease detection in oranges is an important procedure to be carried out for maintaining the quality and quantity of the citrus crop. Deep learning methods, particularly CNN, have cropped up to classify plant diseases. This work investigates the performance of DenseNet121, which is one of the state-of-the-art CNN architectures in classifying orange diseases into four classes: Fresh, Citrus canker, Black spot, and Greening Citrus. Using transfer learning, tuning a pre-trained DenseNet121 model is done, on the publicly available dataset consisting of 232 infected and healthy orange images, with 58 images in each class. This leads to a strong increase in the overall model accuracy, with an overall value of 96%, as it proves capable of engendering proper discrimination among the classes of the diseases. Precision, recall, and F1-score for all categories are above 95%, revealing that the performance from the different categories is relatively consistent and reliable. Among them, Fresh reached 0.97 for precision and 0.96 for recall, while Black Spot reached the highest recall of 0.97. This very strong performance of classification suggests a big potential of the model in practical applications for real-world agriculture, where early detection of diseases with the best possible accuracy is of the highest importance. The results validate that DenseNet121 is quite valid in this disease detection context and this is supposed to be a scalable, automated system to improve the methods of monitoring and intervention in the citrus industry. Moreover, the model could be used in real-time systems and comparisons with other deep learning architectures may be made to better optimize the performance. This dataset can be downloaded from Kaggle at for further research and experimentation in this domain.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Driven Energy Efficiency Framework Using Digital Twin: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The research aimed to investigate the intersection of machine learning, edge computing, digital twin technology, and energy efficiency optimization in the context of packet filtering frameworks. This study provides a structured and systematic approach to identify, collect, and analyze relevant literature on the subject matter. This study utilized different search strings to retrieve relevant papers, focusing on specific keywords such as "machine learning," "edge computing," "digital twin," "energy optimization," and "packet filtering" to gather research articles from reputable sources within the timeframe of 2013 to 2023. The final selection of papers was refined by exporting citations to BibTeX format and utilizing the Kullback-Leibler Divergence (KLD) to categorize and prioritize the results based on the relevance and importance of keywords. Following a reproducible methodology and adhering to established research practices, we compiled a comprehensive dataset of 392 papers for in-depth review and analysis. This study can enable the researchers to have an overview of the existing literature, identify research opportunities, analyze different methodologies, and propose novel ideas and directions, to inform a cohesive framework for guidance on addressing energy efficiency challenges in edge computing through the integration of machine learning and digital twin.

articleTitle: Gaussian Classifier System for Accurate Lung Cancer Prediction and Improved Patient Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: One of the most important and pressing needs in the machine learning field is medicine. Because medical field data is inherently complicated and diagnosis needs analysis of many different kinds of data, these criteria are of the utmost importance. There is a great deal of danger associated with cancer detection, making it an area that demands absolute accuracy and dependability. It is now essential to have quicker and more precise detections since they greatly increase the amount of time patients may live. Many different kinds of cancer may develop in different parts of the body. To that end, there is a great deal of variation across cancer types in terms of this characteristic. On top of that, there shouldn't be a unified method for cancer detection since various types of cancer have varied needs. The creation of models for the detection of lung cancer is the centre of this thesis. When it comes to cancers, lung cancer is among the most important since it kills the most people. The detecting method is very complicated because of all the many factors that need to be considered. The three primary findings from this thesis tackle the problems with lung cancer forecasting in a way that is both effective and efficient. Improvement over the prior model is achieved by the development of a model that can increase the levels of predictability. In order to deal with the intricacy of data, a more involved technique is used. The suggested approach Gaussian Classifier System (GCS) surpasses the other two methods, Naïve Bayes (NB) and Logistic Regression (LR), when compared side by side. Naïve Bayes performs well, however Logistic Regression outperforms it with enhanced prediction skills. The suggested technique, on the other hand, outperforms both of them with a 93% accuracy rate, demonstrating that it successfully balances precision and recall while keeping a high degree of accuracy.

articleTitle: Prompt Engineering: An efficient way for Content Creation using Prompt Chaining
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In tasks related to creative writing or content generation, individuals can employ prompt chaining to construct a narrative, shape characters, or explore various storytelling avenues. AI has become a key element in content creation, transforming how content is generated, optimized, and refined. Prompt engineering is the meticulous crafting and optimization of queries or instructions to elicit precise and valuable responses from generative AI models. This strategic approach translates human intentions and business needs into actionable outcomes, ensuring alignment with desired objectives. The presented application highlights the use of prompt engineering in the domain of content creation.

articleTitle: Enhancing Data Security in the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) with a Robust Transmission Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has made real-time applications more flexible and deployable. IoT has security and energy efficiency issues despite its benefits. This study addresses these issues with a secure data transmission architecture using fuzzy-based secure clustering and hybridised metaheuristic algorithms. The suggested framework contains three phases. The first phase presents an energy-efficient and secure IoT data transfer infrastructure. Secure route selection is done using fuzzy-based secure clustering and the Whale Optimization-based Harris Hawks Optimisation (W-HHO) method. Parallel cypher block chaining and advanced encryption strengthen data security. Secure cluster-based routing is needed for IOMT in the second phase. To group nodes, we use an adaptive Gaussian mutation-based Sine Cosine Optimisation (SCO) method, and we use mutual authentication to make sure everything is secure. Phase last of the research yields the most optimal and safe fuzzy inference route selection approach. With its foundation in Levy Flight Distributed Optimization (LFD-HGSO), the Henry Gas Solubility Optimization Algorithm clusters data and encrypts it concurrently and cypher-block-chains it. The safest routes are selected by fuzzy inference. In comparison to conventional methods, the proposed alternatives achieve better results in several performance metrics, including delivery rate for packet, energy efficiency, throughput and network lifetime. These results demonstrate the framework's secure and energy-efficient data transport for IoT and IoMT applications.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and its Algorithmic Foundations Reshaping the Future
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Because AI is built on formulas, numerous industries are evolving. This study examines three types of networks: genetic algorithms, convolutional neural net-works (CNNs), and long short-term memory networks (LSTMs). It investigates how advanced AI approaches influence these networks. This method combines many algorithms to create a versatile artificial intelligence system capable of solving issues. CNNs, on the other hand, acquire hierarchical features quickly and function well with images, while LSTMs excel at sequential data and other tasks. GAs employs genetic optimization to strengthen and improve response capabilities. By combining these technologies in novel ways, you may improve their optimization, natural language processing, and image identification. Even though artificial intelligence is still in its early stages, this study demonstrates the importance of algorithmic roots in predicting when smart systems may begin to challenge technology again.

articleTitle: Reverse Logistics in the Indian Textile Industry: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Reverse logistics has gained significant attention in recent years due to its potential for sustainability and cost optimization. The Indian textile industry, being one of the largest contributors to the country's economy, faces various challenges related to waste management, recycling, and reusing. Therefore, this paper presents a comprehensive review of the current state of reverse logistics practices within the Indian textile industry. Further, the study aims to address the existing research gap based on a comprehensive literature review and propose future research directions based on the research gap analysis. A total of 14 research works including research papers, book chapters, magazine and conference proceedings were selected, categorized, and analyzed, and voids in the literature were identified to propose opportunities for future research. It explores the existing literature, identifies key factors persuading the execution of reverse logistics, and highlights successful case studies in the domain. The review aims to provide valuable understanding of the challenges and opportunities related to reverse logistics, foster sustainable practices, and improve the global competitiveness of the Indian textile industry. This literature review may be beneficial for academics, researchers, and practitioners seeking a deeper understanding of reverse logistics and directions for future research.

articleTitle: Deciphering Digital Disruptions And Their Dynamic Impact On Data-Driven Discourses
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This research revisits how technology affects fact-based assertions. Advanced approaches like TF-IDF for content mining, VADER for mood analysis, and ARIMA for time series analysis are optimal. This approach shows digital change more accurately and completely than others. The proposed approach has many advantages over the present one. It excels in precision, speed, flexibility, and analysis. Many compliments to the approach's high-level methodologies, automation, scalability, and near-real-time processing. The recommended solution handles complex data effectively, responds to new patterns, and provides accurate real-time views, making it long-lasting. Finally, the recommended strategy offers a current and flexible way to consider how digital developments influence data-driven arguments in many ways. This method is useful for solving our current difficulties since it helps us grasp digital era processes.

Author Keywords: Digital Disruptions Processing in Real Time

articleTitle: Overview Of Some Techniques Of Internet Search Manipulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The most common form of obtaining quick information on any topic today is searching the Internet. Although it cannot always be considered accurate and true, information gathered in that way is often used to make important decisions. Posts on social media and various portals are considered more unreliable than information which users search for themselves through Internet search engines. Search engines work by collecting terms from web pages and links to those pages. They use specially designed programs (crawlers, robots) which browse and analyse keywords on web pages. In that way, the pages are indexed and categorized by different algorithms and, as such, displayed as search results to users. However, it is less known that even such search results are subject to various manipulation techniques, such as Astroturfing and Google bombing. The Aim of those manipulation techniques is to influence the attitudes of persons who search them by frequently displaying the content of individual web pages. For the purposes of this paper, research was conducted by searching complex terms in Internet search engines which are related to politics immediately before the local elections held in Croatia in May 2021.

articleTitle: Innovative Machine Learning Framework for Anticipating Synergistic Effects in Cancer Drug Therapy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Bioinformatics has led to improvements in cancer treatment and longevity. Cancer, caused by alterations and mutations in a patient's cell genes, is very difficult to cure, especially in the tumor surroundings. Since different individuals react differentially to the same cancer medications, more individualized therapies are required. In order to identify new medications more quickly, researchers are looking for replacements to clinical studies. The industry has been driven by big data in the fields of cancer and pharmacogenomics. In order to make sense of this information and propel advances in cancer treatment, data analysis and artificial intelligence are vital. Both structural and functional similarities between drugs and between drugs and tissues in terms of expression of genes are essential for the target function. To discover synergistic pharmaceutical combinations towards avoiding cancer, we provide a comprehensive technique. Through the use of features derived from specific medication response data, our comprehensive technique is able to anticipate drug interactions. To find synergistic medication combinations, this study used a combination drug screen to generate useful characteristics. We have compared the models that have been trained using assessments of performance metrics including sensitivity, accuracy, and specificity. Among the models tested, the Random Forest model performed the best. The optimal model is found by comparing trained models using performance metrics like sensitivity, accuracy, and specificity. In tests comparing several models, randomly generated forest systems consistently outperformed the competition. Both the Braf-synergy and Braf-effective models, which make use of the random forest model, achieve a success rate of 95.45 and 97.16, respectively.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Various Optimization Techniques used in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The applications of wireless sensor networks (WSNs) in a variety of industries, including smart cities, health care, and environmental monitoring, have drawn a lot of attention. Nevertheless, in order to increase network performance, prolong lifespan, and boost efficiency, optimization techniques must be used due to sensor nodes' restricted resources. This work covers different optimization strategies used in WSNs and groups them into three categories: algorithms inspired by nature, heuristic approaches, and classical optimization strategies. We give a thorough taxonomy of these techniques, highlight important findings from the research, talk about the difficulties that have been faced, and suggest possible avenues for future investigation.

articleTitle: Big Data and Artificial Intelligence Applications for Cyber Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Cybersecurity has long been involved with artificial intelligence (AI). One long-standing use of AI technologies is the detection of potential threats to computer systems, with the goal of allowing humans to react accordingly. Still, cyber assaults have been happening more often and with more serious consequences recently. Always trying to acquire access to digital regions are cybercriminals and hostile agents. The prevalence of cyber assaults, including phishing scams, identity theft, etc., is surging. Every industry and field has made use of it. The expansion of the Internet's reach, the escalating number of users, and the ease with which data may be transmitted and shared are all results of the progression of information technology. An increase in requests for information security is a direct result of this. When the big data era finally arrives, there will be much more complex data that needs the protection of IT security specialists. It is possible that AI solutions, such as big data security protection, can solve this problem. In addition to improving the safety of data transmitted across networks, AI has the potential to alter human lifestyles in the future as it finds more widespread use in the internet, ushering in a new era of massive transformation.

articleTitle: Career Path for ITI: Navigating Success in Industrial Training Institutes
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This research work shall attempt to aid students in the selection of the proper career pathway for their respective chosen streams as they are interested in Industrial Training Institute (ITI) education. It shall inform the student about the various courses offered by ITIs, industry demands, and multiple possible career paths through a user-friendly interface. This is an app that equips students with all the knowledge to take informed decisions regarding educational and professional futures to which they aspire. Whatever the options, be it mechanics, electronics, or some other trade, this platform proves a true guide in navigating this enormous landscape of vocational education and career opportunities.

articleTitle: MRI-Based Epilepsy Seizure Detection Using Combined Approach of CNN With SVM Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The quality of life for those affected by the neurological illness epilepsy is greatly diminished by the frequent occurrence of seizures. Nearly half a million individuals throughout the globe live with this chronic disease. Better results and faster treatment could result from the early identification of seizures via the examination of medical imaging. When applied to MRI and EEG data, deep learning algorithms have shown encouraging results for epilepsy classification. Consistently improving these models' accuracy and reliability is key to achieving great performance in epilepsy detection. To solve the issue of automatically detecting instances of epilepsy in MRI images, this study introduces a new hybrid machine learning method. Based on these specific qualities, the support vector algorithm (SVM) may detect activity related to seizures in a scan. Researchers looked at two sets of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) images from people with epilepsy that had seizures in order to test the notion. This research successfully detects and predicts the beginning of seizures associated with epilepsy in MRI examinations using the suggested hybrid technique, which combines a neural network based on convolution (CNN) with a vector machine with support (SVM). It is clear from these results that computerized prediction systems have achieved significant progress in medical diagnosis. Using 5-fold cross-validation, the proposed SVM-CNN system achieves a detection accuracy greater than 98.69% with dataset 2 and 98.47% with dataset 1, surpassing previous standards. Seizure detection becomes more accurate and interpretable when deep learning and shallow learning are combined. This diagnostic method allows for the early administration of anti-epileptic medication, which may lead to better patient outcomes.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Steganography and Text-to-Image Encryption Using RGB Substitution Techniques for Cybersecurity
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In today’s world, data is money and privacy lie at the apex of our system. There has been a cat and mouse game between the good guys and bad guys. Steganography is a process of hiding any confidential data, it must be any document or image file that we don't want to disclose with any third person in an image or video file. There are tons of encryption mechanisms like DES, 3DES, AES, RSA and so on. Most of these fail against attacks like KPA (Known Plain Text Attack), Known Ciphertext Attack, Brute force, etc. In steganography when creating an application, the application needs many different things. Like some applications need a small secret message to hide in an image or some applications need extra pixels of the images so the secret message can properly hide. This paper intends to give a brief discussion about steganography process and how to use it and which steganography technique is more suitable. This paper focus on implementing a Text-to-image Encryption mechanism in conjunction with AES-256 to gain 2 factored encryption which makes it difficult for the attacker to break the cypher text.

articleTitle: Digital Transformation in Higher Education Institutes in India: Evaluating the Role of Student Relationship Management
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The new challenges for Higher Education Institutions (HEIs) in a competitive market are interacting and aligning with digital transformation agents. The study examines the impact of Student Relationship Management (SRM) through digital transformation on student and parent satisfaction, loyalty, and recommendation willingness in Higher Education Institutions (HEIs). Multiple hypotheses were tested using AMOS. The research, which was conducted at Engineering and Management Institutes, using a descriptive research design, determined that effective SRM practices substantially increase student and parent satisfaction, resulting in improved retention, advocacy, and institutional success. student engagement and satisfaction were discovered to be positively influenced by digital interventions and management support. Parent loyalty and student retention were also influenced by branding and promotion strategies, even though their maximum potential is still unrealized in numerous institutions. The research suggests that higher education institutions should improve their student learning management (SRM) strategies to cultivate more robust relationships with students and parents. This includes boosting student life cycle management, incorporating knowledge management throughout online and offline platforms, and enhancing branding and promotion initiatives. Building loyalties that last and advocacy necessitates the implementation of digital tools and consistent feedback mechanisms. The significance of SRM in fostering student satisfaction, loyalty, and institutional success is emphasized by the research.

articleTitle: Secure data communication framework based on fuzzy based secure clustering and hybridized metaheuristic algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has made real-time applications more flexible and deployable. IoT has security and energy efficiency issues despite its benefits. This study addresses these issues with a secure data transmission architecture using fuzzy-based secure clustering and hybridised metaheuristic algorithms. The suggested framework contains three phases. The first phase presents an energy-efficient and secure IoT data transfer infrastructure. Secure route selection is done using fuzzy-based secure clustering and the Whale Optimization-based Harris Hawks Optimisation (W-HHO) method. Parallel cypher block chaining and advanced encryption strengthen data security. Secure cluster-based routing is needed for the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) in the second phase. An adaptive Gaussian mutation-based Sine Cosine Optimisation (SCO) approach clusters nodes, and mutual authentication assures security. Final phase of research delivers optimal and secure fuzzy inference route selection policy. The Levy Flight Distributed optimization-based Henry Gas Solubility Optimisation Algorithm (LFD-HGSO) clusters data, while concurrent encryption and cypher block chaining secure it. Fuzzy inference selects safest paths. Performance tests show that the proposed solutions improve packet delivery rate, throughput, energy efficiency, and network lifetime over conventional methods. These results demonstrate the framework's safe and energy-efficient data transfer for IoT and IoMT applications. Experimental findings show that the suggested strategy outperforms various QoS metrics like packet delivery ratio, throughput, network longevity, and energy usage. Time efficiency is also improved by the PAES-CBC key generation algorithm.

articleTitle: Advanced Machine Learning Frameworks for Cancer Classification Using Genomic Information
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Computational advancements have improved patient survival rates and treatment of severe illnesses. Cancer is a hereditary illness caused by mutations and variations in the patient's DNA. Cancer therapy is challenging due to the complexity of the tumor's microenvironment. Patients experiencing the same cancer kind have varying responses to targeted therapy. Clinical trials and conventional drug discovery are complicated and laborious. Thus, researchers strive to develop effective treatments for severe disorders. The abundance of internet data sources in oncology and pharmacogenomics has encouraged research in this discipline. Recent advances in data mining including machine learning are enhancing analysis based on data. The following section introduces a cancer classification method that uses multi-objective meta-heuristics and machine learning techniques to predict novel and relevant markers. HMOSHSSA, a hybrid choice of genes method, uses MOSHO and Salp Swarm method. The proposed composite algorithm combines SSA and MOSHO characteristics for mining and extraction. The suggested strategy is compared to a few state-of-the-art methods. The precision of classification and gene count are used to assess the proposed approach. Comparing findings shows that the recommended strategy outperforms competitors. The SVM and KNN classification method for leukemia dataset identifies four genes with 100% accuracy. Existing leukemia dataset prediction methods are less accurate.

articleTitle: A Federated Learning Approach for Self-Parking in V2X Environment by Enhancing Intelligence in Vehicle System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In this survey paper, the integration of cutting-edge technologies in urban mobility is examined, with a specific focus on improving intelligent transportation systems (ITS) and self-parking systems. These technologies include the Internet of Things (IoT), the Internet of Vehicles (IOV), and Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication. The survey intends to overcome the shortcomings of conventional parking management, optimize parking space allocation, and enhance the overall urban driving experience through dynamic parking management and cutting-edge vehicle navigation systems by utilizing these integrated technologies. Federated Learning (FL) provides decentralization, and when paired with IoT, IOV, and V2X's real-time data interchange capabilities, it creates a strong framework for creating efficient, scalable, resilient, and privacy-preserving ITS. In order to provide a thorough understanding of how various technologies might work together to shorten parking search times and support dynamic parking management, this paper examines recent literature as well as case experiences. The results point to the possibility of major advancements in automobile navigation and self-parking systems, which could result in smarter, safer, and more sustainable urban environments. With this poll, we add to the continuing conversation about how technology is revolutionizing urban mobility and offer predictions for the development of self-parking and intelligent transportation. Keywords: Vehicle navigation systems, dynamic parking management, self-parking systems, and intelligent transportation systems (ITS).

articleTitle: A Regression Test Case Prioritization Technique for Web Application Using User Session Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: We propose a novel regression test case prioritization technique (RTCP) for web applications exploiting user session data and hamming code distance. The proposed technique utilises user session data to reorder test cases such that test cases which cover the ‘most frequently accessed subset of pages together’ are given higher priority. The coverage information of user session data along with its frequency appearance and test cases are converted to hamming code. These hamming codes are used to calculate the coverage similarity between user access pattern and the test cases. Further, the hamming code distance is incorporated with frequency of appearance to calculate a weighted average distance among user session data and test cases. Finally, the test cases with a lesser weighted average distance are given higher priority.

articleTitle: The Role of Computer Vision in Automating Defect Detection in Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Automating manufacturing problem-solving is a top priority for contemporary enterprises. This area benefits from computer vision. Our new bug-finding approach employs "CNN-based Feature Extraction," "RNN-based Temporal Analysis," and "Object Detection and Real-time Monitoring" to correct prior methods. Our technique begins with CNN feature extraction. It helps the system discover minor features in object images. The next step is "RNN-based Temporal Analysis," which helps the system detect changing faults over time, an issue that is often ignored by traditional systems. "Object Detection and Real-time Monitoring" improves upon previous methods of fault detection by allowing for rapid reactions to faults and a decrease in the manufacturing of defective goods. We tested the suggested strategy against more conventional methods using a well annotated dataset. In comparison to more conventional approaches, ours achieves higher precision, accuracy, and F1 score. While "CNN-based Feature Extraction" demonstrated competitive results, especially in terms of accuracy, "RNN-based Temporal Analysis" stood out by doing very well in situations when flaws grow dynamically. Finally, by overcoming the shortcomings of conventional approaches, the suggested technique provides a game-changing strategy for defect identification. It is the best option for manufacturers looking to improve quality control and optimize production processes since it can adapt to dynamic and complicated errors, responds in real-time, and has extensive feature extraction capabilities.

articleTitle: Malware Detection in Android Devices Using Histogram-based Gradient Boosting
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This research is to develop a method of using machine learning to make Android malware detection more accurate. Eleven thousand five hundred eighty-eight samples of Android that are of five types of malware were used. There was a lot of work that had to be done in the data preparation that included using tools such as SMOTE to balance and select features. The classifier that is histogram-based gradient boosting (HGB) was the most effective algorithm following the many tests of machine learning algorithms. The HGB model's accuracy is 99.8 percent, which is unbelievably high compared to other models like Decision Tree, XGBoost, and Random Forest. The findings of this study emphasize the necessity for the use of complex machine learning methods and proper data processing to increase the malware detection precision. The suggested method is not only a security method that allows Android malware to be detected but also a new standard for the research in this area.

articleTitle: From Stress to Success: Leveraging Tracebility and Workability to Support Student Well-Being in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The research explores the vital role of traceability in addressing student stress within the education sector. It underscores the importance of systematically tracking and analyzing stress factors and their impacts on students over time. The study aims to develop a framework for capturing, analyzing, and responding to stress-related data in educational settings. This involves understanding student behavior and engagement through machine learning and computer vision technologies. Data collection methods include Google Forms and consultations with psychologists. The document outlines model development, training, real-time monitoring, data visualization, user interaction, and intervention strategies. Furthermore, it elucidates the concepts of traceability and workability in the context of AI, addressing challenges and strategies for overcoming them. The paper also delves into stress-related issues in education and potential solutions.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Frontiers Exploring Sustainable Energy Sources And Preservation Techniques for Ecosystem Maintenance and Biodiversity Conservation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: We introduce Sustainable Energy Optimization via Eco Synthesis (SEOTES), a novel paradigm that promises to revolutionize green energy planning. EcoOptimize, BioDiversityGuard, and Community Empower are SEOTES's complicated initiatives that reduce waste, increase efficiency, and engage people in green energy. The EcoOptimize algorithm determines the ideal location and size for green energy projects to maximize energy production and environmental benefit. BioDiversityGuard utilizes machine learning to predict animal impacts from green energy projects. It emphasizes environmental safety. Community Empower shares the advantages of green energy projects fairly via social network analysis and collaboration. SEO techniques function better and have less impact on the bottom line and environment than outdated techniques. SEOTES is the most innovative and effective renewable energy improvement. This abstract discusses SEOTES's whole technique and its importance for tackling the energy crisis's biggest issues. It emphasizes how SEOTES may improve renewable energy project planning, implementation, and participation.

articleTitle: Impact of Fintech: Revolution in Banking and Financial Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The financial technology (fintech) revolution has significantly transformed the banking and financial industry by introducing innovative solutions that enhance efficiency, accessibility, and customer experience. This paper explores the impact of fintech on the financial sector, focusing on how emerging technologies—such as blockchain, artificial intelligence, and mobile banking—have reshaped traditional banking practices. The integration of fintech has led to more personalised financial services, streamlined payment systems, and increased financial inclusion, particularly in underserved regions. By offering faster transactions, reduced operational costs, and improved risk management, fintech has not only enhanced customer satisfaction but also redefined the competitive landscape for financial institutions. The study discusses both the opportunities and challenges brought about by fintech, including regulatory hurdles, data security concerns, and the implications for workforce dynamics in the banking industry. In addition, the paper reviews the evolving regulatory frameworks that aim to balance innovation with consumer protection. It also highlights the potential risks associated with the rapid adoption of digital financial solutions, such as cybersecurity threats and market instability. Through an analysis of recent literature, this review provides insights into the transformative effects of fintech and the ongoing adaptation of traditional banks to keep pace with these technological advances. Ultimately, the paper emphasizes the need for collaboration between fintech firms, regulatory bodies, and traditional financial institutions to foster a secure, inclusive, and innovative financial ecosystem. This paper concludes by suggesting future research directions that could explore the long-term implications of fintech innovations for economic stability.

articleTitle: Unveiling the Mysteries and Truths Hidden Within Mod-ern Transistors and Terabyte Architectures
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Finding the depth underlying current transistors and terabyte structures is crucial in the digital age. Using mathematical tests, computer simulations and models, and hands-on experimentation, the research seeks to understand these technologies. Terabyte and tera Centre architectures are among the most revolutionary. Because technology improves constantly. The digital age's seemingly little elements and processes have impacted our reality in complex and unnoticed ways. The secrets and facts of these developments have led our civilization into new inventions, networking, and computing fields. The basic building blocks of our phones and the massive data centers that power the internet have changed. The recommended technique evaluates computer performance characteristics such as speed, efficiency, data storage, reliability, redundancy, cost, safety, privacy, and environmental friendliness. It is compared to six typical approaches to demonstrate its superiority in various presentation methods.

articleTitle: Optimized Deep Learning CNN for Efficient Classification of ECG Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: IoT- based biomedical systems are essential to healthcare because they enable efficient data transfer for processing and the use of state-of-the-art sensors to identify physiological factors. It is well known that tools and sensors have been created to assess physiological factors like heart rate, ,body temperature, blood pressure, SPO2 levels, and blood sugar. These systems' ability to handle obtained data effectively is made possible by deep learning techniques, which is essential to their overall efficacy. Numerous neural network-based techniques are used to classify and analyse physical characteristics. In order to optimise the CNN for ECG classification, this section suggests a novel design that employs Particle Swarm Optimisation (PSO). A comparison is made between the proposed PSO-optimized CNN strategy and alternative methods, including Wavelet feature extraction and classifiers such as Convolution Neural Networks (CNNs), Artificial Neural Networks which is also represented as ANN, and Support Vector Machines which is also represented as SVM. This work presents a paradigm for the classification of ECG signals, which is the foundation for these comparisons. The proposed strategy is designed to improve healthcare outcomes by enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of biomedical data interpretation.

articleTitle: Exploring the Dark Side of AI: The Challenges of Explain Ability, Algorithmic Bias, and Ensuring Fairness
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The rapid advancements in Artificial Intelligence (AI) is reshaping various sectors, including military operations, to such an extent that many nations now consider AI development, funding, and deployment a crucial national priority. Artificial Intelligence has been the most popular phrase of the decade, with many real-world problems and their solutions being attributed to it. Prefixing or suffixing the acronym "AI" to any solution typically, makes the solution to seem more legitimate and palatable due AI making deep inroads into almost all fields and gaining wide acceptability. While it is widely acknowledged that human decision-making can be flawed due to unconscious and systemic biases, a critical question arises: Will AI systems developed by humans exhibit less bias, or will they aggravate the existing issues and biases? This research paper explores the less visible challenges of AI, specifically focusing on issues of explain ability, bias, and fairness within AI-driven systems.

articleTitle: Long Short-Term Memory with Encoder-Decoder and Skill Optimization Algorithm based Weather Radar Echo Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This research proposes a novel implementation of Long Short-Term Memory with Encoder-Decoder and Skill Optimization Algorithm (LSTM-ED-SOA) seeking to forecast Weather Radar Echoes. It presents a model that seeks to strengthen ‘the weak’ by introducing an optimization algorithm that combines the advantages of LSTM in handling sequential data and improves the performance of the predictions over time. Temporal dependencies are appropriately modeled with the encoder-decoder structure which is coupled with a skill optimization technique that enables the model to mitigate against capricious weather conditions. Forecasting models such as EPD, TrajGRU, and ConvLSTM as well as, and PredRNN put together show weaknesses when compared to LSTM-ED-SOA. Thus, it comes out convincingly that the model performs exceptionally achieving an accuracy of 99.8%, precision of 99.6%, and an F1 score of 99.7% way ahead of the best conventional models which were achieved accuracy of 85% at the very best. These results underscore the stability and effectiveness of the LSTM-ED-SOA system, for more advanced radars, wherein, it will greatly enhance the accuracy and timeliness of weather forecasting.

articleTitle: AI Based Decision Support System for Cyber Forensics Investigations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The increasing sophistication and frequency of cyber attacks have made advanced solutions necessary to safeguard critical systems from threats. data. AI-Based Decision Support Systems (DSS) offer a transformative approach to cyber security by leveraging artificial intelligence and machine learning to identify, assess, and mitigate risks in real time. These systems enhance decision-making processes by automating threat detection, analyzing vast datasets for anomalies, and predicting potential vulnerabilities with high precision. This essay looks at how AI-based DSS can be used in cyber security, focusing on how they can adapt to new attack vectors and offer proactive defenses. By combining advanced analytics, monitoring in real time, and smart threat response, these systems make digital infrastructures more resilient and cut down on the time it takes to respond. Key applications include intrusion detection, fraud prevention, malware analysis, and secure network management. The study also highlights the challenges of implementing AI in cyber security, such as ethical concerns, data privacy, and the need for robust training datasets.AI-based DSS represent a critical advancement in cyber security, empowering organizations to stay ahead of adversaries and establish a secure digital environment. Their potential for scalability and continual learning positions them as essential tools in addressing the dynamic and complex nature of modern cyber threats. This paper presents a case study of a real-world medical information system.

articleTitle: Perceived Risk of Disabled’s Consumption and Behavior on Clothing under Digital Fashion-Metaverse
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Emergence of digital fashion industry realm continues to spread widely in the area of metaverse (digital spaces), still there remains a notable gap on disabled consumer's accessibility functions. However, few researchers explored the area of adaptive fashion, this study explores the perceived risk and behavioral aspects of disabled individuals on their clothing pattern through digital fashion through questionnaire (n= 52) on type of disability (fully and partial) in India. The methodology employed is on quantitative basis that includes factor analysis, cluster analysis and chi-square analysis to identify the underlying factors influencing disabled, user experiences and challenges based on perceived risk faced by the consumers on accessing digital fashion platforms. As a result, findings states that critical determinants like accessibility, usability and availability of adaptive clothing features are revealed on adoption of digital fashion by disabled consumers. In contempt of growing potential of digital fashion consumers with disability face significant barriers, due to lack of awareness about the capabilities of metaverse is to limited access of adaptive clothing that is designed to their needs. Through this research contribution towards disabled consumers, unboxing specific challenges and opportunities within digital fashion, that offers valuable insight to fashion industries and developers (tech-developers). By pointing out these gaps, digital fashion can be more inclusive and serve disabled consumers based in their needs. The implications of the study suggests emerging desperation towards industries and education to range it's advances towards digital fashion on tailoring inclusive designs and essentials based on inclusivity and adaptive technologies for disable consumers.

articleTitle: Traversing Through Terabytes to Decode the Tapestry of Tangible Technology Trends
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Understanding the intricate network of visible technology trends is crucial in today's fast-changing technological environment. We'll enter a terabyte-sized digital jungle as we strive to understand the complicated network of new technologies that are transforming our world. The exponential increase in digital data demands sophisticated techniques for making sense of changing tech landscapes. In "Traversing Through Terabytes to Decode the Tapestry of Tangible Technology Trends," the authors provide an innovative method that brings together Natural Language Processing (NLP), Machine Learning (ML), and Network Analysis. Using natural language processing, the technique extracts relevant phrases and themes from large amounts of raw textual data. Machine learning algorithms interpret speech and forecast trends. In contrast, network analysis uncovers the deep relationships between numerous technical fields. Our solution beats standard methods after rigorous testing. This would help stakeholders grasp technology trends and make better strategic decisions.

articleTitle: AI Assisted Teaching Support for Answering Frequently Asked Questions and Generating Educational Content
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This research describes a high-tech AI-powered system that answers student inquiries and creates useful material to improve learning. We use AI and NLP to vectorize student inquiries using word embeddings and match them with commonly requested questions. Students utilize cosine resemblance to get the best solutions with instructor assistance. Feedback loops and gradient descent improve the system's accuracy and relevance. The system answers questions and creates lessons by highlighting key concepts and building on them using NLP. Multimedia makes learning entertaining and personalized. Performance studies reveal that the system outperforms existing approaches in content accuracy, reaction time, and scenario relevance. You can simply extend and alter the approach, and it works well with many teaching resources, making it safe and successful in many learning contexts. Results suggest that an AI-powered approach may improve education by providing speedy, accurate, and relevant responses. This will affect educational information delivery and utilization.

articleTitle: The Role of AI-Enhanced Financial Literacy and HR Marketing in Personal Investment Decisions A Quantitative Analysis of Urban and Rural Households
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Policymakers around the world have begun to pay more attention to financial inclusion because of the strong foundation it is believed to provide for human growth. National monetary systems as they have always been cannot appeal to every part of society. Members of society who are already well-off find it difficult to participate in the financial industry due to the legacy system's many obstacles. Theoretically, this research aims to shed light on how Artificial Intelligence (AI) can encourage financial inclusion. In order to back up its claims, the report cites actual instances of governments using AI to break down obstacles to financial inclusion. With the right infrastructure and regulations in place, artificial intelligence (AI) can help expand access to financial services. By learning about different investment options and how to diversify their portfolios, people with financial literacy are better able to handle their own money. Investors sought to strike a better income-expenditure balance by taking advantage of new options to invest in firms' stocks, bonds, shares, and other financial instruments through traditional and nontraditional investment channels, as well as stock exchanges. The present economic climate encourages individual investors to trade stocks due to factors such as low stock prices, capital gains, financial interest, and stock market rumours. The reason being that these indexes offer more equitable investment opportunities than traditional forms of investment, such as bank savings. On the other hand, financial literacy (FL) provides a pathway for investors to make wise use of resources by way of investing in solid investments.

articleTitle: Understanding the Underlying Mechanics of Binary Brainwaves and Bayesian Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This work uses Bayesian reasoning, sophisticated optimization, and recurrent regularization to forecast and enhance brainwave signals for accuracy and resilience. The recommended approach examines brainwave waves using Bayesian reasoning. A Gaussian prior illustrates the initial concepts related to the hidden signal. Bayes' theorem calculates the posterior distribution, and MAP estimates discover the most probable hidden signal. We use backward samples in Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) to estimate the signal. We then validate this estimate using cross-validation and log-likelihood. Iterative regularization smoothes and denoises the signal while preserving significant characteristics and penalizing rapid changes. Gradient descent ensures smooth, accurate output during optimization. After extensive testing, the concept achieved 95.8% classification accuracy, 93.4% precision, 92.7% memory, and a 93.0% F1 score. A root mean square error of 0.04 and mean absolute error of 0.02 demonstrate its accuracy. Its rapid computing (12.5 seconds), scaling (9.5), noise resistance (9.8), and interpretability (9.0) make it successful. The findings demonstrate neurofeedback, brainwave analysis, and medical diagnostic applications for the proposed technique. They also define standards for signal processing accuracy, efficiency, and adaptability.

articleTitle: Cardiac Arrest Prediction Model Using Ensemble Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The physician employs a diverse range of laboratory diagnostics, physical examinations, and on occasion, even invasive procedures to ascertain the presence of diseases. It is necessary to have a physician that possesses exceptional training, expertise and skill in the specific field, for detection of the disease in its initial phases. Despite the widespread use of ensemble techniques in disease prediction, here is a notable absence of comprehensive evaluation of regularly utilized ensemble algorithms for highly studied diseases. Consumers typically resort to seeking medical assistance from a doctor or other medical expert only after exhausting all other home remedies without finding relief for their ailments. This is probably a result of insufficient comprehension, as well as other factors related to behavior. This paper introduces a conventional ensemble LSTM model that incorporates data preparation and feature engineering. The model proposed in this research represents major gains in numerous statistical parameters like precision, f score, accuracy and ROC curve in comparison to the other models.

articleTitle: Fourier Transform with Depth Quarter for Silent Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Object Detection identifies and isolates the most visible parts of a photograph. It is widely used in visual applications for object re-targeting, classification, image generation, tracking, picture retrieval, and more. The biggest obstacles for object identification algorithms include non-uniform illumination, postures, occlusion, and other variables that cause incorrect object detection. Traditional object-identification algorithms will perform poorly on complex backdrops. However, object identification systems using deep learning are in demand. Deep learning requires high-quality pictures for object identification training. Images in the datasets were taken under various lighting conditions. Low light causes data loss, making object identification harder. The thesis specifically enhances photographs to avoid the effects of poor illumination or damaged images, unlike existing detection methods, which directly recognize objects in degraded photos. This contradicts current detecting techniques. Picture augmentation is needed for many applications in many industries. Several approaches are used to improve images. These approaches reduce blur and noise to enhance a photo. Machine learning models' detection and classification skills are improved by these methods, as are object geometric features like edges. Published research describes histogram equalization, gamma correction, contrast limiting adaptive histogram equalization, and other image enhancing methods. Modern image processing uses complex algebra like the Fourier transform. A strategy for enhancing photographs is proposed in the thesis: Discrete Quaternion Fourier Transform (DQFT). The proposed approach can handle a larger dataset and achieve a 97% identification rate, outperforming CNN techniques. Compared to CNN, DFTCNN, RCNN, and Mask RCNN, our method can identify objects with accuracy of 0.8752, recall of 0.8268, and F1-score of 0.8295.

articleTitle: Advanced Hyper-Tunning Strategies for Global Mean Based Feature Selection and Creation for enhanced Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Clustering accuracy is crucial for effective data analysis in unsupervised learning tasks, with the usage of the simple and efficient cluster analysis technique named as K-means technique. However, standard K-means suffers from limitations such as sensitivity to random initialization and challenges in handling high-dimensional data with irrelevant features. This paper presents a hyper-tuned approach to improve K-means clustering accuracy by Unifying Global Mean-Based Nearest Feature Object Selection for robust Centroid initialization with a Feature Creation Method Based on Important Feature Selection. The proposed method first enhances Centroid initialization by selecting points close to global feature means, ensuring initial centroids are more representative of the data distribution. Additionally, it focuses on identifying and weighting the most important features while creating composite features that amplify cluster separability. Experimental results demonstrate a 1.36986% improvement in clustering accuracy, an increase in silhouette scores, faster convergence, and improved stability across multiple trials compared to traditional K-means.

articleTitle: Development of The Next Generation of Automated Teller Machines (ATMs): Implementing an Advanced Python-Based Architecture for Secure, Adaptive, And Scalable Banking Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The quick headway of innovation has essentially changed the financial scene, requiring the ceaseless development of Mechanized Teller Machines (ATMs) to meet the advancing requirements of clients and monetary foundations. This paper proposes an imaginative way to deal with ATM improvement, utilizing a high-level Python-based design to make cutting edge ATMs that focus on security, versatility, and adaptability. As of late, security has arisen as a fundamental worry in the financial area, especially concerning ATM exchanges and client information. The proposed Python-based engineering consolidates powerful safety efforts, including encryption calculations, verification components, and ongoing checking frameworks. These actions are intended to defend client exchanges and delicate information from different digital dangers, guaranteeing the respectability and classification of banking activities. This customized approach improves consumer loyalty as well as drives client unwaveringness and maintenance in the serious financial industry. All in all, the proposed progressed Python-based design addresses a critical headway in ATM improvement, offering a thorough answer for the diverse difficulties looked by conventional financial frameworks. By focusing on security, versatility, and versatility, this engineering vows to reform the financial experience, giving clients improved comfort, security, and customized administrations while engaging monetary foundations with the adaptability to enhance and adjust to changing business sector elements.

articleTitle: SDR-Based Store & Forward Repeater PTToC Using QKD
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The rapid evolution of Software-Defined Radio (SDR) technology, coupled with advancements in quantum computing, has significantly enhanced contemporary communication systems. This paper presents a novel Store & Forward Repeater system for Push-to-Talk over Cellular (PTToC), integrating SDR with quantum technologies to enhance security and performance. Traditional repeaters encounter limitations in security, latency, and data integrity. Our system leverages SDR’s flexibility and reconfigurability, enabling dynamic adjustments in frequency and modulation to optimize communication between distant nodes in mobile networks. The system incorporates Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) for secure data transmission, ensuring that any interception attempts are detected, thereby providing theoretically unbreakable encryption. The Store & Forward Repeater stores messages when the destination is unreachable and forwards them securely once reconnected, minimizing data loss. Our testing demonstrated substantial improvements in latency (up to 70% reduction), error rate, and data security over conventional PTToC systems. We also provide a comprehensive comparison with conventional communication systems, highlighting the advantages of integrating quantum cryptography with SDR. Numerical analysis underscores the efficiency gains achieved through QKD over traditional encryption methods. Finally, we discuss future research directions, including quantum-assisted modulation schemes and the integration of 5G networks to further enhance communication in mission-critical applications. This work establishes the groundwork for scalable, secure communication systems with applications in public safety, military, and emergency response scenarios.

articleTitle: Optimized Deep Learning-Based Intrusion Detection and Secure, Energy-Efficient Routing in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The growth of WSN and the Internet of Things (IoT) has been phenomenal as a consequence of recent technical developments. The supplier of cloud services experiences maximum delay due to the enormous amount of data processing required. The IoT is made possible by fog computing, which is an unsecured computing technology that supports programs on billions of connected gadgets in an efficiently and economical way. It has the potential to address issues with Internet of Things applications that need location awareness, geolocation, low latency, and movement support. When it involves fog-based WSNs, cybersecurity is of the utmost importance, and IDS (intrusion detection systems) are often built using Deep Learning (DL) models. This method's design allows applications to run on platforms that are near the network's edge, reducing service overhead. A cloud-like system that provides users with preservation, software service, and computer assets. As a new method, it encounters many problems with security and privacy due to the fact that fog gadgets are often located in areas with low levels of protection. The confidentiality of information may be jeopardized by cyberattacks such as port scanning, disruption of service, probes, and man-in-the-middle attacks. The Cuckoo optimization method has shown results that are slightly better, with a precision of 99%. In addition, the Behavior-based IDS approach has shown moderate findings with a 99% success rate.

articleTitle: Analyzing Unstructured Data: Natural Language Processing Frameworks, Challenges, Approaches, and Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Today’s world data is about 80-90% unstructured, which makes it very complex to analyze, interpret and understand. Meaningful insights, patterns are hidden in the data, discovering knowledge and converting to structured form is important. It is also important to interpret in various forms and process the data. In this paper, we have presented an overview which includes various texts, their representation formats and finds Natural Language Processing (NLP), an essential component for interpreting the unstructured form. NLP components including its history, components, architecture, and challenges are well illustrated. Presented Research dives the evolution of NLP from rule-based systems to modern Deep Learning (DL) approaches. Key features and characteristics such as Natural Language Understanding (NLU), Natural Language Generation (NLG), and machine translation are discussed. The architectural framework of NLP systems is presented, furthermore, we address research and industrial challenges in NLP, emphasizing the need for robust methodologies, domain-specific changes, and ethical considerations.

articleTitle: Intelligent Resource Scheduling for Edge-Integrated IoT Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: With the proliferation of connected devices brought about by the IoT, new obstacles have developed in the way of effective management of resources and processing of data. Autonomous cars, smart cities, healthcare, and industrial automation all rely on real-time processing and minimal latency responses. Some of the disadvantages of the conventional architecture in cloud computing are issues with the network congestion, latency, and scalability. But it is quite possible in edge computing that utilizes network bandwidth efficiently, has less latency, and includes computation in data origination. Rendering resource management at the edge challenging is due to constantly evolving IoT environments and the variability of workload and applications/devices’ demands. Drawing from deep learning approaches, this paper proposes an intelligent resource scheduling framework for IoT systems with edge integration. Thereby acting in real-time based on the existing condition of the network and the availability and needs of the connected devices, the framework adjusts the offloading and allocation of tasks. This means that when future workloads are predicted and resources properly assigned, the deep learning model adjusts task schedules. In conditions of scarce resources and a high rate of change in the environment, this method ensures the rational distribution of resources, reduces the load on the network, and significantly reduces the time required to complete work. Substantial experimental and simulation data show that the projected framework is better than the existing scheduling algorithms in terms of system outcome, power consumption, and time to task execution.

articleTitle: Advanced Forecasting of Covid-19 Infections Using Ensemble Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The global spread of the corona virus (COVID-19) is a pressing concern in the modern day. The effects of COVID-19 are noticeable throughout the population, and this includes the elderly who suffer from conditions such as asthma and other chronic illnesses. The medical industry has recently seen several accomplishments from ML and DL. Using ensemble deep learning models, this study primarily aims to forecast the figure of complete, fatal, and improved COVID-19 cases. Medical professionals can control the pandemic scenario with the use of accurate prediction models. The purpose of this learning was to determine the best prototypical for predicting the number of COVID-19 patients that survived, died, or recovered by using ensemble deep learning classifiers. Some of the approaches that are used are ResNet-50, Attention based LSTM (A-LSTM), and long short-term memory (LSTM). The Adaptive Bald Eagle Search Optimization (ABESO) program optimizes the neural networks' weights. The last step in predicting COVID-19 instances is to apply the softmax layer after ensembleing the network information via modality fusion. On two datasets, the WHO and JH, the collaborative method and current DL methods such as LSTM, ResNet-50, A-LSTM, and Bi-LSTM are evaluated using performance metrics like RMSE, MAE, and MAPE for confirmed, demise, and regaining cases.

articleTitle: Enhanced Shape Recognition Through Multi-Scale Morphological Image Processing and Preprocessing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Important for surgical planning and therapy, hemorrhage stroke identification using shape priors is a key component of medical image processing. The complex architecture and high dimensionality of medical imaging data make this task difficult. The lack of a large number of labelled training samples and the low intensity contrast between the blood circulation and the complex shape topology are two of the obstacles. Many methods, such as deep learning models and low-level image analysis, have been proposed to deal with these problems. The usage of a DL-based Multiscale-MMNN for accurate outline appreciation of hemorrhage stroke is the primary emphasis of this research thesis. From the vantage points of PSNR, SSIM, and MSE, the suggested approach is contrasted with preexisting form recognition algorithms like CNN, Residual CNN, and MCDNN. When associated to up-to-date methods, the suggested methodology achieves 99.5% of its measured outcomes. The following phase employs morphological procedures to semantically segment hemorrhage stroke using Multiresolution U-Net. At a 97.9% improvement over state-of-the-art segmentation methods like U-net, SegNet, ResNet, and 3D-ResU-Net, this method accurately and rapidly identifies hemorrhagic stroke. Superior sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, and precision were attained by the suggested methodology’s performance rate when contrasted with older conventional approaches.

articleTitle: Metabolite Profiling of Herbal Medicines using an Artificial Intelligence Approach-A Concise Review
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is being developed extremely swiftly in medicine. A structured review should be conducted to comprehend the current status of AI models since they have been introduced in Traditional medicine to Investigate and classify the present applications of AI in TM. Following the technique suggested by the Joanna Briggs Institute, a thorough scoping review was conducted. To find papers on AI and CAM, three databases were searched: PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane Library. Studies published only in English since 2000 are taken into account. Those without mention of traditional medicine or AI methods were also disqualified, as were studies that were not peer-reviewed. All pertinent studies were located using a comprehensive search technique. This review demonstrated the potential use of AI models in TM; nevertheless, to develop AI in TM in the era of digital health, future research should concentrate on validating and verifying the models by carrying out a sizable clinical investigation.

articleTitle: Visual Narratives: Bridging Images and Stories Using NLP
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In today’s visual world, the power of turning images into narrative experiences is still an untapped market. The problem is that there lacks a simple yet powerful system to automatically translate images into engaging, contextually rich stories — until now this has been the goal of "Image to Story Narration" work. The system uses state-of-the-art AI algorithms based on the deep learning and modern natural-language processing mechanisms to comprehend both textual input data from users as well visual content in order to build consistent, creative stories. It has an easy to use interface where users can upload images and pick a genre for their stories such as Horror, Action, Romance, Comedy, Historical or Sci-fi.The image-to-caption module uses deep learning to generate textual descriptions and the caption-to-story-module employs a GPT-2 model. This twin-module design guarantees tales that are contextually perfect yet also imaginative compelling. Preliminary results suggest the system is competitive in generating a variety of engaging narratives, spanning multiple genres. The resulting stories, both in terms of accuracy and creativity outperform plain factual captions showing a high level satisfaction towards the successful translation from visual to narrative form. In early testing, the system has been adept at producing original science fiction stories and highly factual historic tales. Applications for this "Image to Story Narration" work are broad, from improving sighted multimedia teaching aids and presentations to creating immersive storytelling experiences for the blind. The proposed system is very effective at producing relevant sentences for images. It also generates descriptions that are notably more true to the specific image content than previous work.

articleTitle: BlockSure: A Decentralized Blockchain Platform for Secure and Trustworthy Transactions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Transaction services built on the blockchain provide a revolutionary means of boosting security and trust in online transactions. The approach ensures more dependable transactions by reducing the chance of returns and cancellations by asking both buyers and sellers to stake a commitment. This decentralized platform is especially helpful for small businesses since it makes use of the transparent and immutable properties of blockchain technology to create a trustworthy environment. This study examines how blockchain technology can be applied in an ecosystem that is driven by business, emphasizing how it can lower fraud, boost accountability, and give people more power through decentralized governance. The proposed system seeks to transform the way transactions are carried out by integrating smart contracts, cryptographic security, and consensus methods. This would provide a safe, transparent, and fair marketplace for all participants.

articleTitle: Analysis of TS-SLIPT for a Composite Underwater and RF Communication Link
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This paper comprises the study carried out to analyze the performance a hybrid underwater wireless optical communication (UWOC) - radio frequency link (RF) that utilizes one of the simultaneous light wave information and power transfer (SLIPT) technique for data transmission. The hybrid link is assumed to comprise of an autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) that acts as the signal transmitter, a time switching (TS) SLIPT enabled communication buoy (CB) floating on water body surface which carries out energy harvesting (EH) and information decoding (ID) and an onshore data centre (ODC) which receives the RF signal transmitted from the CB. Such a link finds its utilization not only in commercial domain but also in military applications for communicating during land-sea operations. In this link the CB utilizes the harvested energy to transmit the decoded signal to ODC. Further the closed form expressions of outage probability and throughput of the entire AUV-ODC link were derived considering TS-SLIPT method at the CB and the results were compared with the simulations carried out. Further simulations were carried out to demonstrate that optimal TS parameter selection helps in minimizing the outage probability for a given data rate. The effect of optimal combined value of TS parameter and target data rate on the performance of the hybrid link was also demonstrated via simulation. The paper also draws a performance comparison between the power splitting (PS) and TS enabled SLIPT for the same set up of hybrid link. The simulations are carried out considering three variety of water types namely pure sea, clear ocean and coastal water.

Author Keywords: Simultaneous lightwave information and power transfer (SLIPT)

articleTitle: Leveraging Data Mining Classifiers for Robust Ddos Attack Detection in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: One sort of infiltration in cloud computing environments is the Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attack, which covertly inserts malicious data packs into net traffic and has a devastating effect on end users. When it came to protecting the server from several external unauthorised traffics, typical cyber-security solutions fell short. A well-designed intrusion detection system (IDS) is a vital component of any loT design. When developing ML algorithms for intrusion detection, it is necessary to do thorough literature studies to study different machine learning approaches, neural network models, and optimisation algorithms. This will help uncover any gaps or flaws and ultimately lead to the development of more effective algorithms. We create data mining algorithms like C4.5, SVM, and KNN, and test how well they can identify DDoS attacks. Various classifier methods, including CART, Random Forest, and Naive Bayes, are used to compare the created algorithms' performance. While the SVM-based DDoS attack discovery model performed better than all other procedures, it struggled with handling massive datasets, according to the results analysis. An approach to this challenge is the development of Artificial Neural Network (ANN) based approaches for effective intrusion detection.
