The accuracy of the various approaches shown by KNN, SVM, C4.5 with KNN, and C4.5 with SVM varies when compared. In general, KNN shows respectable accuracy, although SVM is somewhat less accurate. C4.5 integrated with KNN enhances precision. Out of all the approaches that were investigated, the one that sticks out with an astonishing 97% accuracy is the one that is suggested: C4.5 with SVM.

articleTitle: Integrating Multi-Criteria Decision-Making for Improved Congestion Control in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The many elements that contribute to the problem of congestion make it a difficult decision-making task. This is because of the complexity of the situation. Since this is the case, the objective of this chapter is to provide a method for the management of congestion that takes use of a well-known MCDM methodology. Using this method, alternative options are evaluated that are based on the relative relevance of a number of factors. The investigation came to the conclusion that cluster heads that were chosen for the purpose of transferring information to the sink node based on a single criterion do not provide acceptable thermal performance. That being said, while selecting a cluster head, it is necessary to take into consideration a number of parameters. Multi-criteria decision making (MCDM) is a process that takes into consideration a variety of conflicting criteria in order to arrive at the most appropriate response. At your disposal are a variety of MCDM approaches. A strategy that we have recommended makes use of the Analytic hierarchy process (AHP) since it is preferable in terms of picking the best choice from a group of options that are competing with one another. The newly developed Security aware congestion control-Fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (SACC-FAHP) method provides pinpoint precision. Compared to Security aware congestion control (SACC), Congestion aware routing algorithm CARA, and Security aware congestion control- Analytic hierarchy process (SACC-AHP), which all have a lower level of accuracy, SACC-FAHP always surpasses each of these methods under every scenario, especially when the total number of unwanted nodes is reduced, with an accuracy of 96.12%.

articleTitle: An Optimized Hamiltonian Quantum Generative Network Based Drug-Drug Interactions Prediction Through Combining Local And Global Features
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This work is important in clinical practice and drug development because DDIs are a major factor that poses serious risks to patients’ safety. To enable medication to be given properly with the least side effects, probable DDIs must be predicted correctly. This work introduces a new Spike driven Transformer based Hamiltonian Quantum Generative Adversarial Network with Gorilla Troops Optimizer (SDTbHQGAN-GTO), which achieves every given data set’s accurate DDIs prediction with ease. First, the DDIs datasets are obtained and then pre-processed where noise feature is eliminated from the data through normalization and data cleaning process. Subsequently, the local and global features concerning DDI prediction can be acquired employing Spike driven Transformer (SDT). After that, the DDI interaction can be predicted from the extracted data using Hamiltonian Quantum Generative Adversarial Network with Gorilla Troops Optimizer abbreviated as HQGAN-GTO. It is also possible to optimize the parameters of the HQGAN including reduction of the error and enhancement of the prediction accuracy using the Gorilla Troops Optimizer (GTO). Finally, the performance of the proposed method can be analysed in terms of accuracy, precision, recall and f-score. This approach is superior to the suggested one in terms of the worst-case higher order estimate in offering better 99.82% accuracy, 99.81% precision, 99.812% f1-score, 99.821% recall. Therefore for the accurate prediction of DDIs the proposed method surpasses the current methods in a significant way.

articleTitle: Post-Quantum Cryptography: Securing Critical Infrastructure Against Emerging Quantum Threats
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The rapid advancements in quantum computing pose significant threats to traditional cryptographic systems, which are foundational to securing modern digital infrastructure. Cryptosystems like RSA and ECC, currently relied upon for secure communications, are vulnerable to quantum attacks, necessitating the development of post-quantum cryptography (PQC). The proposed methodology in this paper focuses on safeguarding critical infrastructure from quantum-based cyberattacks by leveraging PQC. The framework integrates several key strategies: hybrid cryptography, which combines classical and post-quantum algorithms to ensure security even as quantum threats evolve; quantum key distribution (QKD), ensuring secure communication by detecting any interception attempts; and post-quantum algorithms designed to resist quantum computing capabilities. The methodology also includes a robust security layer with incident response and threat monitoring systems to detect anomalies and initiate rapid responses to potential attacks. This holistic approach secures vital sectors like healthcare, energy, and telecommunications by future-proofing cryptographic measures against quantum threats.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches for Breast Cancer Prediction: A WEKA-Based Performance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The Major cause of deaths in women related to cancer is Breast Cancer these days. Increasing the accuracy in diagnostic is still a challenge even after so much progress in detecting and treating the disease. In this article, by using Machine Learning (ML) techniques, early investigation and early breast cancer prediction by focusing on two pivotal attributes: Menopause and Node-Caps. Utilizing Records of 1,144 patients each with ten attributes derived from testing reports, the study employs the Weka 3.6.9 tool in analyzing the dataset and compare the effectiveness of various ML classifiers, including KStar, Decision Table, and REPTree. For each classifier, the evaluation ensures calculation of F-Measure, Precision and Recall. The results indicate that KStar attains exorbitant accuracy, with weighted averages of 0.976 for Menopause and 0.980 for Node-Caps, indicating its worthier ability to forecast disease outcomes. Decision Table also exhibits a robust performance, especially in recall and F-Measure, while REPTree shows varying outcomes with improved performance for Node-Caps but lesser precision overall. The results emphasize the efficacy of ML techniques in augmenting early breast cancer detection, with KStar emerging as the most precise classifier for the traits analyzed. The study indicates that incorporating advanced ML methods could help in early diagnostics of breast cancer.

articleTitle: Study Of 5G IoT Module And Leveraging For Military Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The rapid evolution of 5G technology is transforming the landscape of the "Internet of Things (IoT), enabling the deployment of high-speed, low-latency, and massive device communication" networks [1]. This paper studies the design, development, and integration of 5G IoT modules, focusing on their architecture, functionality, and performance in real-world military applications. By leveraging 5G’s "enhanced mobile broadband (eMBB), ultra-reliable low-latency communication (URLLC), and massive machine-type communication (mMTC)". 5G IoT modules also facilitate a range of military solutions, including battlefield communication, autonomous systems, Internet of Military Things (IoMT), and situational awareness [1]. The paper investigates the role of network slicing in optimizing specific mission-critical applications, ensuring isolated and secure communication in contested environments. Paper concludes by addressing challenges such as security, interoperability, and energy consumption while providing insights into the future of 5G IoT in military strategy.

articleTitle: Enhanced Prediction of Early-Stage Autism Using Supervised Learning with Optimized Feature Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: An autism spectrum disease (ASD) affects a person's brain development. Autism spectrum disorder is detected in children and young adults. For an early diagnosis of the disease, parental observation is crucial. That is why it is possible to provide children with effective therapy or treatment when they are young. Misdiagnosis is common due to the wide range of symptoms and levels of autism range syndrome. The datasets on children and toddlers with ASD that were identified at an early age were subjected to a limited number of Feature Transformation methods. The next step was to determine which classification methods performed best by applying them to various ASD datasets. Log, Power-Box Cox, and Yeo-Johnson Transformations for toddler datasets and Log transformations for children’s datasets were the FTs that followed the best prediction. The next step in using these altered datasets for early autism prediction is to use characteristic Selection Techniques in order to identify the most important ASD risk characteristic. In this comparison, the proposed method is the top machine learning technique with an incredible accuracy. Decision Tree, Random Forest (RF), K-Nearest Neighbours(KNN), Support Vector Machine(SVM), and Gradient Descent(GD) are some of the other models that perform a decent job, but they can't compare to the outstanding results that proposed method obtained. With an accuracy rate of 98.99%, proposed method stands out as the most reliable and efficient alternative among these methods.

articleTitle: Sustainable Logistics, Supply Chain Operations, Positioning and Routing in Motor Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: When motorists near an intersection, the system will alert them and tell them in what lane they should get into the intersection and how much time they have before the light changes. It has been the subject of heated dispute amongst industry professionals about whether a navigation system for autonomous vehicles is even possible. Analysis of the data collected by inertial sensors can also yield valuable results. Multiple types of sensors, such as radar, lidar, and cameras, could be included in a self-driving car. Threat areas are mapped with the use of a laser rangefinder. The environmental impact of traditional logistics tasks is startling. Imagine massive networks of energy-intensive warehouses, cargo ships spewing pollutants across oceans, and fleets of diesel vehicles. Since they make it easier to move products and services across borders and continents, the transportation and logistics sectors are essential to economic growth and global trade. However, this vital sector’s dependence on fossil fuels and antiquated methods has unintentionally worsened several environmental problems. Traditional logistics and transportation operations undoubtedly negatively influence the environment, from suffocating urban areas to raising greenhouse gas emissions that worsen climate change. In addition, the industry’s careless actions have damaged natural resources, resulting in resource depletion and ecological deterioration. The need for sustainability is becoming more pressing as societies, corporations, and governments struggle with the effects of climate change and environmental deterioration.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Hand Gestures Recognition Using Optimized Quantum GAN and ResNet-152 Features
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The creation of hand gesture recognition approach, such as sign language applications, is crucial to bridging the communication gap with non-sign language users. This work proposes a novel approach to hand gesture detection with improved efficiency and accuracy through the use of sophisticated pre-processing, feature extraction, and classification algorithms. The suggested approach presents a robust image pre-processing technique called Window-aware guided image filtering, which smooths gesture images while maintaining edge details that are essential for feature extraction. After that, high-level discriminative features are extracted from gesture photos using ResNet-152, a deep convolutional neural network. In order to improve gesture classification even more, a Quantum Generative Adversarial Network (QGAN) is included. This network makes use of quantum computing to accelerate convergence and improve learning effectiveness. Furthermore, the Zebra Optimization (ZO) is utilized to optimize the QGAN model by fine-tuning the network parameters for enhanced recognition performance. This hybrid approach achieves superior accuracy, robustness, and speed, outperforming traditional hand gesture recognition systems. The presented approach gained the efficiency of around 99% for all recognition metrics.

articleTitle: Enhanced Traffic Prediction for Smart Cities through IoT using Optimized Continual Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In many cities, traffic congestion has a negative impact on sustainability since it increases air pollution. Effective smart traffic management can help users avoid congested areas, thus reducing pollutant levels. It is complex and dynamic in nature that is why traffic propagation forecasting is not perfectly accurate due to the existence of numerous interactions involved in traffic flow complexity., decision makers have large datasets, whose utilisation helps in designing brilliant, sustainable transport solutions. In order to address with these challenges, the following novel framework is developed namely Enhanced Traffic Prediction for Smart Cities through IoT using Optimized Continual Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Network (CSTGCN-BTGO). In this work, the author has presented the traffic propagation model based on the traffic data of Buxton, UK. The feature extracted includes time, date, length, speed, flow, and headway of the traffic video which was accomplished using Differential Synchro-squeezing Wavelet Transform (DSWT). These features were then fed into a Continual Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Network (CSTGCN) for traffic propagation over the road network forecasting. This model will simulate traffic in a particularly busy municipality for a 5-minute interval by employing data whose source will be traffic sensors positioned at two terminals, they are vehicle speed data terminals. To improve the predictive accuracy of the above-mentioned approach, Banyan Tree Growth Optimization (BTGO) was incorporated into CSTGCN. Two error measure tools called accuracy and mean squared error were the two tools used to evaluate the suggested CSTGCN-BTGO method. Outcome indicates that CSTGCN-BTGO model has acquired approximately sixteen percent improvement than the baseline model. 53% increase in accuracy than existing methods such congestion prediction using LSTM-IOT, traffic control using Deep SORT-IOT and traffic accident prediction using CNN-IOT.

articleTitle: A Study on Innovative Work Behavior with Reference to Software Development Companies
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Innovation is a vital component of success in the software development industry, where companies constantly seek to improve processes, products, and services. While individual creativity and motivation are essential, organizational factors also play a significant role in shaping innovative work behavior. This study delves into the complex interplay between individual and organizational factors that influence innovative work behavior in software development companies. Using a mixed-methods approach, we collected survey data from software developers, conducted in-depth interviews, and observed work practices. Our results reveal those individual factors like creativity, autonomy, and motivation, as well as organizational factors like leadership support, resources, and a culture of innovation, significantly impact innovative work behavior. We also found that organizational factors moderate the relationship between individual factors and innovative work behavior.This study contributes to the understanding of innovative work behavior in software development, highlighting the importance of aligning individual and organizational factors to foster a culture of innovation. Our findings provide actionable insights for software development companies to develop strategies that promote innovative work behavior, drive competitiveness, and enhance success in the industry. By understanding the interplay between individual and organizational factors, companies can create an environment that encourages creativity, experimentation, and innovation, leading to the development of novel software solutions and improved business outcomes.

articleTitle: Ai-Driven Strategies for Securing Internet of Battlefield Things(IoBT)
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup> The Internet of Battlefield Things (IoBT) represents a significant advancement in modern warfare, leveraging the power of interconnected devices, sensors, and autonomous systems to enhance situational awareness, decision-making, and operational efficiency. However, the increasing complexity and scale of IoBT also introduce significant cyber security challenges, including vulnerabilities to cyber attacks such as Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS), data tampering, and adversarial artificial intelligence (AI). This paper explores AI-driven strategies for securing IoBT ecosystems, focusing on leveraging machine learning algorithms, real-time threat detection, and autonomous response systems to mitigate cyber risks. It examines the role of AI in enhancing encryption protocols, identifying anomalous behaviors across battlefield networks, and responding to threats autonomously with minimal human intervention. Additionally, the paper proposes adaptive security frameworks that utilize AI to learn from evolving threats and protect sensitive battlefield information. Through a detailed analysis of current cybersecurity challenges and AI applications, this paper aims to contribute to the development of resilient, intelligent defense mechanisms capable of securing future IoBT deployments in dynamic and hostile environments.

articleTitle: A Survey on Monkeypox Diagnosis Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: "Are you awaiting the dawn of a new day without health threats, like those we saw before COVID-19 became a global issue? Monkeypox symptoms are similar to those of smallpox and include fever, chills, headaches, and, later, distinctive rashes. The challenge is that these signs resemble common skin conditions like warts or chickenpox, making misdiagnosis likely. This complicates containment and delays intervention. Current diagnostic methods rely on clinical suspicion and lab-based tests, primarily requiring PCR, which may not be easily accessible in resource-limited areas. This overlap, along with delayed diagnosis, leads to continued transmission. Smart, cutting-edge technologies are essential to ensure rapid and accurate detection as the disease spreads. This literature review covers how deep learning algorithms are transforming medical imaging and DNA sequence analysis for monkeypox diagnosis. A deep learning system at the edge could offer more efficient, automated real-time diagnosis. Deploying this at the front lines or integrating with telehealth platforms would speed up the screening of potential cases without requiring expert interpretation. The research also explores AI’s ability to differentiate between the monkeypox virus (MPV) and human papillomavirus (HPV), which causes warts. This illustrates approaches and strategies to tackle this emerging health concern and shows how AI can play a key role in global public health campaigns, beyond just early detection, aiming for broader pandemic prevention efforts.

Author Keywords: LIME (Local Interpretable Model- A gnostic Explanations)

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis of Machine Learning Frameworks in the review of Multivariate datasets for Crop Yield Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Crop Yield Prediction (CYP) is crucial for optimizing agricultural practices globally. This study conducts an in-depth review of Machine Learning (ML) techniques applied to multivariate datasets for crop yield forecasting. We examine the performance of models including deep learning, ensemble classifiers, and hybrid approaches, emphasizing their ability to integrate diverse data sources and adapt to varying climatic conditions. Despite significant progress, challenges such as sparse data handling and generalization across regions persist. This paper not only identifies these challenges but also proposes advanced solutions for improving prediction accuracy, offering a roadmap for future research in agricultural ML frameworks.

articleTitle: Advancing Patient-Centric Care Through Genomic Data and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Personalized medicine use genomic information and data analysis in order to develop treatment plan applicable to the specific patient. This approach is on the rise as the method to sequence DNA becomes more efficient and enabled by state-of-art deep-learning algorithms. Within the paradigm of genetic variations, personalized medicine can decrease side effects that occur during the treatment process as well as increase its efficiency. This approach is opposite to the mass approaches in the traditional system where the treatment is the same for all patients. This approach involves sophistication of deep learning models that increase the precision of risk, biotherapeutic interventions and genomics’. It also combines genetic data with demographic and medical data to create extensive client portraits. The suggested approach can be considered as a powerful basis for the translation of the concept of the PM into clinical reality. It points to the change that has been experienced in recent years regarding ownership of health data and deep learning to improve patient experience. The further research in this field has to concentrate on the potential solutions with the development of the algorithmic methods, and the repeatability and reproducibility of the results as well as the author’s ethical approach to work.

articleTitle: Enhancing Data Integrity: Enforcing Ownership and Authorization Protocols in Machine Learning Model Development
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: There is a current lack of protection for multimedia data such as images, audio, video, and text from unauthorized machine learning training along with misuse of authors rights to their work; this paper therefore proposes a novel framework with the intention of giving the users more control and authorization for their data. It uses small distortions via simple mathematical operations which are still perceivable by the human eye while adding noise which will cause the current ML and DL models to fail. For images, by using random functions, pixel colors are changed in order to maintain picture quality but shift ML attention to the introduced patterns. Environmental sounds improve the audibility of audio and the human reader does not need to guess what the author means. In terms of quality, sine, cosine, and tangent transformations can be as applied to video frames. Text is encrypted by replacing like appearing Unicode characters that changes the machine learning vectors without losing content information. The results reveal that such micro-interferences allow for addressing the problem of protecting creators from misuse and unauthorized use of material by making it impossible for ML models to learn the initial data patterns which belong to the creators.

articleTitle: Navigating The Battleground: An Analysis Of Adversarial Threats And Protections In Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Deep learning techniques find broad applications in important areas such as malware detection systems, self-driving cars, and health care. However, it is still possible to attack deep learning soft intelligent models using adversarial example approaches. This study investigates the works and findings of recent research, whose central focus has been on adversarial machine learning, its weaknesses, and its application. Some of the focus has been on malware attacks that use deep learning frameworks, such as neural network based Jacobian saliency map attacks and anatomy of the Carlini and Wagner attacks. This has again posed a limitation to the present-day research on the increasing range of the actors and their role within the range of types of attack as well as strategies and development of countermeasures, including making biases and models to mitigate the threats. Furthermore, there is also a deficiency in the evaluation of defence mechanisms, particularly in developing appropriate parameters that would demonstrate the efficacy of the existing models. In conclusion, this paper presents communication and deliberations on areas that offer an interesting promise for future research in which the challenges experienced in applying deep learning systems will be satisfactorily addressed.

articleTitle: Adoption as a Population Stabilization Strategy in India: A Predictive Modeling Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Overpopulation, a pressing issue in India, is compounded by the nation's limited resources and has contributed to various socio-economic and environmental challenges. This study examines the relationship between population rates and adoption. It proposes that increasing adoption rates could be a viable solution to this issue. Using historical data and predictive modeling, the study examines fertility and forecasts population growth trends until 2050 and evaluates the potential of higher adoption rates to alleviate reliance on natural births and support sustainable development. The analysis incorporates a rich dataset of demographic factors, including adoption, births, and population, along with a sample of public viewpoints in India. This research contributes to the growing knowledge of adoption as a solution for population stability and machine learning-based counterfactual prediction.

articleTitle: Hybrid Texture Features and Support Vector Machine for Brain Tumor Cataloguing in MRI Images: An Inclusive Investigation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Worldwide, cancer kills more people than any other disease, and it will overtake all others as the top killer in the coming decades. The most effective ways to reduce death from brain cancer have been shown to be early identification and treatment. Recent advances in soft computing and image processing have substantially improved the understanding of medical pictures, which in turn has helped in early diagnosis. The absence of effective treatments, very high tumor heterogeneity, and low survival rates are hallmarks of GBM. Plus, there aren't a ton of MR pictures. It takes a lot of time and has a number of drawbacks to manually analyze these photographs. Maintaining a laser-like focus during the categorization process, which in turn increases the false hit rate, is also very taxing. For this reason, CAD has great promise as an automated approach for MR image analysis. Improving the accuracy of brain tumor categorization using routinely acquired T1 post-contrast MR imaging is the primary goal of this paper, which aims to develop, deploy, and assess a pattern recognition system for this purpose. Automatic brain tumor identification in MRI scans utilizing texture features extracted from the scans using a HTF and SVM is the primary focus of the first piece of research. Various assessment metrics are used to verify the experimental outcomes, including sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, matching index, overlap fraction, and extra fraction. In terms of classification accuracy, HTF with Achieving the greatest accuracy of 98% with GLCM-based vectors of features and 96%, SVM continuously showed the best performance across both conclusion tables When compared with other classifiers, HTF with SVM has a lower error in classification.

articleTitle: A Binary Question Answering System for Diagnosing Mental Health Syndromes powered by Large Language Model with Custom-Built Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: With telemedicine and remote patient monitoring, the need for accessible mental health resources has become increasingly apparent. This work presents a binary question-answering system tailored for individuals experiencing depression, utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs) designed to handle the complexities of mental health inquiries. By examining existing LLMs, a system enhanced by prompt engineering on pre-trained models was developed to meet the particular necessities of those seeking help for depression. Utilizing depression inventories and dictionaries, a detailed dataset of depression symptoms was compiled, creating precise prompts to elicit comprehensive and relevant responses from the LLMs. The system was tested using zero-shot, one-shot, and few-shot learning techniques, with results compared against human-generated responses to assess efficacy. This study confirms the flexibility and accuracy of LLMs in managing sensitive mental health conversations and serves as a foundation for future developments. Further enhancement of the system is proposed through specialized fine-tuning of LLMs with a dedicated corpus of depression-related prompts. The goal is to deliver a scalable, empathetic tool that provides timely and effective support for individuals battling mental health issues, leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to address a critical gap in mental health care.

articleTitle: Ensemble Methods for Early Prediction of Dementia
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Dementia is a progressive cognitive disorder that primarily affects older adults. The patients affected by Dementia experience memory loss, reasoning impairment, and behavioural changes. This condition significantly impacts the daily life and independent activities of the individuals. Although currently available medications cannot reverse or stop the neurodegeneration processes they can temporarily improve or maintain its cognitive functions in the early to moderate phases of the disease. However, early detection of the disease may delay its progression. The paper proposes a systematic approach by applying ensemble methods to predict dementia risk. The algorithms used included XGBoost (XGB), Gradient Boost (GB), Random Forest (RF), Voting Classifier (VC) includes Naïve Bayes (NB) and Support Vector Machine (SVM). The classification algorithms have been compared based on evaluation metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, and f1 score. The model developed achieved an accuracy of 97% and outperformed other methods on the same dataset. The final model enables the early detection of dementia, which is vital for slowing down the neurological decline associated with the disease. This approach is beneficial for underserved populations with limited access to healthcare providers.

articleTitle: Innovations in Mechanical Drawing and Computer Graphics: Enhancing Precision and Visualization in Engineering Design
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This study examines the significant advancements in computer graphics and mechanical drawing, with an emphasis on how these developments have revolutionised engineering design precision and visualisation. For engineers and designers, integrating cutting-edge computer-aided design (CAD) tools and visualisation technologies has become crucial as sectors continue to adapt to issues that are ever more complex. The study focusses on significant developments that improve design accuracy and enable detailed visual representations of engineering concepts, including augmented reality (AR), simulation methods, and 3D modelling. Professionals can streamline the engineering workflow by using CAD software to produce complex drawings that are both exact and easily customisable. Before physical prototyping takes place, decision-making based on examination of the product's performance under different conditions is made possible by the integration of simulation modelling. Furthermore, by offering immersive experiences that let stakeholders see and interact with 3D models in actual settings, augmented reality applications transform design assessments. The research emphasises the importance of these advances in enhancing engineering teams' cooperation, efficiency, and communication through a thorough examination of them. The ultimate goal of this research is to pinpoint future paths for the integration of computer graphics and mechanical drawing, opening the door for improved engineering design and development processes.

articleTitle: Ransomware Classification: A Comparative Analysis of ML Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The increasing prevalence of ransomware, malware, and malicious cyberattacks poses a significant threat to computer networks, data centers, websites, mobile applications, and industrial environments across various business sectors. Ransomware, a type of malicious software, encrypts victims’ files and demands a ransom for the decryption key, creating widespread disruption for individuals and organizations globally. As ransomware continues to evolve and grow in sophistication, the timely and accurate detection of ransomware has become essential. This study aims to address this critical issue by providing a comprehensive analysis of ransomware variants and exploring the use of machine learning techniques to enhance detection capabilities. The research employs a systematic review of existing ransomware detection methods and evaluates the potential of machine learning models to classify and detect different ransomware variant groups. The findings highlight the strengths and limitations of various approaches and demonstrate the effectiveness of machine learning in identifying ransomware patterns. This study’s insights are expected to contribute to the development of more robust and adaptive defense mechanisms against the ever-evolving threat of ransomware.

articleTitle: Enhancing Dynamic Images For End-To-End Training-Based Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In computer vision, object identification using convolutional neural networks is currently trending. There will be a dramatic drop in detection ability in low-light situations due to the image's lighting component, which severely affects object identification. For improved detection results, it is recommended to use a low light picture enhancement approach as a pre processing mechanism to increase image quality. However, current enhancing strategies could be ineffective on some samples because of the intricacy of low-light conditions. As a result, doing better overall detection in low-light circumstances is challenging. We focus on improving object recognition accuracy using picture augmentation in this work, not human perceptual quality. The proposed image enhancement model is compared with the other enhancement techniques such as Histogram equalization (HE), Contrast limited adaptive histogram equalization (CLAHE), gamma correction (GC), and balance contrast enhancement technique (BCET). For the object detection we have used three different methods of CNN to evaluate our image enhancementmodel. With a high detection rate of 98%, the suggested technique outperforms competing CNN algorithms on bigger datasets. When compared to GC, HE, CLAHE, and BCET, our suggested strategy yields more efficient object identification with values of 0.8219), 0.8052 (recall), and 0.8133 (F1-score).

articleTitle: Automated Hair Disease Classification Using VGG19: A Deep Learning Approach for Enhanced Diagnostic Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The research concerns the classification of hair diseases by VGG19 CNN model training. In the paper, several types of hair diseases were used for training and testing of the model with the hope of improving diagnostic support for dermatologists. Because the incidence of hair and scalp disorders is increasing today, automatic detection systems play an important role in early diagnosis and treatment rather than the time-consuming way of manual analysis of medical images. VGG19 architecture was chosen because its deep layers extract fine features. After optimization and fine-tuning, the model achieved a test accuracy of 98.67% and a test loss of 5.34%, so the model has been very effective in identifying hair diseases from dermatoscopic images. Inter-model assessment did exist on the basis of a confusion matrix, which depicted that only negligible cases of misclassifications occurred among the classes. The testing phase took 11.42 seconds to complete because of the model’s efficiency and its suitability for real-world clinical applications. Ultimately, VGG19 seems to be a promising gadget for hair disease diagnosis without human intervention, having immense potential to raise the accuracy and speed of diagnosis in dermatological practice. Further integrative studies are recommended with the clinical setting to test wider perspectives and validation.

articleTitle: Unveiling Security Vulnerabilities in NFTs: A Comprehensive Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The biggest invention of Non-Fungible Tokens System (NFTs), that defines its role digitally using the self-generated concept of proof of ownership, which comes as a result of continues progress and advancement in Blockchain Technology This study aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of NFTs, their foundational technology, and the platforms enabling their trade. It highlights the key challenges of implementing NFT technology, focusing on issues related to ownership, governance, security, privacy, and environmental concerns. The research explores the inherent risks in the evolving NFT ecosystem, offering insights into the nature and scale of these threats. Additionally, it proposes a set of actionable solutions for participants and stakeholders to mitigate these risks. By categorizing core hazards within a simplified taxonomy, this paper identifies key vulnerabilities and outlines strategies for addressing them to enhance the safety and sustainability of the NFT space.

articleTitle: Hyperparameter Optimization and Its Impact on Machine Learning Performance for Heart Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The heart is the utmost crucial part of human body. The heart is the primary pumping organ responsible for circulating blood via the veins. Because it is responsible for pumping blood, which delivers oxygen, nutrition, metals, and alcohol throughout the body, the cardiovascular system is an extremely important part of our bodies. If the heart's regular action is interrupted for whatever cause, Serio's health issues, including death, should be the consequence of its faulty functioning. Sedentary lifestyle, tobacco use, excessive alcohol use, and a high-fat diet are risk factors for cardiovascular disease. The World Health Organization, for instance, estimates that sentiment illness is answerable for the demises of almost 10 million people annually throughout the globe. Preventing gastrointestinal problems requires an appropriate diet and prompt diagnosis. The primary challenge in contemporary medicine is the delivery of top-notch services and the establishment of reliable diagnoses in a timely manner. Cardiac disorders may be efficiently treated and controlled, despite being recognized as the most common cause of mortality globally in recent years. Analysis along with information extraction may be done using records of a massive database of medical data that physicians have collected. Data mining approaches allow us to sift through the mountain of existing knowledge in search of previously unknown but potentially valuable insights. Several scientists are using data mining and statistical methods to help detect heart problems. Discrete data is the main content of the medical database. Consequently, using datasets to make judgments is a tough and demanding task. According to the experimental findings of the performance assessment on the heart dataset, the suggested XGBC model is far more effective with an accuracy of 99%.

articleTitle: Improving Fog Computing Infrastructure with Qos-Aware Resource Provisioning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In today's internet-enabled world, it's possible for everything to link to anything else. Because of this, a new way of working known as the Global Internet of Things has emerged, and it has begun to produce massive amounts of data. While it may be difficult to glean insights from streaming data, doing so has the potential to unleash technological marvels that will benefit society at large. It is critical to have a system in place to store, process, and forecast the data. Another active field of study, infrastructure development has seen a shift from centralised server systems to distributed cloud systems and is continuing to do so. There is a lot of room for investigation into the cloud's shortcomings in processing streaming data and making decisions in near real-time. Now that we have a network, the next step is to find a way to make it more useful and to distribute the load more evenly across the nodes via efficient routing. So that the network doesn't fail suddenly from too much traffic, the allocation is based on the present node load and the total network load. A balanced load on each node in the network is another result of optimised route selection. We built and tested a simple RL algorithm for an insignificant network that leverages the Q-Table. To get around the Q-Table's high level of complexity, an RL technique based on neural networks was suggested, which performs better on big networks. Over all time periods, the Proposed Deep RL technique outperforms Open Shortest Path First (OSPF) and Deep Neural Networks (DNN), achieving an accuracy of almost 92% in minimising average latency. In real-time applications, when minimising latency is crucial, its improved efficiency is evident.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Image Data Sharing through Visual Cryptography System: A compressive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: A method known as "visual cryptography" encrypts pictures so that they can be seen decrypted without the need for intricate calculations. This method is crucial for safe image sharing because it guarantees the confidentiality of important visual data while it is being transmitted. This research has recognized the importance of this and has proposed a unique method called Segment-Based-Visual-Cryptography-Scheme (SBVCS)-based Pictorial Cryptosystems. There are two primary stages to this approach: Insertion and Removal. In addition to integrating safety features like Modified HMAC-based One-Time- Password generation technique (MHOTP) for better Elliptic-Curve-Cryptosystems (IECC)-based encoding and Baker's map-based encryption, it entails encrypting three initial pictures and two secret pictures using a variety of encryption techniques, including Unplanned grid-based untold picture distributing, Increased Visual-Cryptography-Scheme (EVCS), and Kronecker product-based encrypted data. To generate the best cryptography keys feasible, the SBVCS method is utilized in the Kronecker-product-based cryptography step. With three significant improvements over the traditional Gold Rush-Optimization (GRO) algorithm, the SBVCS is presented as a more sophisticated method. The effectiveness and dependability of the SBVCS in producing ideal keys for Kronecker-product-based encryption are greatly increased by these improvements. Moreover, the MHOTP generation approach is employed in the IECC-based encryption, and the OTPs the results of this procedure serve as the authentication credentials for the encoding phase, so converting the ECC algorithm into an IECC algorithm. Reversing the actions taken during different encryption phases is the decryption process. The importance of this suggested strategy is in its capacity to improve security by combining encryption techniques with security precautions. The method has been put through a number of analyses to confirm its efficacy, and the results show that it can safely transmit and recreate hidden pictures in Visual Cryptography settings.

articleTitle: CleanComm: A Hybrid ACO-WOA-MOA Model for Sustainable Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) and their applications are on an increasing trend owing to the users’ demands with interest in environmental activities, intelligent cities, and medical assistance. However, because of the inefficiency and limitations of wireless sensor networks, it is still very difficult to optimize the network parameters and performance (energy consumption, area coverage and reliable information transfer). In this paper optimization algorithms including Ant Colony Optimization (ACO), Moth Flame Optimization (MFO) and Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA) to enhance the effectiveness of wireless sensor systems are presented. In this approach, ACO captures and explores functional properties, MFO coordinates the optimization and exploration processes, and WOA concentrates on global exploration. Wide-ranging simulations demonstrate that the recommended approach is more effective than the existing approaches in enhancing energy efficiency, network lifetime and effectiveness of packet delivery. The findings in this paper indicate that the proposed hybrid algorithms support the various requirements of the WSN, thus promoting development of networks that are secure and dependable.

articleTitle: Advanced Neural Network Optimization for Eeg-Based Epileptic Seizure Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Our study created a computer-assisted method that detects and classifies epileptic episodes using an optimized neural network. Big data methods and the exponential growth of healthcare data have enabled AI use in healthcare. AI helps healthcare providers reduce mistakes and retrieve vital data for fast decision-making. Radiology equipment using AI can provide correct data and eliminate the need for tissue samples. In order to attain the best degree of precision while working with large datasets, some techniques may degrade accuracy. Through a unique way, our team is improving performance and user acceptability with neural networks and deep learning. By adopting an optimized neural network, a computer-aided approach was devised to identify epileptic seizures using EEG data. SONN clustered input patterns into four categories. EEG signal feature extraction using DWT. This collected data was placed into a Genetic Algorithm-trained model that combines SONN and MLP methods. MLP networks were trained by clustering input samples using Self-organizing Neural Networks (SONN). The model classified samples as epileptic or non-epileptic using classifier. A comparison of models showed the recommended technique was effective. The hybrid method improved EEG signal categorization using SONN and MLP-GA.

articleTitle: Random Coupled Neural Network with Sand Cat Swarm Optimization for Automatic Object Detection in Aerial Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Object detection in aerial images plays a crucial role in parking space management, traffic monitoring, and surveillance systems. Every day, vast amounts of aerial and satellite imagery are being collected, and analyzing this extensive data can greatly benefit numerous practical applications. However, traditional Automatic Object detection in aerial image methods struggles with challenges posed by complex backgrounds and detecting small objects in large-scale scenes. To address the previously mentioned challenges, a Random Coupled Neural Network with Sand Cat Swarm Optimization (RCNNet+SCSO) is proposed for automatic object detection in aerial images, ensuring high accuracy. In this approach, images from the UC Merced dataset are used, and to initially reduce noise in the input data, Shape-Aware Mesh Normal Filtering (SAMNF) is introduced. Next, the pre-processed images are subjected to object detection using Improved YOLO-V4. Following that, classification is performed with the Random Coupled Neural Network (RCNNet), which is optimized by Sand Cat Swarm Optimization (SCSO), resulting in automatic object detection in aerial images with enhanced efficiency and accuracy. The performance of the proposed RCNNet+SCSO is evaluated using the UC Merced dataset, achieving 99.2% accuracy and demonstrating superior results compared to existing methods. The outcomes of the proposed technique showed automatic object detection in aerial images that enhance the efficiency of various applications, including urban planning, traffic management, and surveillance. By leveraging advanced algorithms, it accurately identifies vehicles, buildings, and other objects, even in complex environments. This technology offers improved scalability and precision compared to traditional methods.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Object Detection and Voice Guidance Using Yolo Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Machine learning is used now a days in multidiscipline. Vision based or image-based application is very popular in healthcare and human interaction. The proposed model of this article is focus on visually challenged individuals to navigating the environment and ensure their safety by detecting nearby objects using the machine learning algorithm like YOLOV5 model. Secondary module is focus on alert intimation through speech notification. Clear vision is one of the God’s gifts, unfortunately so human is having some issue in their vision, this kind of modern technology will help to solve this issue. This model is mainly help to identify the object at the same time spatial location. Computer vision algorithms, particularly those that leverage convolutional neural networks, are subsequently employed to identify and categorize objects within the scene. The spatial location of these objects is determined, potentially using depth sensors or stereo cameras to calculate distance and relative position. This integration of technology not only aids in recognizing objects but also enhances spatial awareness, contributing to safer and more confident navigation for visually impaired individuals. The average precision level of proposed model is 91% and average Recall value is providing 0.88.

articleTitle: Transcription, Translation and Summarization to Improve Educational Understanding
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In-depth research on improving educational comprehension with the use of summarization, translation, and transcription technology is presented in this work. With an emphasis on accuracy and efficiency, a comparative analysis of the different models employed in these processes is carried out. In particular, we investigate the use of Whisper AI for transcription tasks and a Python interface for text summarization when implementing BART (Bidirectional and Auto-Regressive Transformers). Our results show that Whisper AI greatly increases transcription speed and accuracy, whereas BART excels at producing clear and succinct summaries. Better educational content distribution can be enabled by incorporating these modern techniques, which will make the material easier for teachers and students to understand. This research has many kinds of practical applications, from translating instructional materials between languages to producing succinct summarized notes and then providing flashcards and quizzes based on that.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing Revolution From Humble Beginnings to Deep Learning and Beyond
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This paper explores the intricate development of Natural Language Processing (NLP), a domain which is centered at the core of computational intelligence and human communication. This research is inspired by the need to understand the foundations of NLP and how it has influenced the development of human-computer interactions, language comprehension systems and information retrieval techniques. It explores the transformational effect of deep learning and attention-based models such as the third-generation Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT-3), Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer (T5) and Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT). The models mentioned above have greatly improved the capability to comprehend and generate human-like language using computers. The originality of the work is also reflected on its comprehensive overview of key NLP concepts, tracing chronological advancements, exploring deep learning innovations, and discussing effective pruning techniques to optimize model performance. By reviewing the history of NLP, this research not merely brings the past into focus but suggests future developments for scholars to investigate and find solutions for current challenges in NLP. Its results not only act as a guide for practitioners today but also suggest new directions for research and development that will help meet the challenges of tomorrow in this dynamic discipline of NLP.

articleTitle: Virtual Environment Integration in Arch Linux Using Btrfs Subvolumes
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Virtual environments have become essential in programming, providing isolated workspaces that prevent dependency conflicts and ensure clean development environments. However, their application at the operating system level remains underutilized. This research focuses on integrating virtual environments within an Arch Linux distribution using Btrfs subvolumes. By leveraging Btrfs's advanced features, we centralize user-specific data, including packages, configuration files, and environment variables, within the user’s home directory. This method allows for seamless switching between distinct user-defined environments while maintaining system stability and performance. Unlike traditional containerization and virtualization methods like Docker and KVM, which introduce significant overhead and complexity-ty, our approach creates lightweight, isolated environments directly at the file system level. Btrfs subvolumes offer a manageable and efficient solution, providing complete isolation of file systems, configurations, and packages. Additionally, Btrfs's built-in snapshot feature enhances reliability by allowing users to revert to previous states with minimal data loss. Through comprehensive testing, this method demonstrates minimal overhead, with performance metrics comparable to a standard Arch Linux installation. The integration of virtual environments using Btrfs subvolumes not only enhances system stability but also reduces resource contention, leading to an improved user experience. This approach offers a robust, flexible, and efficient solution for managing complex workflows in a Linux environment, particularly benefiting users engaged in development, hacking, and gaming. The research concludes by identifying potential challenges and future work, such as automating environment switching and extending support to networked environments, which could further refine and expand the applicability of this method.

articleTitle: Cognitive Deep-Learning approach to enhance Problem-Solving Skills based on Knowledge Organization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Knowledge is a fundamental component of human cognition that exists in procedural, declarative, and non-declarative forms and plays a crucial role in influencing problem-solving capabilities. In the current environment of education and professional development, the capacity to solve complex problems effectively is of great importance. Graduates are often examined for problem-solving skills as they transition from education to the professional world. Despite the vast amount of knowledge available, graduates frequently face challenges applying their cognitive skills to real-world situations. This requires a deeper insight into how different types of knowledge and their organization affect problem-solving abilities. Recent studies have demonstrated how data mining techniques with access to surveys can potentially solve problems associated with Attention Deficit Disorder (ADD) and Absence Epilepsy. Research on data pattern analysis regarding depression, anxiety, and cognitive impairments has actually enabled researchers to design interventions in the form of prototypes in video games that may improve cognitive and motor functions. The aim of this study is essentially applying a similar approach to analyze the intricate relationship between knowledge organization, cognitive skills, and problem-solving efficacy among graduates. The data is collected through surveys from the graduates. Concepts of data mining are used to extract the meaningful patterns between knowledge and cognitive skills and their impact on the problem-solving ability to analyze how effectively the knowledge is being used and affected for and by solving different problems. The study mainly focuses on deep learning approaches that are capable of recognizing complex patterns, inferring relationships, and providing tailored recommendations. In conclusion, This research will contribute to a deeper understanding of knowledge acquisition, organization, and utilization, with significant implications for education, cognitive science, and artificial intelligence. By identifying the mechanisms that underlie effective problem-solving, the study aims to inform the development of innovative strategies for knowledge management and skill enhancement, effectively bridging the gap between knowledge and its practical application in complex problem-solving scenarios.

articleTitle: Social Media Text Classification For Hate Speech Detection Using Different Feature Selection Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Social media content is one of the unregulated data and there is not any monitory policy is available for controlling the contents. However, a number of techniques are developed for monitoring the text data in social media but due to lake of effective feature extraction techniques there are very less accuracy has been observed in this context. In this paper we have tried to measure the impact of different feature-extraction methods over the deep learning model. In this context we have implemented five different feature selection models namely bi-gram based features, PoS based features, word count vectorizer, TF-IDF based Features and word embedding technique. These features are trained using a deep learning neural network and their performances of classification have been measured. The experimentation of hate speech detection dataset and the extensive experimental analysis we have found the following facts (1) the word count vectorizer and TF-IDF based features are providing higher training and validation accuracy (2) the variation in feature vector dimension can increase or decrease the classification accuracy (3) the higher dimensional feature vectors can increase resource consumption in terms of time and memory (4) in order to classify the text on social media the words may have grate importance. Based on this investigation we have planned to design a new feature descriptor that will improve the classification performance of small social media text.

articleTitle: Blockchain and Machine Learning For Predictive Analytics in Customer Relationship Management
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: CRM strengthens customer relationships in today's fast-paced corporate land-scape. This paper examines a novel strategy that integrates RNN, Deep Learning, and NLP with Blockchain-Enhanced Customer Relationship Management. This relationship might help firms foresee consumer needs, engage with them, and protect their data, improving CRM. Blockchain CRM (BCRM) secures and simplifies data. Trust and transparency are encouraged while customer data is protected. Deep learning algorithms make it simpler to segment clients and customize offerings. Time-series analysis using machine learning algorithms like RNN predicts client behavior accurately. NLP helps firms understand client feedback by analyzing reviews and comments. Our testing revealed RNN, NLP, and Deep Learning performed better. NLP was flawless, RNN right, and Deep Learning superior. These findings illustrate that the offered solutions may accommodate many corporate objectives and duties. Our graphics helped firms identify the optimal algorithm for CRM enhancement initiatives by comparing them. In predictive analytics accuracy, data security, speed, customization, and rule compliance, the BCRM approach using blockchain and machine learning outperforms CRM alternatives. It provides firms a competitive advantage in maintaining and strengthening customer connections, creating trust, and driving growth and success in a data-driven world.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Customer Segmentation for Enhanced Decision-Making in Retail Markets
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: People have recently become more cautious about online shopping. This has led to the development of online retail platforms and a deeper knowledge of customer purchase behavior. Retail organizations face the challenge of managing a large volume of customer purchases, requiring efficient methods to create more precise and effective consumer segmentation. Customer segmentation is an effective marketing weapon that supports consumer-centric services and, as a result, increases profitability. In this research, we propose a novel consumer segmentation model based on K-Means Clustering (KMC), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), and Central Limit Theorem (CLT) to enhance decision-making processes for companies. To handle large volumes of customer data, the PSO model is combined with the KMC algorithm to detect the optimal centroids in the clusters, which are then further optimized using CLT, resulting in more effective segmentation. For the experiments, we used a UK-based online retail dataset. We compared several state-of-the-art clustering techniques, including K-Means and K-Means++. The model was validated using four metrics: the Silhouette Index, Dunn's Index, Davies-Bouldin Index, and execution time. The proposed K-Means model outperforms existing clustering algorithms, with a Silhouette Index of 0.8124, a Dunn's Index of 0.8045, and a Davies-Bouldin Index of 0.0254.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review on Acreage Estimation of Rabi Pulses and Kharif Onions Using OPTISAR , Hierarchical Decision Rules and Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Accurate estimation of agricultural crop acreage is crucial for effective planning, resource management, and policymaking. In recent years, satellite remote sensing technologies like OPTISAR have become valuable tools for mapping and monitoring agricultural fields. This paper provides a comprehensive review of various machine learning techniques, particularly Random Forest and Hierarchical Decision Rule Classification, employed for the acreage estimation of Rabi pulses and Kharif onions using OPTISAR observations. Random Forest, as an ensemble learning method, has gained popularity due to its robustness in handling high-dimensional data, while Hierarchical Decision Rule Classification offers a structured approach for decision-making through layered rules. The review analyses the performance, accuracy, and limitations of these methods, highlighting their roles in addressing challenges such as mixed cropping patterns, varied phenological stages, and spectral variability in satellite data. The findings suggest that the integration of machine learning techniques with remote sensing data holds significant potential for improving agricultural monitoring and decision-making processes.

articleTitle: A Survey: Traffic Sign Recognition System using Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: A very important aspect of the development of smart transportation networks and road safety is ‘traffic sign recognition’. This survey covers all types of learning techniques applied to traffic sign recognition with respect to effectiveness, challenges, and progress. The study begins with an overview of the foundational methods of traffic sign recognition: traditional image processing approaches and their limitations. Further below, the heart of the survey is modern learning techniques, especially 'machine learning (ML)’ and ‘deep learning (DL)’ approaches. The report reviews employ learning techniques applied in ‘traffic sign recognition systems’. It discusses both the most recent developments in deep learning and advanced machine learning as well as conventional image processing. The review ranges from classical techniques such as colour and shape-based recognition to modern techniques such as ‘Convolutional Neural Network (CNN),' which have significantly increased recognition accuracy. Several important datasets on which the training and evaluation should be done have been reported. One of them is ‘German Traffic Sign Recognition Benchmark’, and the challenges in practical applications along with the future research directions in this field have been highlighted. An overview has been provided regarding the effectiveness and evolution of learning techniques to improve ‘Traffic sign recognition systems’.

articleTitle: Construction and Evaluation of Benchmark Da-Tasets For Adversarial Ai Research
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Standard offensive AI datasets need to be made and tested to improve the performance of AI models. Using adversarial diversity-driven dataset building (ADDC), this work shows new ways to create datasets and ways to measure safety and power. The DCA fakes several aggressive events to make sure that the benchmark dataset has a variety of strikes and pauses within it. When the REA is run, it shows how well AI models can handle certain threats. A vulnerability avoidance algorithm (VMA) finds holes in an AI model and stops them from being used. We compare the suggested plan to ADS, APDA, RMAAI, AVP, CABG, and AASF based on several factors that affect results. The suggested method both lowers the number of mistakes and raises the variety, which improves the dataset and makes sure that a full review is done. Artificial intelligence models that use the suggested method are less likely to be hacked online. First, well-known datasets for study into hostile artificial intelligence are put together and studied.

articleTitle: A Robust Machine Learning System for Classification and Prediction of Customer Churn in Telecom Sector
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Customer desertion detection is one of the most critical research topics that the telecommunications industry must address in order to retain existing customers. Churn is the term utilised to describe a loss of consumers as a result of the existing offers of competitors or, in some cases, network issues. Customers may prefer to terminate their subscriptions to services in these circumstances. Customer churn prediction is crucial for retaining long-term customers and ensuring profitability. The main goal of this system is to analyse various ML algorithms that are required to build models that can anticipate customer attrition and, once retention tactics and plans have been implemented, to identify the reasons behind churn. This study focuses on developing an effective churn prediction model using the Telco customer churn dataset by Kaggle, encompassing 7043 customer records. Through comprehensive data preprocessing, feature selection, and employing ML models—ETC, Decision Tree, and Stacking Classifier—the study evaluates and compares their performance in predicting customer churn according to F1-score, recall, accuracy, and precision. The outcomes demonstrate that a Stacking Classifier achieves the highest accuracy of 91%, highlighting its potential for practical implementation in the telecom sector to reduce churn rates and enhance customer retention strategies.

articleTitle: AI and Blockchain Synergy for Advanced Health Data Processing in IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: AI and blockchain have transformed health data management, notably in IoT applications. This paper introduces "AI and Blockchain Synergy for Advanced Health Data Processing in IoT," which intends to improve health data management systems. The proposed solution protects private health data using modern encryption and hashing. Additionally, it employs machine learning to identify anomalies and estimate risks in real time, helping clinicians make better decisions. The suggested solution outperforms existing systems in data integrity, security, scalability, latency, speed, portability, accuracy, agreement efficiency, cost-effectiveness, user experience, and legal compliance. This unique technique protects patient data and improves healthcare. The findings suggest that AI and blockchain might simplify health data management. This might improve patient outcomes and strengthen the healthcare system in a data-intensive future.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Enhance the Productivity and Thinking of User-MANGO Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Sequential Data Mining (SDM) is an extension of association data mining approach which discovers and identifies hidden patterns or relationships in sequential data where events and items occur in a sequence of time or a specific order. SDM plays an important role in identifying complex relations that lead to the enhancement of the industry and aid in strategic decision-making. Its applications extend across a wide range of domains like health care, telecommunications, retail, and many. SDM focuses more on the order of events and finding relations among the events while Market Basket Analysis focuses on identifying the product associations in the same event. The need to find hidden patterns in the data gave rise to the evolution of new algorithms called Apriori and FP-growth to generate strong association rules. These algorithms made mining processes much easier and helped users find unusual relationships in huge volumes of data. Many Multinational companies have applied these algorithms to find insights that enabled them to enhance their sales and profits by making the right decisions. In this work, we propose a new architecture, the Market Basket Analysis and Cognitive Approach for Analyzing (Customer) and Thinking (Library)-MANGO, designed for two key applications—library management and supermarket optimization. The Mango tool kit offers new suggestions and optimization techniques that could be implemented in libraries and supermarkets to enhance productivity, attract customers and make jobs easier. We also believe this framework can be extended to other fields, offering solutions for various industries that rely on sequential pattern analysis. The focus is on addressing the challenges specific to library management and supermarkets, where sequential pattern mining plays a critical role in optimizing operations and decision-making.

articleTitle: Classifying Eye Gaze Patterns of ASD And Typically Developing Children Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This research shows that utilising several datasets, autism spectrum disorder (ASD) may be detected at an early stage. The first of the many goals of this thesis is to describe how to use an eye tracking dataset in conjunction with convolutional neural network data to classify children as having autism. The Saliency4ASD Visual centre demonstration for ASD provided the eye tracking data that was acquired at IEEE ICME'19. For 300 pictures, the collection includes focus maps for kids with ASD and TD. It is possible to determine if an observer has ASD by looking at their fixation maps, which reveal the areas of the visual cortex that respond to certain stimuli. To achieve this goal, we will utilise Convolution Neural Networks (CNN) to detect whether an individual has autism spectrum disorder or normal development (TD) just by looking at their photograph. Autism is a neurological syndrome that is marked by difficulties in socialising, communicating through both verbal and nonverbal means, repetitive activity, not playing with others, varying degrees of sensitivity to more or less sensual motives, and a strict adherence to routine. Using the Eye Gaze Image dataset, the model demonstrates its great performance in distinguishing between instances of ASD and TD. This is shown by the model's high accuracy when it correctly identifies two true positives without producing any false positives. When applied to this specific scenario, it would seem that the model constantly generates categories that are the most suitable. With the best accuracy (92.8%), precision (93%), recall (95.6%), and F1 score (93%), the proposed model outperforms both CNN and RF, demonstrating its superior performance when comparing children who are normally developing (TD) to those who have autism spectrum disorder (ASD).

articleTitle: Smart Content Management System with Subscription Services
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The "Smart Content Management System with Subscription Services" project focuses on creating a sophisticated web-based platform for sharing and accessing various types of digital content, including text, images, and videos. The platform supports two main user roles: User A (content consumers) and User B (content creators). While User A has free access to standard content, premium content produced by User B requires a subscription, offering a revenue stream for creators and added value for subscribers. Built using modern web technologies like HTML, CSS, Python, JavaScript, Django, and Bootstrap, with PostgreSQL for reliable data management, the platform is designed for scalability, security, and efficiency. Cloud-based deployment ensures high reliability and scalability, addressing the growing needs of an expanding user base [1], [3]. The platform aims to transform content sharing by providing a seamless experience for both creators and consumers. It promotes high-quality content creation through monetization while offering users a broad range of valuable resources. The integration of multiple content formats increases the platform's versatility, catering to diverse user preferences and enhancing engagement.

articleTitle: Environmental Computing and ICT-Driven Agricultural Engineering: Sustainable Solutions for Modern Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Innovative methods in agriculture are required to address the persistent problems of resource scarcity, climate change, and food security. This study investigates how information and communication technology (ICT) and environmental computing contribute to the development of sustainable agricultural engineering solutions. The study explores how advanced data analytics, IoT devices, and AI-driven apps may optimise resource utilisation, boost production, and foster environmental stewardship in agricultural systems. Precision agriculture, in which agricultural techniques are informed by real-time data from linked sensors, and smart irrigation systems, which drastically minimise water usage while optimising crop yields, are two important areas of concentration. The study also looks at how autonomous equipment and drones may be used to monitor crop health and improve operational efficiency. According to the research, using ICT and environmental computing promotes a more sustainable agricultural ecosystem by reducing adverse environmental effects in addition to increasing agricultural productivity.
