This effort intends to give actionable insights and frameworks for attaining sustainable agriculture, assuring the resilience and adaptation of food production systems in the face of changing global problems. This will be accomplished through interdisciplinary collaboration and the deployment of novel technology.

articleTitle: Advanced Techniques for Protecting Privacy in Artificial Intelligence Powered Medical Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Privacy protection is required when analyzing healthcare data and using it effectively. This work proposes a novel technique to secure private data in AI-powered medical systems while providing important data insights. The recommended method incorporates challenging techniques such as integrating Laplace distribution noise, managing secure data, and training group models. A privacy budget manages settings to balance analysis performance and individual contributions. The framework outperforms existing approaches in accuracy, precision, memory, F1 score, and privacy compliance. The technique improves data, models, training, and inference speeds, making it suitable for real-time healthcare applications. Iterative feedback enhances the model by modifying components based on real-world data. In addition to ensuring privacy, this entire design enables AI-powered medical systems to identify and anticipate findings. It provides a true, scalable solution that can adapt to healthcare demands, creating a new standard for AI app privacy and data usage. The technology provides a privacy-protected, highly efficient model that enhances decision-making and patient outcomes, enabling AI in healthcare.

articleTitle: Fed-CCE: A Multicriteria Framework for Client Selection in Multimodal Heterogeneous Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive review of frameworks addressing heterogeneous federated learning, emphasizing the importance of multimodality and fusion techniques in this context. We explore the challenges and opportunities presented by diverse data types and client nodes in federated learning environments. Building upon this foundation, we propose a novel client selection framework called Composite Client Evaluation in Federated Learning (Fed-CCE), which leverages Multi-Criteria Decision Making (MCDM) techniques. Fed-CCE evaluates potential clients based on multiple parameters, including data quality, computational capacity, historical performance, and accuracy of the local learning model. This approach aims to optimize client selection in heterogeneous federated learning scenarios, potentially improving overall model performance and efficiency. Our work contributes to the growing field of federated learning by addressing the critical issue of client heterogeneity and proposing a practical solution for effective client selection in multimodal environments.

articleTitle: Pixels to Insights: The Role of Multispectral Image Classification in Informing Decision-Making and Driving Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Multispectral image classification is a process of categorizing the individual elements within a multispectral image into different classes or categories based on their spectral characteristics. It involves the use of spectral information from multiple bands of electromagnetic radiation to identify and categorize various features or land cover types present in the scene. Multispectral data provides a robust basis for classification by capturing the spectral response of features across different wavelengths, making it less susceptible to errors arising from variations in illumination or atmospheric conditions. By utilizing information from multiple spectral bands, multispectral image classification facilitates the extraction of richer and more detailed feature information. The ultimate goal is to derive meaningful and actionable insights from multispectral imagery, including different types of application such as Ecosystem mapping like land cover, agricultural assessments, and urban planning. For instance, in urban planning, it aids in analyzing land use patterns, planning infrastructure, and managing urban growth. The ability to accurately classify and analyze these images is essential for informed decision-making and efficient resource management. By capturing detailed spectral information, multispectral image classification enables a deeper understanding of the Earth’s surface, driving advancements in environmental monitoring and sustainable development.

articleTitle: Air Quality Index Prediction Model Utilizing Random Forest and NodeMCU
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Air pollution is a silent public health crisis demanding smarter solutions. This study discusses one such novelty in the use of machine learning and IoT for the prediction of hyper-local AQI forecasting. For this purpose, we will be integrating the Random Forest algorithm with NodeMCU to obtain point accuracy in AQI forecasts. It basically consists of a strong machine learning model trained on historical data with rich environmental parameters, such as air quality indicators including PM2.5 and ozone, along with meteorological data. In this way, the model will be able to forecast future AQI levels with very high accuracy. Real-time data acquisition is facilitated by NodeMCU, an IoT platform that can act like an environmental sentinel. It feeds the model real-time data through its live feed. Consequently, it guarantees real-time prediction of AQI with location specificity. The model is crossvalidated at large, returning a promising accuracy level of 99%, hence making it a potential revolutionist in air quality management. With machine learning and IoT combined, this work opens a gateway toward a future wherein proactive air quality management enables greener cities and a healthier future.

articleTitle: Implementation of Asynchronous Communication using LoRa and MQTT for Military Force Tracking Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of an asynchronous communication system utilizing LoRa and MQTT protocols for real-time military force tracking. The proposed system integrates the long-range, low-power capabilities of LoRa with the lightweight, efficient data transfer features of the MQTT protocol to enable secure and reliable communication for military applications. We discuss the system’s architecture, including the hardware components such as Raspberry Pi and Dragino LoRa GPS modules, and the software environment comprising programming languages and network libraries. The methodology emphasizes the network architecture that supports data flow from sensors and devices, providing robust, encrypted communication to ensure network security. Performance evaluation is conducted through extensive tests, focusing on data transmission reliability, latency, and power management. Results highlight the system’s feasibility and effectiveness in various military scenarios, such as troop localization and tactical battlefield awareness. Finally, the paper compares this approach to existing synchronous communication technologies, discusses its implications for military operations, and provides recommendations for future research and development.

articleTitle: The Potential of Embedded Systems in Optimizing Industrial Logistics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In order to keep up with the ever-changing demands of industrial logistics, new methods are needed to improve productivity, accuracy, and safety. In response, this study presents an innovative approach to improve industrial logistics by bringing together Adaptive Routing and Scheduling, Demand Forecasting enabled by the Internet of Things, and Blockchain Supply Chain Security. These three components combined produce a dynamic, data-driven strategy that vastly exceeds previous techniques. The real-time flexibility of Adaptive Routing and Scheduling makes it possible to continually optimize routes considering dynamic conditions like traffic and service outages. This improves operating efficiency and reduces costs by compensating for the drawbacks of predetermined, static routes used by more conventional approaches. Data-driven predictive analytics for improved demand forecasting are made possible by IoT-Enabled Demand Forecasting, which makes use of the Internet of Things to its full potential. It outperforms conventional, less accurate methods of demand forecasting by enabling proactive inventory management and supply chain modifications, therefore reducing surplus stock, and increasing overall efficiency. As a result, a more cutting-edge and efficient method of meeting the ever-evolving needs of logistics management emerges: the combination of Adaptive Routing and Scheduling, IoT-Enabled Demand Forecasting, and Blockchain Supply Chain Security.

articleTitle: Enhanced Identification of Curving Lanes Using a Neural Network Model with Minimal Complexity
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: It’s widely acknowledged that lane detection is a vital feature for the autonomous cars that will be used in the transportation systems of the future. In more recent research investigations, attention has been paid to the challenges of extracting and fitting lane markings from photographs of roads. These, however, continue to be useless when the lane is curved and the light is colored. In the case of a curving road, changes in illumination and the structure of the road are the primary factors that influence the effectiveness of lane identification, which might result in accidents. For the purpose of estimating the complete lane by integrating the lane markers under a variety of diverse road circumstances, this study proposes a unique technique that is based on an operational the FLANN paradigm of linked artificial neural networks, that is both low in complexity and efficient. To estimate the curved shape of the streets, we apply trigonometric, polynomial, exponential in nature, and Chebyshev well-designed development-based FLANN models with lane markers retrieved from each area in the road image. We evaluate and verify each model's efficiency on road photos using three standard datasets. The Chebyshev FLANN model outpaces the other three FLANN techniques in terms of computation time and mean accuracy, making it the best of the four. Results from the remaining three models were surpassed by the CFLANN model, which achieved an accurate detection rate of 95.8%.

articleTitle: Design and Develop an Efficient Load Balancing Approach with AOMDV Routing in 7G-FANET
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The congestion in the Flying Ad hoc Network (FANET) is due to insufficient bandwidth or a heavy load on the network. The multipath routing protocol AOMDV (Ad -hoc On-demand Distance Vector) is used for balance the load in network. The multiple routes serve as backup routes for data transmission in the connection breakdown. The speed of the Seventh Generation (7G) is much higher than other generations of wireless networks. 7G has a speed of 100 Gigabits, which reduces communication latency. To optimize the bandwidth capacity, we must shift the load to other or alternative routes for handle congestion and proper load balancing. In this paper, propose a delay estimation rate-based control scheme to improve UAV-to-UAV communication in 7G-FANET. The Efficient Load Balancing AOMDV (ELAOMDV) scheme furnishes data on the number of packets that failed to reach their destination. The variation in the rate of transmission is based on the delay of successful acknowledgement. The proposed approach is to avoid the risk of congestion and balance the load on a specific link. 7G has the advantage of rapid communication. The ELAOMDV congestion management strategy is to minimize the latency and buffer overflow caused by network congestion. The delay difference confirms the existence of congestion and indicates the availability of multipath to balance the load. The performance of ELAOMDV is better than the multipath ad hoc on demand protocol (MAODV). All of the performance metrics showing improved results, indicating that the ELAOMDV approach has improved routing performance in 7G-FANET.

articleTitle: Proposed Edge Computing Neural Accelerator
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Edge computing is revolutionizing data processing, especially for applications like surveillance and traffic control systems. The data being processed closer to the source (e.g., cameras or sensors), with this edge computing reduces communication latency, bandwidth consumption, and power usage, addressing limitations of centralized cloud systems. The integration of machine learning (ML) in edge environments enhances surveillance systems, enabling real-time analytics, such as object detection and activity recognition. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), widely used in video analytics, facilitate instant object recognition at the edge. However, the computational demands of deep neural networks (DNNs) require hardware accelerators like DNN accelerators for efficient deployment. These accelerators, implemented using technologies like Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) and Application-Specific Integrated Circuits (ASICs), improve latency and energy efficiency. Key benefits include parallelism, optimized memory management, and energy-efficient processing, essential for resource-constrained environments like surveillance drones. This paper explores the architecture of deep learning accelerators, such as the Edge Computing Neural Accelerator (ECNA), focusing on their role in real-time surveillance systems. By leveraging binary-weight convolutional layers and systolic array designs, ECNA significantly enhances processing speed and energy efficiency, enabling real-time video analytics while consuming minimal power.

articleTitle: Silicon Celebrations Merging with Systematic Structures to Shape Tomorrow’s Tech Landscape
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: A remarkable dynamic exists between technological advancement and the underlying infrastructure that supports the digital world we live in. Silicon is at the center of this complex dance because it has come to represent the unrelenting ambition of the technology sector [1]. The coming together of silicon parties and methodical structures is a watershed moment in the history of technological progress. This study investigates the new idea of using Infobyte Imprints to have an effect on how future digital user interfaces are made. This method is included in the study’s scope. We are going to use a lot of different types of machine learning and AI to achieve our goals. RL, Computer Vision (CV), and Natural Language Processing (NLP) are a few examples of these techniques. Digital devices send out digital fingerprints, which are known as infobyte imprints, in real time. This step is done after the data preparation, model training, and distribution steps are done. This takes place as soon as the fingerprints are taken. The suggested method is better at getting people to work together and getting things done than 10 other average methods. Since the method was suggested, this works. There are four different types of diagrams that are used to show the data clearly. The 10 buzzwords, which are mentioned in alphabetical order, give a quick outline of the subject being investigated.

articleTitle: Design and Evaluation of IoT Prototypes: Leveraging Test-Beds for Performance Assessment and Innovation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The Internet of Things' (IoT) explosive growth has created new opportunities for creative solutions in a variety of sectors. However, since real-world surroundings are complicated and variable, creating and assessing IoT prototypes may be difficult. The usage of test beds as a vital instrument for evaluating performance and fostering creativity in the creation of IoT prototypes is the main topic of this research study. Test-beds allow developers and researchers to analyse critical performance parameters like latency, scalability, energy efficiency, and interoperability by offering repeatable, controlled settings that mimic real-world situations. This paper examines many IoT test-bed frameworks and their uses in a range of industries, such as industrial automation, smart cities, and healthcare. It also looks at methods for assessing the dependability and effectiveness of IoT devices and the difficulties brought about by the ever-changing nature of IoT ecosystems. Before deploying a prototype, developers may improve its scalability and robustness by iterating iteratively on test-beds. With a focus on their potential to support large-scale IoT deployments and address the emerging challenges of security, privacy, and data management, the paper concludes by discussing future trends in IoT prototype evaluation and the evolving role of test-beds in fostering innovation.

articleTitle: Laying The Theoretical Groundwork for A Seamless Transition to An Edge Intelligence-Driven Web3.0 Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This study introduces a well-defined method for Web3.0 edge intelligence improvement. Autonomous computing and modern algorithms and protocols make the system more dependable, secure, private, and efficient, while also ensuring data accuracy and network latency. Performance studies reveal that this strategy optimises energy economy and data accuracy better than others, which are crucial for dynamic edge decision-making. Strong security and privacy technology protects sensitive data, adhering to regulatory requirements. The ablation research examines all method components to see how they impact performance and propose improvements. According to the research, this strategy is superior to others since it handles problems, uses resources effectively, and saves money. This system advances edge computing. It allows long-term real-time data processing and analysis in dispersed environments. Future research may improve the ablation study and make it compatible with edge computing. This would improve Web 3.0 autonomous computing systems.

articleTitle: Predictive Model for Diabetic Re-admission Using Neural Network Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: From millions of people suffering from diabetes worldwide, proper management would translate to reducing complications of readmission to hospitals, thereby further reducing medical and insurance costs. The hospital readmissions also determine the reputation of the hospitals and their cost implications, and they are also a very good barometer of problems in the health sector. It therefore sought to apply neural network models for an analysis and forecasting of the readmission rates of patients with diabetes in the hospital. The dataset provided contains many attributes regarding patient demographics, medical conditions, and the drugs that are filtered and processed to deal with missing values, reduce complexity, and also to change categorical variables into numerical form. Techniques like Random Forest, Neural Networks, and Support Vector Machines are used after feature engineering to predict whether a patient is readmitted or not. Accuracy, classification reports, and confusion matrices are used to evaluate the models. More complex neural networks, such as ANN and LSTM models, work for the sake of even more accurate prediction-making. The overall findings of the final models regarding health care providers range from identifying high-risk patients to improving patient care and reducing readmission-related healthcare expenses.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Deep Learning for Animal Species Classification using CCTV Surveillance Video: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Biodiversity is crucial for maintaining ecosystem stability, yet global biodiversity is currently in sharp decline, necessitating urgent protective measures. Wildlife monitoring and conservation, which determine biodiversity patterns, are fundamental in ecology, biogeography, and conservation biology. Advances in digital technologies, such as Closed Circuit Television (CCTV) systems, have enhanced the ability to monitor wildlife activities. The growth in wildlife data has facilitated the detection of targeted wild animals and their behaviors, but challenges remain due to the continuous data stream and complex environments. Recent developments in Deep Learning (DL) have demonstrated potential in overcoming these challenges by efficiently processing large-scale video data to detect and classify animal activities. Despite these advancements, further research is needed to refine these models for real-time applications, especially in mitigating wildlife-human conflicts and ensuring the safety of both wildlife and humans. This paper explores the integration of DL techniques in wildlife monitoring, highlighting their potential to improve biodiversity conservation efforts. In this review article we overview the deep learning approaches, focusing on detection of wild creatures to lessen the wild animal- human conflicts. We present a comprehensive overview of issues and challenges in wild life detection in order for a better understanding.

articleTitle: An Efficient Estimation of diabetes mellitus using adapted SVM algorithm and cloud sanctuary
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Global health issues like diabetes require early detection for care and prevention. A persistent metabolic disease with increase blood sugar stages might source stern health matters if not appropriately treated. Prevention of heart, kidney, and eye damage requires early and correct identification. This study introduces a diabetes prediction system using EPCA and MSVM to solve this need. EPCA reduces data dimensionality by keeping only the most important information, improving model prediction accuracy. For categorisation, MSVM, an advanced Support Vector Machine, is used. A powerful prediction model that accurately detects diabetes is created by combining EPCA with MSVM. The analysis framework uses Honeybee encryption to protect sensitive health data. This cloud-based encryption solution protects patient data from unauthorised access and breaches. Data integrity and secrecy are guaranteed using Honeybee encryption. EPCA-enhanced MSVM classifiers predict diabetes with improved accuracy, exceeding previous approaches. The framework's high accuracy allows healthcare providers to detect diabetes early and accurately for prompt intervention and control. Finally, this study offers a safe and accurate early diabetes prediction method. The approach secures patient data and improves prediction accuracy by integrating EPCA and MSVM with sophisticated encryption. This method helps doctors make diabetes-related decisions and improve patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Enhanced Lung Cancer Detection Using Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN) Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Early detection of lung cancer is a critical factor in improving the survival rates of patients. In the meantime, current methods of diagnosis often do not cover the complete process as they bypass the disease’s initial stages. According to the survey, it suggests a unique way to lung cancer prediction involvement of Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) in the acquisition of diagnostic data to raise the accuracy and exactness of diagnostic models. This approach converts patient data from a tabular format to a graph structure, with each node representing a patient and edges representing similarities between two separate clinical features. The proposed GCN model is based on the idea of a multi-layer architecture, enabling it to effectively access both local and global patterns in the data, which in turn ensures the elapse of the performance of prediction. The model was evaluated with thoroughness and it showed the potential to replace the traditional machine learning algorithms in identifying the lung cancer cases correctly at a higher precision. Our methodology unites the advantages of graph convolution networks, so that it can reach our aim of greater accuracies and precision, which gives a good recognition for our approach of early lung cancer detection. The outcomes of the experiments confirm the value of graph-based deep learning models in medical diagnostics especially when the case is about complex tasks like lung cancer prediction. This study reflects the ongoing efforts on reliable and accurate diagnostic tools with the use of AI, thus facilitating the early detection of lung cancer and increasing patient’s survival.

articleTitle: Advancements in AI for Depression Detection: A Survey of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This survey paper delves into the sophisticated applications of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) techniques in the realm of depression detection. By leveraging a variety of analytical methods, including text analysis, speech analysis, social media monitoring, and image and video analysis, the research highlights the role of advanced algorithms such as Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Ensemble Methods, Random Forests, Gradient Boosting Machines (GBM), and Graph Neural Networks (GNN) in identifying depressive symptoms. The study conducts a thorough review of existing literature, showcasing the efficacy of these techniques while pinpointing critical gaps and challenges, such as data quality and integration with clinical practice. This comprehensive examination underscores the necessity for robust, generalizable models capable of real-world application. Ultimately, the survey aims to demonstrate how ML and DL technologies can significantly enhance early detection and intervention strategies in mental health management, paving the way for improved patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Novel Approach to Glioma Classification in MRI Images Using Modified Microstructure Descriptors and Hybrid-RBF Kernel SVM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Cancer kills the most people worldwide and will exceed all others in the next decades. Brain cancer mortality is best reduced by early detection and treatment. Modern computer technology and computational imaging have greatly enhanced medical image interpretation, aiding early diagnosis. GBM is characterized by substantial tumor heterogeneity, no effective therapies, and poor survival rates. Current best practice includes maximal resection through surgery, radiation, and adjuvant treatment. Because precise identification is crucial to diagnosis in clinical settings, medical imaging specialists confront challenges when identifying stroke lesions including brain malignancies. Plus, MR photos are scarce. Manually analyzing these photos is time-consuming and problematic. Maintaining a laser-like attention during classification, which increases false hits, is also difficult. For these reasons, CAD offers enormous potential for automated MR image analysis. We use Multi Texton Histogram (MTH) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) to analyze the structure of tumorous and normal tissues to improve brain tumor classification accuracy in T1 post-contrast MRI images. The suggested approach achieves the desired result via the following steps: HSD is used to extract features from tumor regions, combining the benefits of texton co-occurrence matrix and histogram. Hybrid kernel Support Vector Machine is used for final classification. The experimental findings are verified using K-fold cross validation. The suggested HSD+HKSVM model frequently has the greatest accuracy and recall, according to the two databases. The greatest outcomes are 99.24% accuracy and 100% recall using F(V2) feature vector.

articleTitle: Pragmatic Review on Progressions in Multimodal Disease Prediction with Combination of Machine Learning, Deep Learning and Electronic Health Records
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) methods can be integrated with multimodal data, particularly Electronic Health Records (EHR), presents a significant opportunity to enhance disease prediction. This review paper synthesizes key advancements, identifies gaps in multimodal disease prediction systems, and proposes a roadmap for integrating ML and DL models in clinical settings. By offering a critical comparison of current methods, this paper highlights challenges such as data integration, scalability, and real-world clinical application. In combination of data from various sources like Electronic Health Records (EHR), demographic and clinical dataset, many models have been reviewed and demonstrated with significant improvements in prediction performance compared to existing single-modality methods. This paper highlights the potential of multimodal disease prediction systems and discusses the research gaps that need to be addressed for broader clinical adoption and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Enhanced Accessibility for Recognizing Indian and American Sign Language through Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Sign language detection, specifically for Indian Sign Language (ISL) and American Sign Language (ASL), plays a crucial role in bridging communication gaps between hearing impaired and normal people..This paper proposes a systematic methodology using different deep learning models to detect ISL and ASL from an image dataset of sign language gestures. The algorithms probed were 2D Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), ResNet-50, Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) and VGG16. By using a dataset we conducted an extensive comparative analysis of these algorithms. The results portrayed LSTM as the best predictive classifier with an amazing 97.97% accuracy. This excellent result makes LSTM a strong model for the classification of sign languages with high accuracy. The target classes involved several signs from ISL and ASL are thus extensive for recognizing and interpreting both these languages by using a number of algorithms we make the predictive model more robust as it can handle multiple kinds of data patterns corresponding to different sign gestures. The outcomes of our investigation present the very first step towards an intelligent sign language detection system. A well-recognized and fast-emerging potential of deep learning is in the automatic detection of sign languages, which introduces a drastic positive change in communication efficiency as this research field grows exponentially. This could greatly improve the ability of a person to interact and the accessibility of an individual to sign languages.

articleTitle: Enhancing Watershed Segmentation for Precise Mammogram Detection and Classification with the Application of Feedforward Neural Network Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Mammography may detect breast cancer early. CAD systems increase tissue visualisation by processing medical images like digitally chest x-rays and digital mammograms. Digital mammograms are recommended for women over 40 without breast cancer symptoms. The CAD method mostly uses chest X-rays to diagnose issues early. Healthy breast tissue is protected by low-dose X-rays. Tracking and measuring breast cancer requires accurate computational tumour segmentation. The use of fully automated or CAD for breast cancer segmentation and categorisation has various obstacles. A hybrid two-stage segmentation approach is presented here. Since cancers are abundant under all settings, we first use a watershed transform to divide the picture into basins based on pixel density, which indicates tumour mass. Despite being sensitive to even tiny changes in image size, the number of areas is unreasonably large, and segment boundaries are typically inflexible. The second level set efficiently segments medical images because it naturally allows cavities, folds, splits, and merges. The division result is used as the curve's beginning point in the level-set procedure, simplifying and improving identification. The FNN model has the highest accuracy at 97.68%, showing that it is quite good at data classification. The FNN model has the greatest precision at 98.45%, outperforming both ATMF (93.68%) and MIAS (92.98%). Furthermore, the FNN model has an exceptional capacity to detect real negatives, as seen by its specificity level of 97.54%. This indicates that the model performs much better on the training data than on the test data.

articleTitle: High-Resolution NLP for Social Healthcare Networks: Text Classification through Integration of Causal Dilated Cosine Architecture Optimized by Weighted Leadership Navigator for Advanced Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The advancement in information technology has been on the increase in the recent past with the expansion of text data dissemination in the form of news, medical reports, product reviews, and social media posts among others, the increase in text data has made text mining and classification mandatory. In the last decade a lot of attempts have been undertaken to solve the text classification problems employing machine learning and deep learning approaches both supervised and unsupervised. In this context, our research proposes High-Resolution NLP for Social Healthcare Networks (HiN-TC), a state-of-the-art text classification approach. In our research, data cleaning and normalization are done using Min-Max with Zero-Mean Rescaling Normalization, feature selection is done using Echelon Adaptive Poplar Algorithm, and feature extraction is done using Bi-Consolidation Transformer that captures key patterns in the text. It is supposed to classify the data with good accuracy using Causal Dilated Cosine Architecture and we have optimized it using Precision-Weighted Leadership Navigator for improved performance. This framework is applied to the COVID-19 vaccination Twitter dataset to help get more superior understanding of social healthcare trends. Our methodology demonstrates significant performance improvements, achieving a 98.5% increase in classification accuracy, a 96.3% reduction in text processing time, and a 97.1% boost in scalability. These outcomes suggest the capability of the HiN-TC to deliver a more profound understanding of the social healthcare networks and suggest that the presented framework can be effective for the enhancement of the efficiency and accuracy in the computationally extensive range of the NLP methods and applications for the analysis of the large-scale unstructured text data in healthcare.

articleTitle: KMonPro: A Kernel-Level Module for Comprehensive Resource Monitoring and Process Insights in Linux Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This paper introduces a new kernel module, KMonPro. Design elements of the Linux-based operating system consider bringing perfectly accurate real-time monitoring of system resources. Unlike typical monitoring utilities, KMonPro directly interacts with the kernel so that metrics such as CPU usage, memory statistics, network activity, and process detail have 100% capture at all times.It has at its heart a lightweight monitoring script that continually captures data from the interface ‘/proc/kmonpro’, thereby achieving constant analysis of system performance with little overhead. A case study on KMonPro illuminates very well the ability of KMonPro to generate accurate and trustworthy resource metrics but demonstrates very detailed usage patterns important for fine-tuning and debugging systems.This study significantly contributes to monitoring systems by developing a strong kernel-level solution that merges real-time analytics with resource management. KMonPro constitutes the most significant improvement over other operating system utilities in presenting comprehensive monitoring abilities that assist the system administrator as well as researchers in improving system transparency besides making intelligent decisions on what kind of resource management policies to adopt.

articleTitle: Securing Industry 4.0-Based Precision Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Industry 4.0 presents a novel dimension in the domain of smart agriculture of the tardiest decade. In precision agriculture, the on-field sensor node receives the repetitive agriculture data and forwards it to the isolated station across the wireless carriers. Data received at the base station is big therefore they are deposited in the cloud storage. Cloud computing interfaces have been built utilizing the HTTP protocol, and therefore different HTTP threats have presented to harm agriculture data. Several techniques have been proposed such as threat detection with shortcomings of less precision and higher detection failures. Thus implementing such conventional methods for attack detection is a nightmare and needed an effective method to detect such cyber threats for the Industry 4.0-connected cloud computing interface. The proposed work presents the methodology of detecting the HTTP threats in the cloud storage connected with Industry 4.0-based precision agriculture applications. The results confirmed that the proposed technique obtained better performance compared to state-of-art methods for HTTP attack detection in cloud computing applications.Reducing the use of water, composts, herbicides, and pesticides outside of farmhouse kinds of equipment is one way that precision farming may provide practical and ecological benefits.Social event data, data execution, and control advancements in precision agriculture all rely on WSN. The reliability and robustness of WSNs, which have had a significant influence via the wireless channel, are absolutely critical to the effectiveness of such an intelligent framework.Precision Security: Before investigating the challenges of precision farming routing, we first focused on the detection of Hypertext Transport Protocol (HTTP) threats under Industry 4.0-connected methods. We developed a cloud-connected precision farming application & applied the data mining & machine learning algorithms for accurate HTTP threats. This contribution addresses the security challenge for the precision farming experiment.

articleTitle: Emerging ICT Trends in Engineering Structures and Architectural Economics: The Role of Human-Computer Interaction in Shaping Future Design and Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This study looks into the new trends in information and communication technology (ICT) for engineering structures, focussing on how these trends interact with architectural economics and how important human-computer interaction (HCI) is to the efficiency and design of the future. The integration of information and communication technology (ICT) in structural engineering and architectural design has become essential for optimising both functionality and aesthetics due to the rapid growth of digital technologies. The study investigates how modern computational approaches, virtual reality (VR), and building information modelling (BIM) tools improve stakeholder collaboration and design precision. Furthermore, a study of HCI principles shows how important they are for enhancing utility and user experience, as well as for making sure that technical solutions successfully satisfy the demands of clients, engineers, and architects. HCI enhances efficiency in decision-making and productivity by emphasising usability in design tools and platforms. The results show that creative frameworks that are resilient, durable, and economically feasible can be created by strategically utilising ICT in conjunction with HCI. The goal of this research is to offer a thorough framework for comprehending how different fields intersect, ultimately opening the door to a more effective and progressive environment for engineering and architecture that places a higher priority on user-centred design.

articleTitle: GAME 101: An Online Gamified Learning Platform For Data Structure And Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: There is significant impact of Gamified Learning in educational contexts due to its potential to improve student engagement and motivation. This literature review synthesizes research on the application of games in academics and understanding their impact on learning outcomes and student behavior. This review explores various gamified elements and how they effect cognitive, behavioral and affective engagement of students. The findings suggest that while gamified learning can significantly enhance student motivation and engagement, its success is contingent upon thoughtful implementation and alignment with educational objectives. Gamified learning is a powerful tool that educators can use, it shows great potential in contributing to enhancing student engagement and motivation. The application of game-based elements in academic environments have shown a great deal in research towards learning outcomes and student behavior. Points, badges, leaderboards and storytelling elements are all forms of gamification that have been shown to affect engagement around cognitive (knowledge acquisition), behavior (actions students perform based on how motivating the environment is designed) or Affective outcomes. It has been shown, through studies that gamified learning can help increase student motivation effectively and create more immersive interactivity in the process of learning. Nevertheless, the efficacy of these approaches relies extensively on appropriately designing gamified elements and aligning them with specific educational aims. Poorly implemented or inappropriate gamification may even lead to disengagement and in some cases, counterproductive results. While gamified learning holds promise for transforming educational practices, its efficacy hinges on strategic planning and a clear understanding of the educational goals it aims to achieve. A balanced view regarding the integration of gamification is vital to make it a supplement and not as an alternative; which would amplify its effect on students learning.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cognitive Radio Networks with Multiple Antenna Techniques: Innovations and Performance Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: A revolutionary approach to effectively using spectrum, Cognitive Radio Networks (CRNs) have surfaced to meet the increasing need for wireless communication. Performance gains of up to 30% may be achieved by integrating multiple antenna methods like beamforming and Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) into CRNs. These gains include higher data speeds, better interference resistance, and greater spectral efficiency. This study examines new developments in the use of multiple antenna systems in CRNs, emphasising how these methods maximise spectrum availability and detection, improve communication quality, and increase network capacity overall. Adaptive beamforming techniques, spatial variety, spectrum sensing, and the difficulties of integrating numerous antennas into dynamic CRN settings are important research topics. Simulations and case studies are used to assess the performance advantages of these improvements, emphasising the effects they have on main and secondary users. Furthermore, this study explores how machine learning and sophisticated signal processing methods might be used to optimise antenna layout for real-time adaptation. This work intends to contribute to the continued development of high-performance CRNs, opening the door for more effective and adaptable wireless communication systems, by addressing these advancements and problems.

Author Keywords: Signal Quality Enhancement and Dynamic Spectrum Management

articleTitle: Exploration of Pesticide Residue Detection Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Pesticide residues in chillis present significant health concerns due to their widespread consumption in India. This study provides a range of methods for residual detection, such as mass spectrometry and gas chromatography, which are precise but expensive and time-consuming. We also explore advanced spectroscopic approach like Hyperspectral imaging that provides faster results compared to traditional methods, although it faces sensitivity issues, various machine learning and deep learning techniques which are claimed to function superiorly well in image analysis tasks. The Study reveals that hyperspectral imaging combined with Deep learning methods significantly enhances detection accuracy and reduces processing time compared to traditional approaches. As part of continuous efforts to increase food safety and public health, future research aims to refine these methodologies for enhanced sensitivity and real-time detection of pesticide residues in chilies.

articleTitle: Travel Tinder: A Comprehensive Literature Review on Innovations in Solo Travel Companion Matching
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Travel Tinder is an innovative web platform designed to connect solo travelers based on shared interests, budget, and travel time, aiming to enhance the solo travel experience by providing personalized companion matching. This paper explores the development of Travel Tinder through a combination of intelligent matchmaking algorithms and user-friendly interfaces, leveraging findings from existing research on recommender systems, social matching platforms, and user safety. The platform fosters a global community of like-minded travelers, prioritizing safety, trust, and personalization. Key technologies, such as hybrid recommender systems and AI-driven features for secure interaction, are analyzed, alongside a detailed literature survey on existing travel matchmaking applications. By integrating these advanced technologies, Travel Tinder aspires to make solo travel not only safer and more enjoyable but also socially enriching, contributing significantly to the growing market of solo travel.

articleTitle: Examination Of Trust-Aware Routing in WSN Applications Via Secured Authenticate and Integrity Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) are progressively gaining acceptance in various fields due to the real-world data they can seamlessly obtain. Nevertheless, the transmission and collecting of sensitive data are still issues with problems and challenges. Present solutions may pose such limitations as security threats and signal lagging because they are unable to optimize security and throughput. In traditional systems, slow and unreliable measurements associated with the use of basic protocols for routing and the use of ordinary encryption techniques are realized. In this work, new approaches for enhancing WSN safety, identifiability, dependability, and quality are proposed. Today’s secure routing techniques, effective real time data transmission and flow control are some of the aspects of the system, which are in mind. Energy- aware routing enables efficient using of energy in the required aspects without affecting the overall quality of the network performance. The End-to-End Delay was found to be the least at 8 ms. 4 seconds and this is clearer evidence that our proposed system is superior compared to other existing systems using the Prospective Node Position-Based Neighborhood Selection (NPBNS) protocol. By this protocol data packets may be transmitted inside the WSN quicker by minimizing the time taken to communicate. Thus, the suggested approach may be considered the most favorable for future WSN deployment as it enhances network performance while maintaining a high level of security. However, in terms of the design with the highest PDR of 92%, the Proposed Node Position-Based Neighbourhood Selection (NPBNS) approach outperformed the others as the most accurate in this assessment.

articleTitle: Critical Review: Fog Computing Dimensions for Data Security Features Cloud-Based Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Fog computing combines traditional cloud services with the proximity of users and devices to enhance service efficiency and speed up processes, allowing for mobility and several users to perform heterogeneous computing tasks. This can also be referred to as the fog network. This paper presents a study on cloud computing with a specific focus on its current advances. Mobile edge computing and cloud computing can be regarded as preferred examples of the technologies put under this category. Most of the approaches are design approaches aimed improvement of the service quality among the devices and the cloud environment. This theory has been constructed based on the active development of threat model for fog computing focusing on its services, data operations, and management. Classification criteria are developed from the main and the most importane aspects of fog computing. Benefits and disadvantages are studied. Such as the safety, secrecy, applicability and communication with the end users as in thanks to the research and review.

articleTitle: Traffic Flow in Smart Cities using Dense Clisteer Humboldt Squid Steerable Nested Convolutional Attention Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: As urban populations continue to swell; managing traffic flow in smart cities becomes increasingly complex. Efficient traffic management is essential for reducing congestion, improving safety, and enhancing overall urban quality of life. Traditional traffic monitoring systems often struggle with the sheer volume and variety of data, leading to suboptimal traffic management strategies. This research addresses these challenges, this work is proposed. In this manuscript, an advanced traffic flow analysis framework utilizing the Dense Clisteer Humboldt Squid Steerable Nested Convolutional Attention Network (DCli-H2S-NConv-AtNet). In this, the input dataset is taken from INRIX database. Then using Shape-Aware Mesh Normal Filtering (SAMNF) for preprocessing to ensure high-quality, noise-free data. Features are then extracted and classified using an appropriate DCli-H2S-NConv-AtNet for accurately modelling complex spatial and temporal traffic patterns. The rationale behind this framework is to improve the ability to forecast congestion and non-congestion conditions thus improving traffic flow of urban traffic management. Implemented in Python, the DCli-H2S-NConv-AtNet model achieves an impressive accuracy of 99%, significantly improving traffic prediction and management capabilities in smart cities.

articleTitle: Digital Transformation in Mechatronics: ICT Applications in Automation and Robotics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Mechatronics, a multidisciplinary field and transformed the conventional methods to dynamic and autonomous systems. The emergence of robotics and technology in various sectors marks a significant revolution in the industry specially in manufacturing, construction, food, and pharmaceutical industries. This ensured quality, efficiency and precision in the concerned industries. Based on this background, it is from this perspective that the paper addresses transformatory work in collaborative robots, automation technologies, and robotic manipulators through object recognition, human-robot interaction, and machine learning applications. Reviewing the key technologies- machine vision, thermography etc. that transformed the quality control across the industries, enhancing the reliability and precision and efficiency of the product.Autonomous robots and manipulators in conjunction with the da Vinci Surgical System represent huge promise for surgical purposes and therapeutic interventions within medicine. Discuss some of the challenges in the path planning for system adaptability and insist on the need for robust data in medical robotics, besides the key success factors for adopting robotics in every other sector. This research marks how the growing role of robotics, which includes changing industries that are driving the Fourth Industrial Revolution, offset labor shortages, and growing global demands, is being found.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of the Latest Trends in Stock Market Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Forecasting Stock market prices is ongoing research with researchers aspiring to develop models that supersede previous accuracy rates. Historically, statistical models like the GARCH and ARIMA models have been used for predictive analytics tasks, however, the volatility and complex nature of stock market data make it difficult to complete prediction tasks with such models. Various machine learning models like the Random Forest algorithm and Support Vector Machine have also been used for stock market prediction, at times achieving significant prediction accuracy in some tasks. However, this may not be sufficient. Of late researchers are experimenting with deep learning algorithms for stock market prediction with these remarkably improving accuracy rates. In this study, we conduct a comparative analysis of prominent stock price forecasting models to identify the best-performing model. By using a systematic review of the literature, we evaluate the top-performing models in terms of prediction accuracy, adaptability, and robustness. Results show that variations of the ensemble LSTM model outperform other models. Additionally, we observe that models with knowledge retention generally outperform traditional machine learning approaches in stock market prediction tasks. Our findings have significant implications for developing effective stock market prediction systems and contributing to the growth of AI-driven financial analytics.

articleTitle: Quantum Computing and Quality Quantifiers Shaping the Future of Intelligent Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Quantum computing and quality quantifiers promote advanced computing. Their utilization will develop future smart systems. Quantum-Enhanced Quality Quantification (Q2) is introduced in this paper. Q2 combines quantum computing's built-in capabilities and quality quantification methodologies to assess and enhance smart systems' performance, reliability, and morality. The proposed Q2 technique uses the quantum-enhanced quality integration (QEQI), quality quantification (QQA), and quantum error correction (QEC) algorithms. Quantum error correction (QEC) uses stabilizer codes and syndromes to rectify quantum computing errors without affecting the quantum state. The Quality Quantification Algorithm rates system performance based on dependability, moral conformity, correctness, speed, and error rate. The QEQI method uses new discoveries in quality measurement and error-corrected quantum data to make sure that smart systems offer solutions that are both technically correct and morally right. Six quantum computing methods were compared against Q2 to determine its performance: Quantum quantum, supreme accorrectiondes for quantum computing, quantum machine learning algorithms, quantum annealing, quality quantifiers for ethical AI, and quantum simulations in material science. Speed, accuracy, error rate, development, reliability, and morality determined success. The data reveal that Q2 outperforms traditional techniques in every manner. Precision, working speed, mistake rates, scalability, reliability, and morality improve. These findings demonstrate that Q2 can transform intelligent systems by improving technology and ensuring ethical behavior.

articleTitle: NBNLP-A Naïve Bayes-Natural language Processing algorithm for Chatbots
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In the contemporary era, a growing number of individuals engage with Information and Communication Technology (ICT) tools, witnessing the continuous expansion of technology and its diverse applications. A prevalent observation is the prevalence of virtual machines on websites, adept at responding to user queries and furnishing relevant information—these virtual entities are commonly known as Chatbots. Creating Chatbots involves leveraging a variety of programming languages, such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Pluto, PHP, Python, as well as incorporating elements of artificial intelligence and machine learning. Each language contributes unique features to Chatbot’s functionality. This work proposes "NBNLP-A Naïve Bayes-Natural language processing algorithm for Chatbots" and provides a straightforward comparison of Chatbots developed in different programming languages, shedding light on their distinct attributes. The ensuing discussion delves into a comparative analysis of the working mechanisms and features inherent in Chatbots crafted using diverse programming languages.

articleTitle: Smart Banking: AI and IoT Transformations of Financial Services
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This study investigates the integration of Artificial Intelligence and the Internet of Things in banking and financial services, focusing on how these technologies enhance customer care, streamline operations, and improve data management. The study examines various applications of Artificial Intelligence and the Internet of Things in financial services, such as intelligent document processing, remote asset monitoring, predictive analytics, and smart devices. Through a comprehensive literature review and case studies, the paper demonstrates the potential of Artificial Intelligence and the Internet of Things to revolutionize banking service delivery by enabling more personalized and efficient care. The findings suggest that the adoption of Artificial Intelligence and the Internet of Things in banking can lead to enormous improvements in business outcomes and operational efficiency. The paper also discusses challenges for deployment such as data privacy concerns, requirements for predictive maintenance of assets, and the importance of interoperability between different systems. The paper concludes with recommendations for banks, policymakers, and technology developers to foster the adoption of Artificial Intelligence and the Internet of Things in financial services while addressing the associated challenges.

articleTitle: Integrating Beetle Swarm Optimization into Cross-Layer Routing for Improved Qos In Cluster-Based Wsns
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: An overview of cross-layer architecture and quality-of-service optimizing for router is provided, with a focus on improving the efficiency of cluster oriented wireless sensors via the integration of the Beetle Swarm Optimization (BSO) method with the enhanced Dynamic Source Routing (DSR) approach. Cross Layer Design (CLD) is the name of the suggested approach; in this, processing restrictions related to energy are taken into primary consideration. While the IEEE 802.11 (Wi-Fi) standard was evaluated as a gateway in Chapter 3, it does have a few drawbacks, such as the fact that it can only handle small networks and that every router has only a certain amount of battery capacity. Thus, for the sake of cross-layer layout, this component takes into account the ZigBee/IEEE 802.15.4 (WPAN) wirelessly personalized area network design. A number of settings are adjusted to enhance the wireless sensor network's efficiency depending on the ZigBee structure of layers. Power from batteries is the main focus of the physical component. The media access control (MAC) layer handles packet sequencing and bandwidth that is available. Both the transmission and network layers are responsible for controlling overcrowding. The networking layer handles routable technologies. This chapter concludes, in its experimental part, that the suggested strategy improves the Quality of Services in wireless networks of sensors by outperforming in terms of throughput, consumption of energy, packet delivery ratio, and latency. While Dynamic Source Routing (DSR) and Adhoc On-Demand Distance Vector Routing (AODV) demonstrate substantially lower and more variable levels of accomplishment, the suggested approach Cross Layer Design (CLD) maintains an accuracy in the vicinity of 95%. This is in contrast to the other two methods.

articleTitle: Enhancing Routing in Wireless Networks Through Cross-Layer Design and MAC Layer Bandwidth Management
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The primary goal of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) is to extend the life of a network pressing problem that needs fixing. When it comes to Wireless Sensor Networks, saving the limited energy sources requires a modelling of effective solutions. In order to get around these problems, people are taking use of cross-layer guidelines, which optimize routing while making the network last longer. A novel Cross-Layer Cross-Domain Routing architecture based on clustering is presented in this paper. The most critical part is that a novel hybrid method chooses the cluster head optimally. Additionally, metrics like Energy utilization, Delay, the distance, Throughput, Security, and Overhead are used to choose the best cluster heads to use. By analysing active nodes and the network lifetime of dense sensor networks that are wireless, this technique aims to outperform current models in a variety of test circumstances. The book covers the three main types of routing protocols, including proactive enough, reactive in nature and hybrid approaches, and provides examples for each. Creating cross-layer routing algorithms, with bandwidth on hand as a restriction at the sublayer known as MAC in the TCP/IP transport stack, presents important problems and concerns. The suggested approach outperforms the current one in terms of E2E latency, throughput, above, and packet delivery ratio, all of which contribute to better networking reliability and service. In comparison to the AODV approach, the proposed CLDR method outperforms it by a wide margin, reaching a total accuracy of 100%.

articleTitle: Exploring Ethical Dimensions of Employing Artificial Intelligence Algorithms in Healthcare Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: AI predictive analytics using patient data may dramatically enhance health outcomes in healthcare systems. The research uses prior patient data to predict health outcomes, focusing on societal problems including justice, accuracy, accessibility, data privacy, and equitable healthcare access. We carefully collect, clean, and select features from the data. Next, association analysis finds predictive characteristics. Machine learning, training, and testing optimize and regularize hyperparameters to ensure model performance. The assessment uses memory, accuracy, precision, and k-fold cross-validation to ensure reliability. Since continuous performance monitoring and feedback systems consider social concerns, real-time healthcare applications may employ this approach. The recommended strategy outperforms previous AI solutions in accuracy, bias reduction, data clarity, and rule compliance. The proposal also improves user trust, clinical efficacy, patient safety, and healthcare justice while tackling AI ethical issues. This in-depth examination of the approach demonstrates its potential to provide more equitable and effective healthcare solutions, making it a viable AI healthcare option. Finally, our research underscores the critical role of ethics in the design of AI-powered medical technologies, ensuring their effective operation and responsible utilization.

articleTitle: Advanced Detection of Emergency Vehicles through Multi-Source Data with YOLOv9 & R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In the dynamic realm of modern traffic system there must be a improved road safety and automating traffic management systems required in the essential duty of emergency vehicle detection.The quick and precise identification of emergency vehicles, such as fire vehicles and ambulances, is crucial.By making sure that emergency vehicles are safe and easily identifiable, which facilitates quick emergency response.In order to distinguish emergency vehicles from various domestic vehicles by having data accessible from multiple sources(CCTV,Webcams),This work is carried out in YOLOV9(YOU ONLY LOOK ONCE).The sophisticated problem of identifying emergency vehicles among the clutter of bustling traffic and a variety of environmental circumstances is taken on by YOLOV9, It is highly regarded for its accuracy and real-time processing.The traffic data is utilized to predict the model after being extracted from various sources, including CCTV footage, photos, videos, and webcams.Our project design places a high priority on the capacity to accurately detect emergency vehicles in bustling traffic.
